We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to join our Buenos Aires office. This is the perfect opportunity for someone who loves talking to people all day, every day; is obsessively organized; and wants hands-on experience in recruitment and people operations within a fast-paced, global environment.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Ensure a world-class candidate experience from first touchpoint to onboarding.
Coordinate end-to-end recruitment processes, including scheduling, interviewing support, evaluating skill levels, and taking/giving feedback.
Support onboarding activities to ensure a smooth start for new hires.
Establish yourself as a trusted partner and primary point of contact for hiring managers across the organization.
Create clear, compelling job descriptions that effectively market each unique career opportunity.
Build and maintain relationships with industry associations, universities, meetups, and relevant events to strengthen talent pipelines.
Maintain accurate data and workflows in the ATS (Greenhouse) and related tools, ensuring high attention to detail and follow-through.
WHAT YOU WILL NEED
The foremost quality for this (or any) position at Blockchain is integrity.
**Previous experience in a similar Talent Acquisition / Recruiting / HR coordination role, with **hands-on experience working with an ATS (ideally Greenhouse)****.
Advanced level of English (written and spoken); ability to communicate confidently with global stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills with a proven track record of prioritization, motivation, and follow-through.
Self-motivated with a high sense of urgency, while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
Flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a dynamic, evolving business.
A charismatic, people-first mindset—you’re approachable, fearless, and excited to help build something meaningful.
COMPENSATION & PERKS
Competitive full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company
This is a role based in our Palermo office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week.
The opportunity to be a key player and build your career at a rapidly expanding, global technology company in an exciting, emerging industry.
Performance-based bonuses
Apple equipment provided by the company
Work from Anywhere Policy: You can work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days per year.
Blockchain is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. Blockchain makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.
You may contact our Data Protection Officer by email at dpo@blockchain.com. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment.
Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. Accordingly, if you are located outside of the United States, your personal data will be transferred to the United States once you submit it through this site. Because the European Union Commission has determined that United States data privacy laws do not ensure an adequate level of protection for personal data collected from EU data subjects, the transfer will be subject to appropriate additional safeguards under the standard contractual clauses.
Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. In addition, you may lodge a complaint with an EU supervisory authority.

postings.descriptionText:
Especialista de Finanzas
Te vas a sumar a una empresa donde la seguridad y las personas son la prioridad.
Sé parte de un negocio de litio en crecimiento en Argentina.
Formá parte de un equipo con propósito, donde la seguridad, el respeto y la inclusión
son fundamentales.
Ubicación: Oficina de Salta
Contratación temporal por un plazo estimado de 6 meses.
Información sobre el rol
Este rol tiene como objetivo dar soporte a la gerencia de finanzas de Rincon en el proceso mensual de control presupuestario.
Al formar parte del equipo de Finanzas, tus principales responsabilidades serán:
Seguimiento y control presupuestario de las inversiones de capital.
Soporte financiero al equipo de operaciones, incluyendo análisis de costos.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de controles y procesos financieros.
Preparación de reportes y análisis financieros para apoyar toma de decisiones.
Soporte en los procesos de planeamiento, interactuando con otras áreas.

Información sobre vos
Para este rol, es importante que cuentes con:
Un compromiso firme con tu seguridad y la del equipo
Graduado/a de Contador Público o Licenciado/a en Administración
Experiencia en análisis presupuestario, planificación y control de gastos operativos e inversiones de capital.
Conocimiento en: Excel intermedio, inglés y SAP (no excluyente).

Qué ofrecemos

Un entorno de trabajo donde la seguridad es una prioridad en todo lo que hacemos.
Un paquete de remuneraciones competitivo con incentivos anuales.
Programas de salud de primer nivel, pensados para la familia.
Un Programa de Asistencia al Empleado/a para acompañarte cuando lo necesites.
Apoyo continuo para tu bienestar personal y profesional.
Licencias para todas las etapas de la vida (vacaciones, licencias parentales y médicas).

About Rio Tinto
Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.
We have been mining for 150 years and operate with knowledge built up across generations and continents. Our purpose is finding better ways to provide the materials the world needs – striving for innovation and continuous improvement to produce materials with low emissions and to the right environmental, social and governance standards. But we can’t do it on our own, so we’re focused on creating partnerships to solve problems, create win-win situations and meet opportunities.
Where you will be working
Recognized as a pioneer and leader in the industrial minerals industry due to product quality, supply reliability and technical support; we are proud to make modern life work. Lithium is part of our portfolio of materials essential to a low-carbon future and is a key element needed for low-carbon technologies. The Battery Materials unit is comprised of the Borates operations in US, the Jadar Project in Serbia and the Rincon project in Argentina, leading in mining borates and lithium for a more sustainable future. The Rincon lithium project is a large undeveloped lithium brine project located in the heart of the lithium triangle in the Salta Province of Argentina, an emerging hub for greenfield projects. It is a long-life, scalable resource with one of the lowest carbon footprints of lithium assets in the world. This acquisition is a significant further endorsement of our commitment to the battery materials sector and lithium's role in a low-carbon future.

Respect and Inclusion
At Rio Tinto, we particularly welcome and encourage applications from Indigenous Peoples, women, the LGBTQ+ community, mature workers, people with disabilities, and people from different cultural backgrounds. We are committed to an inclusive environment where people feel comfortable being themselves. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or anything else that makes us different.

Cajero (a) de Servicios y Ventas – Corrientes, Argentina

Responsabilidades del rol
En este rol podrás conectar a los individuos para que el progreso y la prosperidad puedan llegar a más personas, familias y comunidades. Para lograrlo, las responsabilidades son:
Excelente servicio al cliente.
Brindar los diversos productos de la compañía.
Velar por el cumplimiento de los parámetros establecidos en los manuales y políticas de fraude de la Empresa.
Control de caja; cumpliendo con el procedimiento indicado para el manejo de efectivo y seguridad de la sucursal.
Trabajo en equipo en pos de los objetivos comerciales.

Requisitos del rol
Educación secundaria completa (estar cursando estudios universitarios es un plus).
Mínimo de 2 años de experiencia en atención al cliente, manejo de efectivo y control de caja.
Disponibilidad para trabajar de Lunes a Sábados (48 horas semanales/franco rotativo).
Flexibilidad para trabajar en turnos rotativos (dentro del horario comercial).
Buen historial crediticio.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente o en colaboración con otras personas en un entorno global y dinámico, manejar la ambigüedad, tomar decisiones rápidas y gestionar plazos ajustados.
MODALIDAD DE TRABAJO
100% PRESENCIAL - Western Union valora la colaboración presencial, la resolución de problemas y la generación de ideas siempre que sea posible. Creemos que esto fomenta formas de trabajo compartidas y favorece la ejecución de iniciativas para nuestros clientes.
Debido a la naturaleza de esta posición, se espera que la persona desempeñe sus funciones de manera presencial en la oficina a tiempo completo.

BENEFITS AND OTHER DETAILS
Beneficios
También tendrás acceso a incentivos a corto plazo, múltiples opciones de seguro médico, seguro de accidentes y de vida, así como acceso a plataformas de desarrollo de primer nivel, entre otros beneficios. Consulta a continuación los beneficios específicos de tu país. De ser aplicable, los beneficios adicionales específicos del puesto se mencionarán durante el proceso de entrevista o en la oferta de empleo.
Los beneficios específicos de Argentina incluyen:
Regalo por casamiento, nacimientos.
Descuento en gimnasios.
Cursos optativos (convenio con universidades a distancia).
10 días corridos para padre/madre no gestante.

Nos apasiona la diversidad. Nuestro compromiso es brindar una cultura inclusiva que celebre los orígenes y perspectivas únicas de nuestros equipos globales mientras reflejan las comunidades que atender. No discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, nacionalidad, religión, afiliación política, sexo (incluido el embarazo), orientación sexual, identidad de género, edad, discapacidad, estado civil o condición de veterano. La empresa proporcionará adaptaciones a los solicitantes, incluidos aquellos con discapacidades, durante el proceso de contratación, siguiendo las leyes aplicables.

10-19-2026

postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de PepsiCo · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
Overview
CARRERAS PARA SONREIR
En PepsiCo, descubrirás un lugar donde nuestra misión es crear sonrisas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 500 marcas queridas, incluyen Gatorade, Lay's y Quaker y nuestro trabajo llega a millones de personas cada día.
En el corazón de nuestra compañía hay un equipo de pensadores y creadores que colaboran para innovar y convertir las ideas en acciones. Impulsados por la innovación y centrados en crear momentos de alegría a través de los alimentos y bebidas, nuestras decisiones se guían por y para el consumidor, creando oportunidades para que nuestros asociados realicen un trabajo significativo y tengan un impacto duradero en las comunidades a las que servimos.
Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea.
Responsibilities
La oportunidad
Responsable de liderar y desarrollar la ejecución comercial dentro de la zona asignada, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, ejecución en punto de venta y desarrollo de clientes del canal OT. Actúa como nexo entre la estrategia comercial y la operación en campo, gestionando equipos de reposición y/o ejecución, identificando oportunidades de crecimiento y garantizando la excelencia en la implementación de las iniciativas comerciales
Tu impacto
Liderar y gestionar el equipo de repositores y recursos de ejecución de la zona asignada.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de volumen, facturación, ejecución y cobertura.
Monitorear indicadores de gestión (KPIs), identificar oportunidades y desarrollar planes de acción.
Realizar visitas periódicas a clientes y puntos de venta para asegurar la correcta ejecución de exhibiciones, promociones y estándares de Tienda Perfecta.
Coordinar y controlar la implementación de acciones comerciales, material POP y campañas de marca.
Gestionar agendas de visitas, recorridos de campo y rutinas de supervisión.
Capacitar, acompañar y desarrollar al equipo mediante coaching y seguimiento en terreno.
Analizar información de mercado, competencia y desempeño comercial para detectar oportunidades de crecimiento.
Administrar procesos operativos relacionados con viáticos, ausentismo, vacaciones, elementos de trabajo y seguimiento de recursos
Qualifications
¿A quién buscamos?
Profesionales o estudiantes avanzados de Administración, Comercialización, Marketing o carreras afines.
Experiencia previa en ventas, ejecución comercial, trade marketing o supervisión de equipos.
Manejo de indicadores comerciales y herramientas de análisis.
Capacidad de liderazgo, coaching y desarrollo de equipos.
Habilidades de negociación y comunicación efectiva.
Perfil analítico, orientado a resultados y resolución de problemas.
Disponibilidad para realizar trabajo de campo y visitas a clientes.
Licencia de conducir vigente (no principante excluyente)
Manejo intermedio/avanzado de Excel y herramientas digitales de gestión comercial.
Si esta es una oportunidad que te interesa, te alentamos a postularte aún si no cumples con el 100% de los requisitos.
Qué puedes esperar de nosotros:
Oportunidades para aprender y desarrollarte todos los días a través de una amplia oferta de programas.
Plataformas internas digitales que promueven el self-learning.
Programas de desarrollo de acuerdo con habilidades de Liderazgo.
Entrenamientos especializados de acuerdo con el rol.
Experiencias de aprendizaje con proveedores internos y externos.
Nos encanta celebrar el éxito, por lo que contamos con programas de reconocimiento por antigüedad, comportamientos, liderazgo, momentos de vida, entre otros.
Programas de bienestar financiero que te ayudarán a alcanzar tus metas en todas las etapas de la vida.
Un programa de flexibilidad que te permitirá balancear tu vida personal y laboral, adaptando tu jornada laboral a tu estilo de vida.
Y porque tu familia también es importante para nosotros, ellos también pueden gozar de beneficios como nuestra Línea de Bienestar, miles de Convenios y Descuentos, programas de Becas para tus hijos, Planes de Ayuda para diferentes momentos de vida, entre otros.
En PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos con impulsar un equipo de trabajo diverso al crear un espacio colaborativo, equitativo e incluyente, en donde todos y todas independientemente de cómo nos vemos, de dónde somos o a quién amamos- tengamos una voz. Ofrecemos oportunidades únicas para contratar personas calificadas y diversas, independientemente de su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, edad o discapacidad.

postings.title: Enterprise Account Executive
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Minders · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
¿Te apasiona la tecnología y los desafíos comerciales? ¿Quieres formar parte de una experiencia humana en un ambiente increíble? ¡En Minders, te estamos esperando! 🚀 En Minders estamos en plena expansión y buscamos un Account Executive Enterprise con experiencia en ventas B2B consultivas de tecnología para unirse a nuestro equipo en la región SOLA. Esta persona será clave en el crecimiento de nuestras soluciones líderes en Growth y Martech: Amplitude, Braze y Airbridge.
\n

Responsabilidades
Estrategia comercial regional: Definir junto al Regional Manager y el CRO la estrategia para abordar cuentas Enterprise en SoLA, priorizando industrias clave y oportunidades de alto impacto.
Cumplimiento de objetivos comerciales: Alcanzar y superar los objetivos individuales de ventas, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de las metas regionales de SOLA.
Gestión de cuentas estratégicas: Desarrollar relaciones de largo plazo con decisores C-level y equipos técnicos, comprendiendo sus desafíos de negocio y alineando nuestras soluciones a sus objetivos estratégicos. 🤝
Ventas consultivas complejas: Liderar procesos de venta de alto valor con ciclos de más de 6 meses, gestionando múltiples stakeholders, negociaciones contractuales y la construcción de business cases sólidos.
Presentaciones de valor: Realizar demos y presentaciones ejecutivas que traduzcan nuestras capacidades técnicas (Amplitude, Braze, Airbridge y ecosistema de partners) en resultados tangibles de negocio y ROI.
Gestión de pipeline y forecast: Mantener un pipeline robusto y predecible, con visibilidad de cada etapa del proceso comercial. Cumplir la cuota anual de 8–10 cierres con tickets promedio superiores a USD 250K. 📈
Expansión y crecimiento de cuentas: Impulsar el farming en clientes actuales y la expansión hacia nuevas unidades de negocio, asegurando una relación sostenida y rentable con cada cuenta.
Colaboración cross-functional: Trabajar estrechamente con Marketing, BDRs, Customer Success y equipos técnicos para garantizar una experiencia integral y coherente a lo largo del ciclo del cliente.
Conocimiento de mercado y competencia: Mantenerse al día sobre las tendencias en SaaS, martech y analítica, entendiendo qué soluciones están adoptando las empresas Enterprise en la región y cómo posicionarse frente a ellas.
Marca personal y posicionamiento: Actuar como referente de la marca en el segmento Enterprise, compartiendo contenido relevante sobre tecnología, data y crecimiento digital.

Requisitos
Profesional en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Industrial, Administración, Marketing o carreras afines.
Experiencia mínima de 5 años en ventas Enterprise de soluciones SaaS y servicios tecnológicos.
Experiencia demostrable en la venta de proyectos B2B superiores a USD 250K y en la gestión de ciclos de venta largos.
Historial comprobado de cumplimiento o superación de objetivos comerciales.
Experiencia en la venta de servicios asociados a la tecnología (implementaciones, integraciones, consultoría, etc.).
Manejo de CRM (obligatorio).
Inglés avanzado (obligatorio) — comunicación fluida con vendors y C-suite.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma, con enfoque estratégico y visión de negocio regional.

Beneficios
Salario competitivo en USD 🌍
Osde 310
3 semanas de vacaciones pagadas a partir de los 6 meses y 4 semanas a partir de los 2 años en Minders.
Trabajo híbrido (2 veces a la semana en nuestra oficina ubicada en Recoleta).
Presupuesto para capacitación y desarrollo (idiomas, Soft Skills y Hard Skills).
Work from Anywhere (Después de un año, 3 semanas para trabajar de forma remota desde cualquier parte del mundo, y después de 2 años, 5 semanas).

\n
But wait… ¿Quiénes somos? Somos Minders, una consultora experta en Martech y Growth.
Ayudamos a equipos de producto y marketing a retener usuarios, optimizar experiencias digitales y escalar sus negocios con datos, engagement y experimentación.
Somos partners oficiales de Amplitude, Braze y Airbridge en Latinoamérica, y trabajamos con algunas de las empresas más innovadoras de la región: Mercado Libre, Rappi, Kavak, Stone, Globoplay, Creditas, Bold, Davivienda, Banco General, entre muchas otras.

postings.title: Account Executive - Go High Level (GHL)
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Huzzle · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.
About the company
Our client is an innovative AI-driven marketing and business automation firm dedicated to scaling local service and retail brands. The team builds end-to-end systems that integrate content engines, AI voice agents, and CRM automation to drive revenue while reducing operational overhead. By combining human strategy with machine efficiency, they provide transparency through data-verified results and managed marketing packages that include SEO, reputation management, and high-volume social media production.
Operating as a transparent, growth-oriented partner, the company focuses on delivering measurable impact for multi-location businesses, home services, and professional practitioners. The culture is built on a "product-first" mentality, prioritizing technical excellence, 24/7 support, and honest, results-based reporting. Candidates joining this fast-paced environment will work at the intersection of generative AI and business efficiency, helping to deploy cutting-edge tools that redefine how modern businesses capture and convert leads in an AI-first search landscape.
Job Summary
We are seeking a high-performing, results-driven Sales Professional to take full ownership of the revenue engine for a fast-growing AI-powered marketing and automation agency. This is a "player-coach" style role where you will be the primary closer for our done-for-you marketing services, helping local businesses (Home Services, Dental/Med Spas, Professional Services) scale through cutting-edge automation. If you are a GoHighLevel power user who thrives on closing deals and wants a clear path toward leading a sales organization, this is your opportunity to join an agile team at the ground floor.
Key Responsibilities
Execute full-cycle sales, from initial prospecting and cold calling (40–60 calls/day) to booking and running live demos.
Act as the primary closer for tiered marketing and automation packages ranging from $495 to $3,997/month.
Manage the entire sales pipeline within GoHighLevel (GHL), ensuring lead funnels are optimized and followed up on promptly.
Translate complex marketing automation solutions into clear, value-based pitches for local business owners.
Upsell existing clients into higher-tier service packages as they see initial success.
Collaborate directly with the Founder to refine the sales script, lead acquisition strategy, and market positioning.
Proven track record as a Closer: You must demonstrate a high close rate and a "hunter" mentality.
GHL Expert: Deep familiarity with GoHighLevel and marketing automation tools is non-negotiable; you must be ready to hit the ground running without technical training.
Fluent English: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required to build trust with US-based business owners.
High Volume Capacity: Comfort and experience with high-volume outbound calling and managing a busy demo calendar.
Self-Starter: Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal oversight.
Nice-to-Have
Bilingual (English/Spanish): Highly preferred as the team looks to expand into Spanish-speaking markets.
Agency Experience: Prior experience selling marketing services, SEO, or lead generation is a significant plus.
💰 Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission
📈 Significant residual income (15% ongoing) for long-term wealth building
🌎 100% remote work environment
🚀 Opportunity to grow into a Sales Leadership role as the team scales
🛠️ Strong backend support—buildouts and admin are handled by a dedicated partner company, allowing you to focus purely on selling
🎯 Performance-based incentives and negotiable compensation structures

5–7 years of experience in software testing across web, mobile, and API.

Clear understanding of eval vs. deterministic testing — the difference between pass/fail based on exact input/output and evaluating probabilistic AI outputs using human-in-the-loop evaluations, score metrics, benchmark datasets, and semantic evaluation.
Strong understanding of web and mobile application development lifecycles including iOS and Android specifics.
Proven experience in integration, regression, performance/load, and UAT.
Hands-on knowledge of browser DevTools and log monitoring.
Advanced proficiency in Jira and Confluence.
Experience with test management systems.

Experience in the financial services or fintech domain.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

Shape real-world AI-driven projects across key industries, working with clients from startup innovation to enterprise transformation.
Be part of a global team with equal opportunities for collaboration across continents and cultures.
Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards.
Ready to make an impact?
If you're excited to build things that matter, champion responsible AI, and grow with some of the industry’s sharpest minds. Apply today and let’s innovate together.

postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Sezzle · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)
About Sezzle:
With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!
Compensation:
For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.
About the Role:
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.
This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.
You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.
At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.
What You’ll Do:
Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.
Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.
Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.
Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.
Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.
Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.
Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.
What We Look For:
6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.
Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.
Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.
Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.
Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.
Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.
Preferred Knowledge and Skills:
Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.
Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.
Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).
Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.
Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.
Experience with threat modeling at a system level.
About You:
You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better.
You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it.
You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting.
You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable systems for a Product-led engineering team. This person works in Java and/or Kotlin with Spring Boot, GraphQL, MongoDB, and Aurora MySQL on AWS, covering everything from operational tooling to system architecture. Comfort picking up compliance, cost-savings, and observability work matters here.

MUST HAVES
- 3+ years of professional, backend-focused software development experience.
- Proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin.
- Proficiency in a modern NoSQL database, MongoDB on Atlas.
- Proficiency in a modern relational database, Aurora MySQL on AWS.
- Experience building cloud-native distributed systems on AWS.
- Experience with the Spring Boot framework.
- API development with GraphQL (Netflix DGS).
- Experience building and operating large-scale, high-performance, and resilient systems on a major cloud platform.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Event-driven system development, ideally with Apache Kafka and/or SQS.
- AI-assisted coding experience.
- Terraform.
- Experience building microservices.
- API development with gRPC and REST.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Take on lower-priority engineering work the team lacks bandwidth for, including compliance and engineering maintenance, cost-savings, observability, experiment clean-up, and operational tool development.
- Design, build, and maintain scalable, performant, and reliable software systems.
- Contribute to system architecture and technical design, validating solutions through data and experimentation where appropriate.
- Participate in code reviews and design reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including software engineers, product managers, data scientists, and designers.
- Partner with a Product Manager and fellow engineers to clarify requirements and perform mid-level design work, focusing primarily on coding, testing, and documentation.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

postings.title: Product Manager, Orchestration Platform
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Felix Technologies, Inc. · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT US

At Félix [https://felixpago.com/], we are building the indispensable financial
companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first
interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money
movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances
powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and
wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our
ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of
a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically
overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding
from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle
Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value
Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our
investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as
an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech
Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that
will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply
meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long
because we are obsessed with our customers. We get things done with urgency and
focus, driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego,
fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together.
Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay
insatiably curious—always experimenting, building the future today, and
delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We've built an orchestration platform that runs our remittance transaction flow
end to end. It handles the long-running, stateful, failure-prone work between
"customer pressed send" and "money arrived": routing, compliance checks, partner
calls, payouts, reconciliation, retries and compensation when a step fails.

Remittance is the first product on the platform. Our intent is for future
products to launch on this layer rather than rebuild transaction orchestration.
This is the senior product role for that piece of core company infrastructure.

RESPONSIBILITIES

* Platform strategy: Define what the orchestration platform is and isn't: its
boundaries, guarantees, and non-goals. Decide which capabilities are platform
primitives and which belong in consuming products, and hold that line under
pressure.
* The path to multiple products: Own the sequencing and core changes needed
before a second product can onboard, and the migration approach for
remittance as the platform evolves underneath it.
* The product surface: Define the contracts teams build against — workflow
interfaces, idempotency, retry and compensation semantics, timeouts, state
visibility, SLAs — and the docs, onboarding and observability tooling that
make the platform self-serve and operable.
* Roadmap and delivery: Run the platform engineering team's roadmap, balancing
remittance reliability against platform investment, and own the platform's
success metrics (workflow success rates, time-to-completion, manual
intervention rate, time to resolve stuck workflows, time-to-integrate).
* Stakeholders and architecture: Represent the platform to operations,
compliance and finance; partner with the engineering lead on architecture
decisions with product consequences.

REQUIREMENTS

* 5+ years in product management with at least 3 years owning a platform,
infrastructure, API, or backend product whose primary customers were other
engineering teams. You have shipped something other teams built on, lived
with the consequences of its abstractions, and can talk concretely about what
you got wrong.
* Strong grounding in distributed-systems concepts: asynchronous processing,
eventual consistency, at-least-once delivery, idempotency, compensation
versus rollback, and the failure modes of long-running workflows. You can
hold a design conversation with senior engineers as a peer.
* Payments, remittance, banking, ledger or transaction-processing experience.
You understand settlement, reconciliation, payout partners and compliance
screening well enough to know where the domain-specific logic ends.
* Exceptional written communication. Your specs and contracts will be the
reference others depend on.
* Direct comfort with data: querying, reading dashboards, investigating
anomalies without an intermediary.
* A track record of saying No to powerful internal stakeholders and being right
often enough that they kept coming back.
* These are the applicable requirements, although equivalent competencies in
any of the above will also be considered.

Nice to have:

* Hands-on product experience with a workflow or durable-execution engine —
Temporal, Cadence, Step Functions, Camunda, or an in-house equivalent.
* Experience owning platform reliability outcomes, not just features.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Competitive salary
* Initial stock options grant
* Annual performance bonus
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid parental leave
* Work model: currently fully remote, with a future transition to a hybrid
setup
* Health, dental, and vision plans
* 401(k) with employer matching, for US-based employees
* Continuous learning opportunities
* Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all
qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion,
nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This
policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment,
hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy
[https://www.felixpago.com/en/legal].

postings.title: Sr/Ssr Software Engineer - Agent Platform
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Kleva · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Kleva
Kleva construye agentes de IA que deciden cuándo y cómo contactar a cada persona, y después llaman, conversan y resuelven. Hoy recuperan deuda para bancos, fintechs y empresas de servicios en 8 países de América Latina, con miles de llamadas concurrentes. No somos una agencia de cobranzas ni un dialer con IA.
Nuestra visión es ser la voz de las empresas en Latam, y cobranzas es el primer paso. Los modelos de IA están disponibles para todos; lo difícil es lo que está alrededor: que la persona atienda, que la llamada suene real, que el agente sepa qué decir y que cada conversación cueste poco. Eso es lo que construye nuestro equipo de ingeniería.
Conocé Kleva en video
El rol
Buscamos a una persona que se sume al equipo que construye la plataforma con la que se crean, configuran, orquestan y evalúan nuestros agentes. La plataforma ya está en producción: vas a evolucionarla y escalarla de punta a punta, en frontend y backend.
No es un rol de forward deployed ni de implementación. No vas a construir agentes para clientes: vas a trabajar en la plataforma sobre la que se diseñan, prueban, despliegan y operan todos nuestros agentes.
Problemas en los que vas a trabajar
Cómo modelamos un agente para que sea versionado, testeable y reutilizable, sin perder la flexibilidad que pide cada cliente?
Cómo sabemos, antes de que hable con una persona real, que un cambio de prompt no rompió una negociación? Evals antes de cada cambio, con simulación y regresión sobre sistemas no deterministas.
Cómo hacemos que el agente recuerde entre llamadas y canales? Si alguien dijo que cobra después del 10, no lo llamamos el 5. Si rechazó una propuesta, no se la repetimos.
Cómo elegimos, llamada por llamada, qué voz, tono y guion rinden mejor con cada perfil, y cómo dejamos que la plataforma pruebe variantes y se quede con la que gana?
Cómo decidimos a quién contactar, cuándo, por qué canal y cuándo frenar, respetando los horarios, la frecuencia máxima y los registros de no llamar de cada país?
Qué vas a hacer
Desarrollar features de punta a punta, frontend y backend, con ownership completo: desde entender el problema del cliente hasta tenerlo en producción.
Diseñar el modelo de configuración de agentes: prompts, herramientas, reglas, voces y políticas por cliente, versionadas, con rollback y con variantes para experimentar.
Desarrollar la infraestructura de evals junto a QA: deudores simulados, suites de regresión y scoring automático, para que ningún cambio de agente o de prompt llegue a producción sin pasar por ella.
Construir la memoria y el contexto por persona que alimentan cada conversación, entre llamadas y canales.
Desarrollar el motor de orquestación de campañas y canales: ejecuta las decisiones de timing y priorización del equipo de data, sigue la conversación por WhatsApp si no atienden y aplica las reglas de cumplimiento de cada país.
Diseñar e implementar las APIs, contratos, webhooks e integraciones con los sistemas enterprise de cada cliente: carga de carteras, consulta de deuda, registro de promesas y confirmación de pagos.
Contribuir a la arquitectura del sistema a medida que escala en volumen y países.
Resolver incidentes en producción. Si surge un problema crítico, esperamos que te involucres y ayudes a resolverlo.
Stack
Frontend: TypeScript, React y Next.js.
Backend: Node.js con TypeScript, Go y Python.
Datos: PostgreSQL y Redis.
Infraestructura: AWS y Docker.
Contexto del rol
Reporta a: Head of Engineering.
Trabaja con: Producto, Operaciones, Delivery, QA y Data.
Qué no buscamos
Quien siente que ya llegó al nivel profesional que quería
Perfiles que necesitan un spec cerrado para arrancar. Acá recibís un problema, no un ticket. Si necesitás tres reuniones para empezar a codear, no es tu lugar.
Quien necesita certeza antes de avanzar. Ir rápido significa equivocarse seguido, hacer y rehacer; lo aceptamos porque equivocarnos rápido enseña más que acertar tarde. No hay PMs que te mastiquen tickets.
Quien construye la plataforma antes de entender el patrón. Primero entendemos cómo opera cada cliente; después generalizamos.
4+ años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo de software, con track record de llevar producto a producción en ambientes de ritmo alto.
Dominio de TypeScript, React, Next.js y Node.js.
Sólido manejo de PostgreSQL y experiencia con bases NoSQL.
Experiencia diseñando REST APIs, contratos y webhooks, y modelos de datos que aguanten el cambio.
Comodidad con Git, CI/CD y AWS.
Mentalidad de plataforma: pensás en abstracciones reutilizables y sabés cuándo todavía no conviene generalizar.
Capacidad de trabajar de forma independiente, tomar ownership y resolver sin supervisión constante.
Uso intensivo y crítico de asistentes de código con IA (Claude Code o Cursor). La IA escribe; el criterio y lo que mergeás son tuyos.
Deseable
Experiencia construyendo con LLMs en producción: prompting, tool use, structured outputs y evals.
Experiencia en plataformas de agentes, workflow engines, motores de reglas o developer tooling.
Experiencia construyendo copilots o asistentes conversacionales que operan sobre APIs de producto.
Experiencia en Go.
Sistemas multi-tenant, de alta concurrencia o altamente configurables.
Arquitecturas event-driven y colas.
Background en fintech, cobranzas o productos B2B enterprise.
Experiencia en startups early stage.
Salario competitivo en dólares.
Tres semanas pagas de vacaciones por año.
Esquema híbrido en Buenos Aires. Al menos 1 día por semana vamos a la oficina.
Un equipo chico donde lo que construís llega a producción en días
En cada interacción, valoramos los resultados por encima de los egos o jerarquías.
Cómo es trabajar en Kleva
Equipos chicos, talentosos y emprendedores. Vas a trabajar en equipos autónomos y orientados a resultados, junto a algunas de las personas más brillantes en lo suyo.
Una oportunidad excepcional para crecer. Hacemos todo lo posible por contratar personas con un potencial fuera de lo común, y después nuestra prioridad es ponerlas en el lugar ideal para que se destaquen. En Kleva, la responsabilidad se gana con resultados, no con antigüedad:
Amplificá tu impacto con IA. Integrá las herramientas de IA más potentes en todo tu flujo de desarrollo (diseño, implementación, testing y documentación) para ir más rápido sin bajar la vara en calidad, confiabilidad y mantenibilidad.
Simplificá sin descanso. Cuestioná cada capa de complejidad. Mejorá arquitecturas, pipelines y codebases para construir sistemas más simples, más escalables y más fáciles de mantener.

postings.title: Staff QA Automation Engineer
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Meeru AI Inc · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
About Meeru AI
Meeru AI is building an AI-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP&A leaders.
We deploy on customer terms — SaaS multi-tenant, SaaS single-tenant, and on-premises — across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance.
The Role
We are looking for a Staff Data Engineer to build and own the major subsystems of the data foundation — the pipelines, connectors, and curated models that feed the platform's analytics and AI layers. You take the data architecture and standards set by the data lead and turn them into robust, production-grade systems that don't break and don't lie about the numbers.
You own significant pieces of the platform end to end: complex transformations over the warehouse, source integrations for new customer systems, and the reconciliation and lineage that prove the curated model ties back to source. This is a hands-on, high-ownership engineering role with a clear path toward Senior Staff.
Why this role is exciting
High ownership — own major pipelines and integrations end to end, including their performance, reliability, and cost.
Correctness that matters — your reconciliation and lineage work is what makes the platform auditable next to real financials.
Build for reuse — integrations are configuration against a shared framework, not throwaway scripts.
Multi-cloud, multi-tenant — pipelines run inside customer clouds with strong isolation and no data egress.
8+ years in QA and test automation, including 3+ years leading people. You've hired, run 1:1s and performance reviews, and mentored QA engineers, not just led a project.
You've built automation frameworks from scratch. You've taken a product from little or no automation to a working framework across API, UI and backend tests, and you can explain the design choices.
Strong coding in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript. You write maintainable test code daily in both: PyTest for the backend, TypeScript for the frontend.
Deep API testing experience. REST, GraphQL and WebSockets, using tools like PyTest, Postman or REST Assured, including contract, negative and auth testing.
Modern end-to-end UI testing. Playwright or Cypress against React/Next.js apps, with reliable, low-flake suites covering critical user journeys.
Backend and database testing. Testing Python/FastAPI services and PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy), with SQL-based data validation and attention to database performance.
CI/CD integration. You've wired tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins or GitLab CI, set up deployment quality gates, and worked with Docker/Kubernetes environments.
Performance and load testing. You've designed load, stress and scalability tests with tools like k6, Locust or JMeter, plus front-end checks like Lighthouse.
Security testing. SAST/DAST in the pipeline (e.g. SonarQube, Snyk, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite), and testing authentication, role-based access and data encryption.
Multi-tenant SaaS experience. You've tested platforms where many customers share infrastructure and know how to prove one tenant can't see another's data.
Compliance-driven testing. You've supported SOC 2, GDPR or HIPAA requirements with test processes and evidence.
Cloud experience. AWS preferred (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda); GCP or Azure also welcome.
Quality leadership and process. You've defined QA standards, metrics and KPIs, release and regression procedures, and runbooks, and you report quality clearly to leadership.
Clear communication and collaboration. You work closely with Product on acceptance criteria, Engineering on testability and DevOps on releases, explaining risk to technical and non-technical people alike, in an Agile/Scrum setup.
Nice to have
Testing AI/LLM applications. You've tested LLM features or agentic workflows, can handle non-deterministic output, validate prompts and model outputs, and check for bias and fairness. LangChain/LangGraph familiarity is a plus.
FinTech or financial services background. Experience where accuracy, audit trails and reliability around money matter.
Startup experience. You're comfortable building from zero in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
Observability and production monitoring. Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus or New Relic, including monitoring AI behavior in production.
Chaos engineering and resilience testing.
Test management tools. TestRail, Zephyr or Jira-based test management.
Certifications. ISTQB Advanced (or similar), AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect.
Community involvement. Open-source contributions to testing frameworks, technical writing or conference talks.

postings.descriptionText:
Product Manager - North Latam (Mexico, Puerto Rico)

About Abbott
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of .
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position works out of our Mexico City location in the CRM Division. Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks. CRM Division is a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias, or irregular heartbeats.

The Marketing Manager for the North LATAM region, comprising Puerto Rico, Mexico, and the Andean, Caribbean Region. This role will be a contributor of the overall commercialization effort for assigned CRM product lines. Duties include preparing and executing product launch plans for the North LATAM region, including business justification, managing implementation of commercial strategies and development and execution of product commercialization plans. The incumbent in this position will be a technical expert with knowledge of the market and of cardiac rhythm management therapies.

What You’ll Do

Develops launch materials, product literature, and any other collateral material required to support sales and key marketing messages
Develops product marketing bulletins on new and current products. Provides communication to sales team on market released products.
Contacts, visits and educates clients and potential clients on the Company’s products and addresses any client questions and concerns.
Builds and executes on business plans in partnership with management to identify, target and develop new accounts.
Provides medical professionals with information and training on the use of Company products and with staff education, in-services and technical troubleshooting.
Drives market development activities through establishment of best practices and development of tools to raise awareness of the benefits of assigned product(s)/product lines
Builds strong relationships with CALA, US and Global teams to ensure successful launch of new sites / new products (tools/SW) and collaborates to ensure launch of new sales enablement tools and collaborate to ensure launch of new sales enablement tools
Works with market research to collect competitive intelligence and shares results regularly with management.
Defines accurate market models across North LATAM region. Tracks market share across all CRM product categories.
Builds strong relationships with leading KOLs.
Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments. Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Engineering Biomedical, engineering or a relevant technical field, or equivalent. Master’s degree preferred.
Developed leadership skills/experience, including the ability to map task interdependencies, prioritize such tasks, and develop, monitor and live within budgets as well as the demonstrated ability to forecast major milestones.
Experience working in a broader enterprise/cross-division business unit model preferred.
Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.
Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.
Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.
Language: Ability to conduct business in English and Spanish

Preferred:
Deep Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) product knowledge/expertise.
Experience of commercial medical device experience

Apply now

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.
Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

Company description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Shopify Plus Developer to help build and scale modern enterprise ecommerce experiences on Shopify's native platform. This role will focus on developing high-performance storefronts, custom commerce logic, and platform integrations using Shopify's full extensibility stack, including Online Store 2.0 themes, Shopify Functions, Checkout UI Extensions, Customer Account Extensions, and custom apps.
You will work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to build scalable storefront experiences, integrate enterprise systems, and help shape technical solutions that support complex commerce ecosystems.
The ideal candidate brings deep Shopify Plus expertise, strong engineering fundamentals across Liquid, JavaScript, and TypeScript, and a passion for pushing Shopify's native platform to support enterprise-grade commerce.

Responsibilities

Your Impact:
Build and maintain custom Shopify Plus storefronts using Online Store 2.0 themes, Liquid, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
Develop custom commerce experiences across product discovery, product detail pages, cart, checkout, customer accounts, and post-purchase experiences.
Build custom commerce functionality using Shopify Functions for discounts, shipping, payment, and validation customizations.
Develop Checkout UI Extensions, Customer Account UI Extensions, and post-purchase extensions using Shopify's modern extensibility frameworks.
Model and consume structured commerce content using Shopify metaobjects and metafields to power dynamic merchandising, content blocks, and product data within Online Store 2.0 themes.
Build and maintain custom Shopify apps using Admin API, Storefront API, GraphQL, Webhooks, and Shopify Flow.
Integrate Shopify with enterprise systems including payments, fulfillment, inventory, pricing, OMS, CRM, and product information platforms.
Collaborate with Product, UX, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Optimize storefront performance, theme architecture, Core Web Vitals, and mobile experiences.
Support automated testing including unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage using Playwright or equivalent, alongside deployments, troubleshooting, production support, and continuous platform improvements.
Use AI-assisted development tooling (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) as part of day-to-day engineering workflow to accelerate delivery, testing, and documentation.
Stay current on emerging Shopify capabilities, extensibility frameworks, and modern development best practices.

Qualifications

Your skills and Experience:
5+ years of ecommerce development experience with strong hands-on experience building solutions on Shopify Plus.
Deep expertise in Liquid, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with strong frontend engineering fundamentals.
Hands-on production experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout UI Extensions, and Customer Account Extensions.
Strong experience with Shopify APIs including Admin API, Storefront API, GraphQL, Webhooks, and custom app development.
Working knowledge of Shopify backend concepts including metaobjects, metafields, and Markets in support of theme and extension development.
Strong understanding of ecommerce fundamentals including catalog management, cart and checkout, payments, promotions, fulfillment, and order lifecycle management.
Experience integrating Shopify with third-party systems such as ERP, OMS, PIM, payment providers, or fulfillment platforms.
Strong understanding of theme architecture, modern web performance optimization, and frontend engineering best practices.
Experience working within Agile product development environments.
Set Yourself Apart With:
Experience supporting Shopify B2B implementations including company accounts, catalogs, and payment terms.
Experience with Shopify Flow, event-driven architecture, and middleware orchestration.
Experience with platforms such as Datadog, Sentry, or similar observability and developer tooling.
Experience supporting WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility in production Shopify themes and storefronts.
Experience working on enterprise-scale commerce implementations with complex system integrations.
Experience supporting platform migrations to Shopify Plus from SFCC, Hybris, Magento, or similar.
Shopify certifications preferred.

Additional information

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com

postings.title: HE3 - Software Developer, E-Commerce Systems
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Rockcruit · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
We run three home furnishings storefronts on a catalog of 100,000+ SKUs from a long list of manufacturers. Almost all of it runs on software we built ourselves: a Django backend, a React storefront on Cloudflare Workers, and a set of pipelines that turn messy vendor spreadsheets, emails, SFTP drops and websites into clean product, pricing and inventory data.
We're looking for a developer to work alongside our lead developer on that stack. Most of the job is solving concrete business problems: a vendor feed that breaks every month, a pricing rule nobody can explain, a task the team still does by hand in a spreadsheet. You'll figure out what's actually going on, then build the fix, and look for places where AI can make the process itself work better.
What you'll work on
● Product data. Vendor imports and feeds, our in-house PIM, categorization, images and data quality across a large, inconsistent catalog.
● Inventory and pricing. Feed ingestion (AWS Lambda, S3, SFTP), scrapers for vendors without feeds, and the pricing, deals and cart logic that depend on them.
● The storefront API. We're replacing Shopify with our own Django backend and a React Router storefront. You'll build and test the API endpoints the new site depends on.
● Search. Elasticsearch-backed search, facets and recommendations.
● Internal tools and automation. Find the manual, repetitive work across the business (merchandising, customer service, operations) and replace it with something reliable. Sometimes that's a script or an admin screen. Sometimes it's an LLM-based workflow, if that's the right tool for the problem.
● Infrastructure. We're moving hand-built AWS and Cloudflare resources to OpenTofu. Some exposure here is useful but not required.
How we work
● Tests come first. We write a failing test, then the code. Tests build their own data and assert on exact values. A test that only checks for a 200 response doesn't count.
● Typed, reviewed, small. Python is type-annotated and checked, TypeScript runs in strict mode, and changes go in as small, focused pull requests with one fix per commit.
● Production is careful work. Migrations, data fixes and infrastructure changes get agreed on before they run, and we don't commit secrets.
● We use AI coding assistants every day, and we review everything they produce. We keep written project conventions that the agents follow. We want someone who gets real speed out of these tools and still owns every line that ships, and who can spot when the assistant got it wrong.
What we're looking for
● Strong Python. Django (ORM, migrations, admin) experience is a big plus.
● Solid SQL and PostgreSQL. Comfortable reading query plans and pushing work into the database when it makes sense.
● Experience building and consuming APIs. Django Ninja, Pydantic or OpenAPI is a plus.
● Experience working with messy real-world data: CSV/Excel imports, vendor feeds, scraping, ETL.
● Enough TypeScript/React to work on the storefront when a feature spans both repos.
● Good judgment about when automation (including LLMs) helps and when a plain script or a better process is the right answer.
● Clear written communication. You'll write PR descriptions, docs and tickets that someone else can act on.
Nice to have
● E-commerce experience, especially catalog, PIM, order management or checkout (Stripe).
● Elasticsearch or another major search platform.
● AWS (Lambda, S3, ECS), Cloudflare Workers, OpenTofu/Terraform.
● Experience in furniture, home furnishings or another product-heavy retail business.

Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to join our Buenos Aires office. This is the perfect opportunity for someone who loves talking to people all day, every day; is obsessively organized; and wants hands-on experience in recruitment and people operations within a fast-paced, global environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Ensure a world-class candidate experience from first touchpoint to onboarding.

Establish yourself as a trusted partner and primary point of contact for hiring managers across the organization.
Create clear, compelling job descriptions that effectively market each unique career opportunity.
Build and maintain relationships with industry associations, universities, meetups, and relevant events to strengthen talent pipelines.
Maintain accurate data and workflows in the ATS (Greenhouse) and related tools, ensuring high attention to detail and follow-through.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

The foremost quality for this (or any) position at Blockchain is integrity.
**Previous experience in a similar Talent Acquisition / Recruiting / HR coordination role, with **hands-on experience working with an ATS (ideally Greenhouse)****.
Advanced level of English (written and spoken); ability to communicate confidently with global stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills with a proven track record of prioritization, motivation, and follow-through.
Self-motivated with a high sense of urgency, while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
Flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a dynamic, evolving business.
A charismatic, people-first mindset—you’re approachable, fearless, and excited to help build something meaningful.

COMPENSATION & PERKS

Competitive full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company
This is a role based in our Palermo office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week.
The opportunity to be a key player and build your career at a rapidly expanding, global technology company in an exciting, emerging industry.
Performance-based bonuses
Apple equipment provided by the company
Work from Anywhere Policy: You can work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days per year.

Blockchain is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. Blockchain makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

You may contact our Data Protection Officer by email at dpo@blockchain.com. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment.

Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. Accordingly, if you are located outside of the United States, your personal data will be transferred to the United States once you submit it through this site. Because the European Union Commission has determined that United States data privacy laws do not ensure an adequate level of protection for personal data collected from EU data subjects, the transfer will be subject to appropriate additional safeguards under the standard contractual clauses.

Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. In addition, you may lodge a complaint with an EU supervisory authority.

postings.title: Recruiter
postings.descriptionText:
This is a remote position.

Recruiter

Reports to: HR & Recruiting Manager

Location: Remote (Argentina-based)

Type: Independent Contractor

Compensation: Competitive USD pay

About The Role

As a Recruiter at Shapely, you will play a critical role in sourcing, screening, and hiring top talent for a rapidly growing, mission-driven company. You will partner closely with hiring managers and the HR team to understand hiring needs and build effective recruitment strategies. You will own full-cycle recruiting across a wide range of roles — from healthcare profiles in the United States to corporate positions across multiple business areas globally — directly impacting our ability to scale and deliver better care to patients.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in fast-paced startup environments, loves the hunt, and brings a strategic mindset to every search.

What You'll Do

Own full-cycle recruiting for two main talent streams:
Healthcare profiles in the U.S., including Providers (Physician Assistants and Nurse Practitioners) and Dietitians.
Corporate profiles globally, across areas such as Marketing, Finance, Tech, Operations, and others as the company scales.
Proactively source and attract top talent through diverse channels, including LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, social media, referrals, networking, and direct sourcing.
Screen resumes and conduct virtual interviews to assess candidates' skills, experience, and cultural fit.
Partner with hiring managers to deeply understand hiring needs, define ideal candidate profiles, and design effective recruitment strategies.
Champion and continuously improve the candidate experience from first touchpoint through offer, ensuring alignment with Shapely's values.
Contribute to employer branding efforts across job descriptions, outreach messaging, and candidate communications.
Build and maintain robust candidate pipelines for active and anticipated openings.
In partnership with the HR Manager, maintain accurate and up-to-date reporting on personnel, new hires, and TA KPIs.
Track, analyze, and optimize recruiting metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, funnel conversion, source effectiveness) to improve hiring outcomes.
Bring creative ideas to the table and drive special projects that elevate our talent function.
Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
+3 years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, including hunting, sourcing, screening, and interviewing.
Proven experience recruiting for the U.S. market (required).
Hands-on experience working with multiple sourcing platforms (LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and others).
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken (required).
Strategic mindset: you see beyond the req and think about talent as a long-term lever for the business.
Proactive, self-driven, and creative.
Comfortable (and excited) in fast-moving startup environments where priorities shift and ambiguity is part of the game.
Strong communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

Experience recruiting healthcare profiles in the U.S., such as Providers (Physician Assistants and Nurse Practitioners) and Dietitians.
Experience recruiting corporate profiles across functions like Marketing, Finance, and Tech.
Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruiting analytics tools.
Experience partnering with hiring managers across multiple time zones and cultures.

Benefits

Competitive USD compensation.
100% remote work
PTO
Direct impact on the growth of a fast-scaling, mission-driven company changing how weight loss care is delivered.
A collaborative, low-ego startup culture where your ideas are heard and your ownership is real.
Opportunities for professional growth as the Talent function scales.
Exposure to a wide variety of roles and markets (U.S. healthcare hiring and global corporate hiring).
