postings.title: Analyst, GSS Learning Projects Operations
postings.descriptionText:
Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is now seeking a Analyst, GSS Learning Projects Operations to join our team at WHG Argentina (1701) in Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires.

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of the largest hotel franchise company in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The Role

The Analyst, Learning Projects Operations is responsible for coordinating the operational readiness and day-to-day delivery of Wyndham University learning programs, including primary operational ownership of recurring webinars and virtual learning sessions within a Global Shared Services model.

The role coordinates learning calendars, LMS administration, facilitator readiness, registrations, logistics, learner communication requirements, and cross-functional dependencies to ensure consistent and successful program delivery.

The Analyst monitors operational activity, workload, and program performance metrics, identifies opportunities for continuous improvement, and provides Training Administration coverage during peak periods or as needed for business continuity.

What You’ll Do

- Coordinate operational readiness for assigned learning programs and initiatives, managing calendars, milestones, operational requirements, and cross-functional dependencies to ensure successful delivery, in coordination with Learning Project Management for project-based initiatives.
- Own the end-to-end operational coordination of recurring webinars and virtual learning sessions, including scheduling, facilitator and instructor coordination, session readiness, logistics, and post-session follow-up.
- Coordinate webinar promotion and learner communication requirements in partnership with Learner Engagement, ensuring alignment on audiences, timelines, materials, and approvals.
- Manage day-to-day LMS administration for assigned learning programs, including course setup, registrations/enrollments, learner access, updates, completion tracking, and related troubleshooting.
- Coordinate operational requirements across Training Administration, Learner Engagement, Learning Project Management, facilitators, vendors, and other stakeholders, identifying and escalating risks, logistical dependencies, or potential delivery issues as appropriate.
- Track and report learning operational metrics, including program activity, webinar attendance and participation, learner feedback, workload trends, and other relevant metrics to support visibility and decision-making.
- Identify recurring operational issues and improvement opportunities, recommending actions to enhance efficiency, consistency, and learner experience.
- Maintain and improve operational documentation, guides, and checklists to support process consistency, cross-training, and business continuity.
- Provide Training Administration coverage during peak periods or as needed to support service continuity.

You’ll be successful if you have

- Strong organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple recurring activities and deadlines simultaneously.
- You are comfortable working with learning management systems and managing LMS-related activities accurately and independently.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate and timely execution.
- Ability to coordinate operational requirements across multiple learning programs and stakeholders.
- Strong service orientation and focus on learner experience.
- Ability to identify operational issues, trends, and opportunities for process improvement.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively across Learning & Development teams and cross-functional partners.
- Ability to adapt to changing priorities and provide support during periods of increased workload.
- Strong analytical skills and comfort working with operational data, trackers, and reporting.
- Ability to follow established processes while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency.

Required Qualifications/Experience

- Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience in Learning & Development, learning operations, training administration, program coordination, or related fields.
- 2–4 years of relevant experience in learning operations, training administration, program coordination, or related roles.
- Experience coordinating virtual and/or in-person learning programs, events, or recurring activities.
- Experience supporting learning platforms, LMS environments, learner registrations, or related learning operations.
- Experience managing multiple concurrent operational activities and deadlines.
- Experience working with operational data, reporting, trackers, or process documentation.
- Experience supporting vendors, invoices, or learning program logistics preferred.
- Experience supporting U.S.-based or global teams, or working in a Shared Services environment, strongly preferred.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with LMS, Zoom, Smartsheet, and other learning or tracking platforms preferred.
- Fluency in English (written and verbal) required.

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Job Location: WHG Argentina (1701), Paraguay 1178, 10¡ piso, Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires C1057AAR

Employment Status: Full-time

Employment Disclaimer

In some locations around the world, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts manages hotel properties on behalf of a third party owner. At many of those properties, the Hotel owner is the actual employer, and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts performs recruiting and hiring functions on behalf of the owner. I understand and agree that, by applying through this site, I may be applying for a position with a company other than Wyndham Hotels & Resorts where Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is serving only as the recruiter and will not be my actual employer.

La persona que ocupe el puesto de Administrativo/a en Protecor Médica tendrá a su cargo la elaboración de cotizaciones y la emisión de facturas, remitos y notas de crédito, así como la carga y el seguimiento de pedidos de clientes. Asimismo, será responsable del manejo de proveedores, lo que incluye la solicitud de precios, la gestión de órdenes de compra y el seguimiento de entregas. Requisitos

Aptitudes administrativas: elaboración de cotizaciones, facturación, emisión de remitos, manejo de proveedores y organización de la documentación.

Postulación

postings.title: Billing Operations Associate
postings.descriptionText: About AppDirectBecome a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.About Firstbase, an AppDirect SubsidiaryFirstbase helps companies equip their teams with everything they need to do great work—from computers and furniture to company swag and perks. We give businesses the ability to instantly support employees with the right physical goods, and give employees the flexibility to choose what works for their unique needs. Firstbase is part of AppDirect, a subscription commerce platform that powers millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations selling any product, through any channel, on any device—as a service.About YouThe ITAD Billing Operations Associate will own the financial side of our IT Asset Disposition program, a small, fast-moving team responsible for what happens to hardware at the end of its life, and for the money that comes back when it's resold or recycled. You'll own the final word on whether a settlement is right. Half of that is investigative: a deposit that doesn't match any invoice, a partner file that's quietly missing a hundred devices, revenue a vendor earned months ago that never reached our books. You find it, you prove it, you close it. Increasingly, you won't do that hunting alone. We're building AI agents that work these queues inside ITAD OS, our internal operations platform, pulling partner files apart, matching deposits against revenue, flagging the rows that look wrong, and we're putting the best AI tooling available into this team's hands as fast as it ships. That moves the job up, not away: the agent proposes, you decide. Your value becomes knowing what the right answer should look like, catching the case the agent got confidently wrong, and turning a workflow you've been running by hand into one that runs itself with you supervising it. If you'd rather be the person who automates their own job than the one it gets automated around, this is that seat. This posting is for the finance-focused seat on the team. Alongside your primary ownership, you'll be trained across the rest of our ITAD operations —data destruction documentation, vendor management, shipping and logistics — so the team can cover for one another. Everyone here rotates.The position offers a flexible hybrid schedule: you will work one day per week onsite and four days remote. Compensation includes 15 paid working days (PTO) plus local holidays, comprehensive medical coverage (OSDE Plan 310) for you and your dependents, reimbursement for eligible wellness activities, English lessons, global and local events participation, and much more! What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impactIngest settlement and revenue reports from our resale and recycling partners. Every partner sends a different format, and a real part of the craft is turning messy vendor data into clean, trustworthy records without introducing errors.Reconcile device-level and order-level ITAD revenue against actual bank deposits, and allocate deposits to settlements.Investigate unmatched records, ambiguous serials and variances.Own the end-to-end credit issuance workflow in partnership with Finance.Raise and resolve discrepancies directly with our vendor partners.Own financial reporting for the ITAD program, including revenue and margin, and produce executive-ready summaries that go straight to leadership.Review and ingest Certificates of Destruction and data destruction reports from partners, matching them to the devices they cover.Monitor ITAD action queues, ensuring steps are followed per SOPs and that we're hitting our service level objectives.Support shipment and recycling order workflows with our warehouses and partner facilities: pick lists, ship and receipt dates, and resolving receipt exceptions.Maintain and enrich our internal database of fair market value estimates per device, drawing on secondary market platforms, trade-in partners and historical resale data.Act as a primary point of contact between Operations, Finance, Customer Success and Warehouse teams for ITAD financial workflows.What we’re looking for2–5 years in reconciliation, cash applications, billing, audit, accounts payable/receivable, or financial operations. This is a hands-on execution role.Demonstrated experience finding and resolving discrepancies, not just processing transactions. We'll ask you about a number that didn't tie and what you did about it.Strong Excel / Google Sheets: lookups, pivots, text-to-columns, deduplication, and genuine comfort cleaning up badly formatted exports.Strong spoken and written English. You'll speak and write directly to partners in the US and UK, and to colleagues over Slack. Expect this to be assessed.The judgment to know when something is wrong, and the confidence to escalate rather than force a match.High attention to detail, and the ability to run several parallel workflows without losing track of any of them.Comfortable with structured SOPs, but restless about improving them.(*) Interested candidates should submit their resume in English. Please note that Spanish versions will not be reviewed.About AppDirect:AppDirect is the only end-to-end commerce platform for selling, distributing, and managing cloud-based products and services to succeed in the digital economy. The AppDirect ecosystem connects channels, developers, and customers through its platform to simplify the digital supply chain by enabling the onboarding and sale of products with third-party services, for any channel, on any device, with support. Powering millions of cloud subscriptions worldwide, AppDirect helps organizations, including Jaguar Land Rover, Comcast, ADP, and Deutsche Telekom connect their customers to the solutions they need to reach their full potential in the digital economy.We believe that the unique contributions of all AppDirectors is the driver of our success. To make sure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience we never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.At AppDirect we take privacy very seriously. For more information about our use and handling of personal data from job applicants, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information of our general privacy practices, please see AppDirect Privacy Notice: link: https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice

postings.descriptionText:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources.

Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

About The Job

We are looking for a Sales Support Specialist to join our team in Argentina, providing commercial and operational support to our distribution partners and internal stakeholders across Latin America.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer inquiries, resolving complex and non-standard order-related requests, and ensuring timely and accurate support through our digital platforms.

You will play a key role in supporting our sales channels, improving the customer experience, and strengthening the efficiency of our regional operations.

Key Responsibilities

- Provide order management and commercial support to distributors, integrators, system builders, and other channel partners across Latin America.
- Manage and resolve customer inquiries, tickets, complaints, and non-standard order-related requests, ensuring timely and high-quality responses.
- Support order-related activities, including logistics follow-up, documentation, invoicing inquiries, credit holds, and export control requirements.
- Manage and support the use of Alfa Laval’s e-commerce platforms, including Anytime and other digital tools.
- Provide basic technical and product-related guidance, coordinating with technical specialists when required.
- Support partner registration, platform access, and digital tool onboarding processes.
- Conduct virtual training sessions for distributors and partner order handlers to strengthen their knowledge and use of digital tools.
- Prepare operational reports and monitor service performance to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
- Collaborate closely with Channel Managers, Sales, Finance, Logistics, and other internal stakeholders to ensure effective resolution of customer needs.
- Contribute to a positive customer experience by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, and a continuous improvement mindset.

What you know

- Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineer, Administration, Comex, Logistics, International businesses.
- At least 2 years of experience in order support, customer support, e-commerce operations, sales support, or similar B2B roles.
- Experience handling customer inquiries, support tickets, complaints, and complex operational requests.
- Experience working with CRM systems such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
- Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, digital sales tools, or order management systems.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel.
- Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.
- Fluent Spanish.
- Portuguese proficiency is a plus.
- Previous experience in industrial or multinational environments is desirable.

Who You Are

You are a proactive and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems and delivering high-quality service.

You demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.

You take ownership of challenges, respond with agility, and maintain a results-oriented mindset, even when dealing with complex or non-standard situations.

We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate’s fit for a role. To help us achieve this, we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application, you will be invited to complete the assessment games.

We’re one of the world’s leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 10,000 people and serve over 120 million customers in 26 languages.

We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of growth opportunities, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our global worldwide.

Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, featuring more than 1.38 million In-Play sporting events a year. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe (750,000), we handle over 6 billion HTTP requests daily and process more than 1.5 million bets per hour at peak.

Job Description

As a Legal Administrator, you will keep vital processes running seamlessly behind the scenes while supporting international regulatory compliance.

The Legal team manages compliance frameworks, license obligations, and governance across diverse jurisdictions. Operating across high-growth international markets such as LATAM, this team ensures that documentation, corporate registrations, and regulatory filings adhere strictly to statutory standards.

In this role, you will coordinate critical document workflows, track regulatory submissions, and support cross-functional legal initiatives. Working alongside experienced legal and compliance professionals, you will provide the operational backbone that keeps multi-jurisdictional legal operations organized, precise, and efficient.

Qualifications

- High level of English and fluency in Spanish, both written and spoken.
- Previous legal administrative experience, compliance, or AML.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to work.
- Ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
- Experience supporting legal, compliance or regulated business functions.
- Experience within a highly regulated industry would be beneficial.

Additional Information

- Deliver administrative and operational support across daily legal and compliance workflows.
- Prepare, organize, and maintain legal documentation, contracts, and official correspondence.
- Manage statutory filings and documentation to satisfy ongoing regulatory obligations.
- Track and submit documentation for license renewals, registrations, and official filings.
- Liaise with internal departments to gather essential information for legal and regulatory matters.
- Coordinate approvals, execute signature collections, and monitor end-to-end document workflows.
- Monitor shared departmental mailboxes and address routine inquiries promptly.
- Produce reports, status trackers, and management data to support legal and compliance activities.
- Conduct targeted legal and regulatory research across LATAM jurisdictions.

postings.title: Analista de Operaciones
postings.descriptionText: ¡Hola! Gracias por la curiosidad 👋Nos impulsa la ambición y nos guía una visión audaz. A medida que ampliamos nuestro ecosistema de herramientas y servicios, buscamos un/a Analista de Operaciones con espíritu emprendedor: alguien que se meta en la operación, encuentre lo que no funciona y lo resuelva sin esperar a que se lo pidan. Vas a reportar directamente al Manager de Operaciones.Quiénes SomosZubale es una empresa de tecnología que empodera a los retailers para triunfar en el comercio electrónico (e-commerce). Atendemos a una amplia gama de clientes —desde supermercados, tiendas especializadas y farmacias hasta tiendas departamentales y marcas de moda— en México, Brasil, Chile, Costa Rica, Perú, Colombia y, ahora, Argentina. ¿Cómo lo hacemos? A través de dos productos clave:Flexifleet: Un marketplace de freelancers para realizar tareas de recolección (picking), empaque (packing) y entrega para retailers y agregadores.Consumer Connect: Comercio conversacional impulsado por inteligencia artificial vía WhatsApp para impulsar las ventas y mejorar la experiencia del cliente.Nos apasiona ayudar a marcas, agregadores y retailers a optimizar sus operaciones de e-commerce, reducir costos y aumentar la rentabilidad. Respaldados por más de 70 millones de dólares en capital de riesgo (venture capital), hemos mantenido un crecimiento constante durante los últimos seis años y procesado más de 100 millones de pedidos a través de nuestra plataforma. Hoy atendemos a más de 100 clientes y conectamos a miles de freelancers dentro de nuestra red. Y esto es solo el comienzo. Estamos construyendo un ecosistema rentable y escalable, con la visión de convertirnos en el aliado número uno para el crecimiento del comercio electrónico de los retailers.¿Quién sos?Sos una persona dinámica, con iniciativa y obsesionada con hacer las cosas mejor. Cuando ves un problema, no lo reportás: lo investigás, proponés una solución y la probás. Preferís ver la operación con tus propios ojos antes que leerla en un reporte, te sentís cómodo/a en una tienda en plena hora pico y también frente a una planilla armando el caso para un cambio. Actuás como dueño/a de los resultados y te motiva construir en un entorno que se mueve rápido.¿Qué vas a hacer?En la operaciónVisitar tiendas y puntos de operación con frecuencia para observar procesos, detectar fricciones y entender la realidad del día a día.Trabajar codo a codo con supervisores, shoppers y equipos de cliente para implementar mejoras directamente en campo.Resolver incidencias operativas de principio a fin y convertir cada problema recurrente en un proceso corregido.Proponer e impulsar por iniciativa propia proyectos que reduzcan costos, tiempos o errores en la operación.Estar presente en lanzamientos de nuevos clientes, picos de demanda y fechas críticas (Hot Sale, CyberMonday, Black Friday, campañas estacionales).Procesos y mejora continuaMapear y documentar procesos operativos end-to-end, a partir de lo que ves en campo.Rediseñar flujos para ganar eficiencia y probarlos en la práctica antes de escalarlos.Definir SLAs, controles y mecanismos de seguimiento por proceso, con foco en la experiencia del cliente.Data como herramientaMonitorear métricas operativas para saber dónde intervenir y medir si las mejoras funcionaron.Automatizar reportes y tareas repetitivas para liberar tiempo del equipo (SQL, Python, n8n, Apps Script).Mantener dashboards operativos en Looker.Lo que este rol no esNo es un rol de análisis de escritorio ni de coordinación a distancia. Esperamos que pases una parte importante de tu semana en terreno, que te involucres de lleno en la operación y que ayudes a sacar el trabajo adelante cuando el día lo pide.Lo que vas a aportarOperacionesExperiencia en operaciones de campo, retail, logística o última milla.Experiencia mapeando y rediseñando procesos para hacerlos más eficientes.Espíritu emprendedor: autonomía, sentido de urgencia y ganas de resolver sin esperar instrucciones.Mentalidad lean y comodidad con la ambigüedad.Capacidad de influir y movilizar a otros sin autoridad formal, trabajando con equipos operativos y áreas como Contabilidad, Customer Success y Data Ops.HerramientasGoogle Sheets a nivel avanzado.SQL y Python para análisis de datos.Automatizaciones con n8n o Apps Script (deseable).Formación y experienciaCarrera en Administración, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Estadística o afines.1 a 2 años de experiencia en operaciones, consultoría operativa o roles similares.Experiencia en startups, retail, logística o plataformas digitales (deseable).Inglés intermedio.Lo que ofrecemosModalidad híbrida: 3 días por semana en nuestra oficina de Vicente López y trabajo frecuente en tiendas y puntos de operación.Una cultura de alto rendimiento donde los datos y la calle se complementan.Impacto directo y visible en la operación.Oportunidades de crecimiento en una empresa en expansión.¿Te suena a vos? ¡Postulate y charlemos!

En Dentsu buscamos Tax Assistant:

La posición brindará soporte en el proceso de seguimiento y control de liquidación y presentación de impuestos mensuales y anuales, colaborando en el cumplimiento de las obligaciones fiscales en tiempo y forma, así como en tareas de conciliación y análisis de cuentas impositivas. - Modalidad de trabajo Híbrida: presencial una vez por semana en Belgrano.

- Asistencia en el seguimiento, análisis y control de declaraciones juradas mensuales y anuales de impuestos nacionales, provinciales y municipales (IVA, IIBB, SICORE, ARCIBA, IG, entre otros).

- Seguimiento de comunicaciones de organismos fiscales.
- Colaboración en la actualización de cambios normativos y archivo de documentación impositiva.
- Participación en iniciativas de mejora de procesos y organización de tareas.

- Estudiante avanzado/a o graduado/a reciente de Contador Público.

- Manejo de Excel intermedio.

postings.title: Accounting Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
This is a full-time, remote position from LatAm only.

About The Role

Our client's Large Loss Division is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented National Large Loss Project Accountant to support financial administration, project documentation, billing coordination, and partner franchise management for large commercial restoration projects nationwide.

This position serves as a critical liaison between Project Managers, partner franchises, clients, and the finance team to ensure projects are properly documented, billed accurately, and administered efficiently from emergency response through final invoicing.

Primary Responsibilities

- Review emergency service documentation, T&M records, and final Xactimate estimates for completeness and accuracy
- Coordinate with Project Managers and Finance Team to facilitate timely invoicing and collections
- Assist with project billing, revenue tracking, and financial reporting
- Monitor project documentation to ensure billing compliance and client requirements are met
- Support accounts receivable efforts by tracking outstanding invoices and assisting with payment follow-up
- Manage onboarding of partner franchises, including MOUs, compliance

documentation, and project expectations.

- Evaluate partner franchise capabilities and qualifications for large loss assignments
- Maintain referral and partner tracking systems
- Coordinate with Large Loss Team members during Work-In-Progress and EOS meetings
- Track project milestones, documentation requirements, and deliverables
- Serve as a point of contact for clients regarding project status, documentation requests, and billing inquiries
- Maintain Buildertrend, Xactimate, and other project management systems
- Coordinate employee travel arrangements, including hotels, rental vehicles, and per diem tracking
- Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned

Qualifications

Required:

- Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Construction Management, Finance, or related field; equivalent experience considered
- 3+ years of experience in project administration, project accounting, construction administration, restoration, insurance, or related industries
- Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel

Preferred:

- Experience with Xactimate, Buildertrend, DASH, Encircle, QuickBooks, or Restoration Manager
- Previous experience in restoration, construction, catastrophe response, or insurance claims environments
- Understanding of project billing, job costing, and T&M documentation
- Experience working with multi-location operations or franchise systems

About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Our values and what to expect:

- Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer
- Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated
- Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility
- Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone that interacts with RYZ with respect
- Frugality - being frugal and cost conscious helps us do more with less
- Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way
- Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, our expectations. Status quo is not good enough and never should be

Launch Your Next Successful Chapter with Veta Virtual! 🚀

💸 Competitive Salary in USD | 🌍 100% Remote | 🪙 Crypto & Digital Asset Accounting | 📊 Fintech & Cryptocurrency Industry

Veta Virtual is hiring a Staff Accountant for one of our high-growth clients in the Fintech and Cryptocurrency industry. This is a unique, forward-thinking accounting role built for someone who combines strong foundational accounting skills with a genuine understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain — supporting digital asset accounting, monthly close processes, and financial reporting for one of the world's largest crypto kiosk networks. If you are a detail-oriented accountant who is excited about the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets, this role was made for you.

As a Staff Accountant, you will support the Accounting and Finance team with a focus on cryptocurrency-related transactions, digital asset management, and monthly close processes — playing a key role in ensuring the accuracy of financial data across a global fintech platform operating thousands of kiosks and an OTC trading desk. Your day-to-day will involve:

- Preparing and maintaining monthly rollforwards for BTC, ETH, LTC, and other supported digital assets — ensuring accuracy and completeness across all crypto holdings.
- Reconciling wallet balances to blockchain data and internal subledgers — performing wallet data cleanup, validation, and exception resolution with precision.
- Performing fair market value (FMV) calculations and remeasurements for digital asset holdings — and supporting position checks and proof-of-reserves style reconciliations.
- Processing and accounting for crypto donations, rewards, and incentives — and recording and reconciling hardware wallet activity including Trezor and cold storage.
- Preparing and posting journal entries for month-end close — including balance sheet account reconciliations, flux analysis, and variance explanations.
- Maintaining fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules — and assisting in preparing financial reporting schedules and audit support packages.
- Developing spreadsheet reports, verifying financial information, and reconciling accounts — contributing to a culture of accuracy, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.
- Analyzing current accounting policies and procedures — recommending improvements, contributing to SOP development, and supporting cross-functional teams on accounting processes.

✅ What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.
- At least 2 years of related accounting experience — with hands-on exposure to journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end close processes.
- Working knowledge of cryptocurrency and blockchain fundamentals is required — this role is specifically focused on digital asset accounting and crypto transaction processing.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite — particularly Excel for reconciliations, reporting, and data analysis.
- Experience with NetSuite or a similar ERP system is strongly preferred.
- Excellent organizational skills and sharp attention to detail — you meet deadlines, maintain accuracy under pressure, and never let things slip through the cracks.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills — able to collaborate clearly with cross-functional teams and respond to information requests accurately and promptly.
- Bonus: passion for fintech and the evolving cryptocurrency landscape.
- Bonus: experience with Alteryx, Tableau, or similar data and BI tools.

- To be considered for this role, you must be currently based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.

💼 What We Offer

- 💸 Competitive salary in USD — paid consistently every month, no matter where you are!
- 🌴 10 paid vacation days per year plus all U.S. federal holidays.
- 💻 100% remote — work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe with a professional home setup.
- 🚀 A fast-paced, high-growth environment at the forefront of global fintech and cryptocurrency — where your accounting work directly supports operations across thousands of locations and multiple international markets.
- 🤝 A collaborative, supportive culture through Veta Virtual and our client — where precision, curiosity, and continuous improvement are genuinely valued from day one.

Ready to Apply?

If you are ready to bring your accounting skills into the world of digital assets, support a world-class fintech team, and grow at the cutting edge of cryptocurrency finance — apply now and launch your next chapter with Veta Virtual.

Once you apply, you will be invited to complete a short 2-minute video question as part of our screening process. It is your first opportunity to show us your expertise, your attention to detail, and what makes you the right person for this role. We can't wait to meet you!

postings.descriptionText:
About the job

Cultivar supports passionate CPG Founders in growing their businesses with confidence. We focus on providing financial and strategic guidance tailored to the unique needs of emerging consumer brands. Our team members work closely with Founders to strengthen financial foundations, improve decision-making, and enable sustainable growth.

Location: Remote / Flexible
Report to: Accountant Team Lead
The Mission: Financial Integrity at the Source.

Role Description
We are seeking a highly autonomous and analytical Accountant (Tier 2) to join our growing finance operations team. This role is positioned between a Super Senior Accountant and a Junior Controller, requiring deep technical ownership of the accounting function within a fast-moving, mid-market CPG environment.
This is not a leadership position. The focus is on hands-on execution and system ownership. We need a technical expert who does not just process transactions but understands the underlying logic of how systems connect, how inventory impacts margins, and how to proactively improve workflows. At Cultivar, we believe that structure creates freedom.

What You'll Do:

Financial Production & Ownership

- Full-Cycle Accounting: Own the complete accounting cycle within QuickBooks Online, ensuring the production of accurate and timely monthly financial statements.
- Balance Sheet Integrity: Manage bank feeds and reconcile all balance sheet accounts with absolute precision.
- Clearing Account Governance: Investigate and resolve discrepancies in complex clearing accounts, including Point-of-Sale, payroll, and bill pay integrations.

Inventory & Systems Integration

- Inventory Reconciliation: Reconcile inventory valuation reports against operational and warehouse data (IMS tools) to ensure alignment between physical stock and financial reporting.
- System Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve negative inventory, sync errors, or integration mismatches from platforms like Shopify, Amazon, and A2X.
- Root Cause Analysis: Resolve discrepancies at the source. We value fixing the underlying data or integration issue over masking problems with manual journal entries.

Process Optimization

- Workflow Standardization: Continuously improve the month-end close process by identifying inefficiencies and building stronger reconciliation workflows.
- Technical Troubleshooting: Independently navigate complex accounting hurdles, acting as a functional owner who can move from "chaos" to "order" without constant supervision.

Must-Have Requirements

- Experience: 4–7+ years of accounting experience with a proven ability to produce full, audit-ready financial statements.
- Software Mastery: Expert-level hands-on proficiency in QuickBooks Online, including advanced bank feed and clearing account logic.
- CPG & Inventory Background: Demonstrated experience in manufacturing, food & beverage, or inventory-heavy environments.
- Technical Toolset: Experience reconciling Shopify sales and working with tools such as A2X, Cin7, or similar Inventory Management Systems (IMS).
- Communication: Technical capability and a growth mindset are prioritized; while English proficiency is required, we value technical accuracy over linguistic fluency.

Technical Knowledge Deep-Dive

- Inventory & COGS Analysis: Deep understanding of how physical movement impacts the P&L and Balance Sheet.
- Integration Logic: Understanding the "plumbing" between Shopify, A2X, and QBO.
- Troubleshooting Mindset: The ability to see an out-of-balance account as a puzzle to be solved at the root, not a number to be adjusted.

Success Metrics (KPIs)

- Karbon Timeliness: Meeting all delivery milestones within the assigned deadlines.
- Xenett Accuracy Scores: Maintaining high data integrity and zero-defect reporting.
- Capacity Efficiency: Consistently delivering high-quality work within the budgeted hours.

Why This Role Matters

- Mission-Critical Execution: You provide the clean data that allows our leads to provide strategic insights to Founders.
- Autonomy: You have the freedom to own your process and the responsibility to ensure it is bulletproof.

postings.title: Senior Accountant | Climate Tech & Energy Transition Startups (AR)
postings.descriptionText:
Summary

- Role: Accounting and finance ops for a portfolio of venture-backed climate tech companies.
- Preferred experience: 4–10 years, including time at a leading national or regional accounting firm
- Location: Remote — US or LATAM (working hours that overlap with US time zones)
- Expected start: Dec '26 or Jan '27

Overview
Planetary Scale partners with climate and energy-transition companies as their strategic finance arm, working alongside founders from seed through growth. We help them refine their business model, raise venture funding, manage their finances and get through the hardest moments on the path to scale.

For many of these companies, we also maintain their books, prepare financial reports, and handle day-to-day finance work like paying bills, invoicing customers and running payroll. Founders rely on us to get the numbers right and make sure everyone gets paid on time. That side of our work is growing, and we're hiring a Senior Accountant to take on a group of clients and work closely with the rest of our team to provide world-class finance function support.

The Role
You'll run the accounting and day-to-day finance work for several client companies at once, alongside a peer accountant who looks after a separate set of clients. For each company, you'll work with our engagement lead who owns the relationship, and often with the founder and their team directly. Our clients primarily use QuickBooks Online or Xero, plus bank, bill-pay and payroll tools. We also have a set of internally developed tools to make the monthly close process flow smoothly and help to share context across our accounting and strategic finance work.

You'll be in real client work from your first week, paired with experienced teammates while you learn each company's financial picture and the nuances of working with early-stage companies that are commercializing complex new technologies.

- You'll own the month-end close for each of your companies: reconciliations, accruals, prepaid and fixed-asset schedules, and financial statements you've reviewed yourself before they reach the engagement lead and the founder.
- Where a company relies on us for its payables and receivables, you'll run them, including bill-pay runs in tools like Bill.com and Brex, as well as invoicing and collections, so vendors are paid on time and cash comes in when it should.
- For some clients, you'll also run payroll and take care of occasional filings like Delaware Franchise Tax, state sales tax returns or year-end 1099s.
- You will figure out and apply the correct accounting treatment for various revenue recognition scenarios, government grants, venture debt and multi-currency transfer pricing. You'll need good judgement on when to ask others for help.
- You'll support audits and investor diligence, preparing schedules and answering auditors' and investors' questions so the founder can focus on running the company. At year end, you'll prepare each company's package for its outside tax preparer.
- You'll help make our close faster and more consistent across clients, noticing where a checklist, template or automation would save the team time.

About You
You hold yourself to a high standard — and you want to work somewhere that does the same. A few things that matter here:

- Accuracy is your baseline. Founders, their boards and their investors make decisions from the numbers you close, and a wrong one can undermine a founder's credibility at the worst possible moment. You tie out every balance before you call a month closed, and you'd rather catch your own mistake than have a founder find it.
- You dig in, and you ask when you're not sure. When a balance won't reconcile or a transaction looks off, you trace it back to its source and find out why. If you're unsure how something should be treated, you ask before you book it.
- You're a good teammate. You'll work alongside a peer accountant and each client's engagement lead. You keep them up to date, leave workpapers anyone could follow, and help out when someone else is stretched.
- You aspire to be great at what you do. You put in the time to sharpen your technical skills, including the less common topics our clients run into, like grants and venture debt. When part of the close is slow or easy to get wrong, you build a better way of doing it.
- You take ownership before you're asked. When something needs doing, you do it. If you see the wrong info being communicated, you jump in to fix it before it becomes a bigger issue. At a firm this size, if you assume something is someone else's job, it usually doesn't get done.

Beyond that, for this role specifically:

- You learned the craft at a leading accounting firm. You've spent time at a leading national or regional accounting firm, in audit, assurance or client accounting, and you've owned a close from start to finish. You know US GAAP well enough to handle accruals, fixed assets and revenue recognition with confidence, and you're hands-on in QuickBooks Online or Xero.
- You're a CPA, or hold your country's equivalent qualification. It's what we generally expect. If you don't hold one yet but you're exceptional in every other way, we'd still like to hear from you.
- You communicate clearly in English and work US hours. Our clients and most of our team are in the US, so professional written and spoken English is a must, and so are working hours that overlap fully with at least one US time zone.
- You care about this work specifically. Climate and the energy transition matter to you, and you want your accounting to support the companies building a better future.

It helps a lot if you've also worked inside a venture- or private-equity-backed company, or at an outsourced accounting firm that serves them. Beyond that, experience with sales tax, payroll or year-end tax work, or with a company's first audit, is a plus.

What makes this different

- Working directly with founders. You'll work with people building some of the most consequential companies in climate and energy — exposure and ownership that typically takes far longer to reach at a larger firm.
- A steep curve and a supportive team. Hands-on work alongside experienced team members, frequent and direct feedback, and real client exposure from day one. We hold a high bar and invest seriously in getting you there.
- Something new every week. We work with a diverse set of high growth companies bringing novel technologies to market. You will learn about many different markets, verticals and business models and get exposure to a wide range of interesting accounting and finance topics.

We're fully remote with team members in the US, Colombia, Poland and the Philippines. Our offer includes performance bonus, client equity exposure and 30 days of PTO.

EEO
Planetary Scale is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates on their merits and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.

Produce daily and month-end reporting; support month-end close end-to-end. Comfortable working across multiple bank accounts and foreign-currency payments. Strong attention to detail and the discipline to perform high-volume, recurring work accurately every day. Comfortable with reporting and tech-savvy including using AI and automation tools to streamline workflows. Excellent English (written and spoken), for working with internal stakeholders. We are looking for an analytical, details-driven professional who seamlessly balances technical accuracy with clear, empathetic communication. If you are as confident navigating NetSuite spreadsheets as you are demystifying complex billing inquiries for sellers and buyers, this is the place for you.

What You Will Do

- Address Customer Experience support tickets related to payments, invoicing, and refunds
- Monitor customer accounts and assist with the application of cash receipts, incoming Wire and ACH payments, and reconciliation of discrepancies
- Preparing daily/monthly journal entries in the ERP system for Cash and A/R transactions
- Processing Sales Team Requests, Refunds, Credits, Rate adjustments, and other one-off payment issues in Admin, NetSuite and Avalara
- Identify opportunities to streamline and enhance automation across key accounts payable and accounts receivable workflows, contributing to process efficiency and scalability, creating and updating accounting policy memos and process flowcharts
- Sales Tax Exemption maintenance and refund processing in Avalara
- Serve as a point of contact for key sellers, delivering proactive updates on sales proceeds and payout schedules

What We Are Looking For

- +3 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Bookkeeping, Customer Support or related finance support roles
- Familiarity with basic accounting principles and ERP systems (NetSuite or Oracle Fusion)
- Proven experience working with Salesforce (CRM/billing workflows) is required
- Strong Excel skills and attention to detail in data entry and transaction processing
- Excellent communication and organizational skills
- Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Our values and what to expect:

- Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer
- Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated
- Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility
- Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone that interacts with RYZ with respect
- Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less
- Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way
- Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, our expectations. Status quo is not good enough and never should be

Lien Files

Accounting & Bookkeeping

- Advanced or strong Excel skills.

- Exceptional attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Strong written English and professional communication skills.
- Highly organized with strong follow-up and time-management skills.
- Ability to handle confidential financial and client information.

Personal Injury law firm experience is preferred.

Experience With Claude Or Similar AI Tools Is Preferred.

Bring your recruiting expertise to a role where you’ll help connect high-caliber talent with opportunities at Worldwide while creating a consistent, high-quality candidate experience. What You'll Do

- Lead recruiting programs and manage vacancies through sourcing, screening, selection, and appointment.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

Workplace Type: Hybrid

Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.

Cerro Negro is a high-grade gold mining complex located in Argentina's Patagonia region, in the province of Santa Cruz. It consists of multiple underground mines and deposits spread across a large area of the region. Because the operation is located approximately two hours by road from the nearest town, our workforce lives on site and works on rotational schedules.

Life at Cerro Negro takes place in a modern, well-equipped camp where safety, camaraderie, and teamwork are fundamental pillars of our daily activities. This commitment is also reflected in our focus on innovation. In 2022, Cerro Negro became the first underground mine in Argentina to implement remote-operated mining, significantly improving safety and efficiency. This achievement is a clear example of our culture of continuous improvement.

Our team is committed to responsible mining and to supporting the development of communities in this sparsely populated region. Working at Cerro Negro offers the opportunity to be part of a pioneering team in a unique environment, advance your professional development, and contribute to Newmont’s goal of creating sustainable value for the province of Santa Cruz.

Your Contribution

Help foster a respectful, inclusive, and compliant workplace by conducting workplace investigations and supporting employee relations processes across Newmont Argentina. In this role, you will independently gather facts, analyze information, and partner with key stakeholders to address workplace concerns fairly and professionally.

As Part of Our Team, You Will

- Conduct workplace investigations related to employee concerns, harassment, discrimination, bullying, sexual harassment, retaliation and other behavioral misconduct matters.
- Gather and assess information through interviews, documentation reviews, and fact-finding activities.
- Partner with employees, leaders, HR, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders throughout the investigation process.
- Prepare clear investigation reports, findings, and recommendations.
- Maintain accurate and confidential case records.
- Support the implementation of employee relations, compliance, and workplace conduct programs.
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adjusting priorities to meet evolving business needs.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, and employee awareness.
- Provide guidance on corrective actions and help promote a respectful workplace culture.

Prerequisites for your success in this role

- Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Employee Relations, Business, Law, Psychology, or a related field.
- Experience conducting workplace investigations, employee relations reviews, compliance reviews, or similar case management activities.
- Experience with investigation methods, interviewing techniques, and case documentation practices.
- Workplace investigation certification is considered an asset.
- Strong critical thinking and ability to analyze information objectively.
- Ability to navigate sensitive conversations with professionalism, discretion, and empathy.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and case management or compliance systems.
- Ability to build positive relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Fluent in English and Spanish.

Your work environment

- You will work closely with employees, leaders, Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and other internal and external stakeholders. This role requires handling sensitive and confidential matters while helping create a safe, respectful, and inclusive workplace for everyone.
- Work Location: Buenos Aires Office
- Work schedule: Hybrid

Why Join Newmont

At Newmont, you'll be part of a values-driven organization committed to safety, integrity, inclusion, and sustainability. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting fair workplace practices, promoting respectful behaviors, and helping build a culture where everyone can succeed.

At Cerro Negro, we value the well-being, development, and recognition of the people who are part of our team. That is why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees and their families. This includes medical coverage, recognition programmes for performance and outstanding contributions, as well as fair and competitive salary reviews, aligned with our commitment to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent.

At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining.

Learn more about our purpose and values: About Newmont

Hear from our people: Life at Newmont

Important: Newmont does not ask candidates to pay money or share sensitive personal data outside our secure application process. If this happens, please report it to our Business Integrity team: it.sec@newmont.com.

postings.descriptionText:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

The role

You’ll run full-cycle recruiting for our LATAM teams, with a focus on customer-facing roles like Customer Support and Onboarding. You’ll own the process from intake to signed offer: sourcing, screening, managing hiring managers, and making sure every candidate has a great experience. You’ll work closely with our recruiting team and with hiring managers, and you’ll have real influence on how we hire in the region.

What you’ll do

- Run full-cycle searches end to end, from intake through offer and close
- Source proactively across LinkedIn, local job boards, communities, and referrals. Don’t wait for applicants.
- Run high-quality recruiter screens and give hiring managers clear, honest recommendations
- Partner with hiring managers to set expectations, calibrate on the bar, and keep searches moving
- Keep Ashby clean, and use pipeline data to flag risks and bottlenecks early
- Build market knowledge across LATAM: talent pools, compensation, and what works in each market
- Help improve our process, from outreach and screening to candidate experience

What we’re looking for

- 3-5 years of recruiting experience, agency or in-house, with full-cycle ownership
- Experience hiring in Latin America
- Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken.
- Strong sourcing instincts and comfort running high-volume and niche searches at the same time
- Sound judgment on candidates and the ability to give hiring managers direct, data-backed advice
- Organized and fast, with a bias toward action and clear communication
- Comfortable working async and across time zones, with overlap with US hours

Big plus

- Experience recruiting for Customer Experience roles (Support, Onboarding, Success, or similar), especially at scale
- Experience at a startup or high-growth company
- Experience with Ashby or a comparable modern ATS

Pay And Benefits

The estimated base salary range for this role is $50,000-$60,000 USD converted to your local currency. Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, a remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO, and extra fun perks.

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

Job title: Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist

Type: Full-time
Schedule: Monday–Friday
Working Hours: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Pacific Time / 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time
Work Environment: Remote

About the Role
Talent Global is looking for a sharp, fast-moving, and highly proactive In-House Recruiter to help identify, evaluate, and present exceptional talent for our clients.

This role is ideal for someone who can quickly understand different types of positions—from digital marketing and creative roles to sales, operations, and other specialized functions—and translate those requirements into an effective recruiting and interview strategy.

We want someone who thinks quickly, adapts easily, asks the right questions, and takes ownership of finding strong candidates.

Speed matters in this role. The right person will be able to work with urgency while maintaining a high standard for the talent selection process, communication, and candidate evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct Interviews: Perform structured Zoom interviews daily to evaluate candidates’ experience, communication skills, technical capabilities, professionalism, and overall fit for roles across Marketing, Design, Sales, Operations, and other functions.
- Evaluate Candidates: Review applications, resumes, work samples, and portfolios to determine whether candidates meet client expectations. This includes evaluating graphic design and advertising portfolios when relevant.
- Understand New Roles Quickly: Rapidly learn the responsibilities, terminology, required skills, and performance expectations of unfamiliar positions before beginning candidate evaluation.
- Maintain a High Talent Bar: Identify strong candidates rather than simply candidates who meet minimum requirements. Exercise sound judgment around experience, communication, problem-solving ability, professionalism, and overall quality.
- Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with account managers and talent sourcers to understand client hiring requirements, priorities, feedback, and changes in recruiting strategy.
- Present Candidates: Prepare clear, professional, and accurate candidate summaries and evaluations for shortlisted candidates presented to clients.
- Manage the Talent Pipeline: Build and maintain a strong pool of pre-vetted professionals for recurring client needs and frequently requested positions.
- Maintain CRM & Documentation: Keep candidate records, interview notes, evaluations, compensation expectations, and recruiting activity accurate and up to date in internal systems.
- Develop Interviews & Assessments: Create role-specific interview questions, scorecards, assignments, and assessments that accurately measure candidates’ capabilities.
- Stay Market-Informed: Continuously learn about trends, terminology, tools, compensation, and expectations across digital marketing, creative, sales, and other commonly recruited functions.
- Contractor Follow-Up: Check in with placed contractors after hiring to support onboarding, identify issues early, and help maintain successful placements.
- Negotiate Rates: Discuss compensation expectations with candidates and negotiate rates within client budgets while protecting both candidate quality and company margins.
- Improve Recruiting Operations: Help improve internal recruiting systems, assessment scoring, reporting, data visualization, and workflow efficiency through automation using AI, Make.com, and related tools.
- Work Independently & Collaboratively: Manage responsibilities independently while maintaining fast, clear communication with talent sourcers, account managers, and the sales team.

What We Are Looking For
The ideal candidate is:

- Fast-moving: Works with urgency and maintains strong output without needing constant follow-up.

The goal is to find strong talent quickly, evaluate them accurately, and maintain a consistently high hiring standard.

Moving forward together

We’re focused on developing the leaders who will support us in building a better working world, and you’ll have the opportunity to influence the change of our programs and development of our people.

The opportunity

Talent has seen a significant investment and growth in our people, and you’ll see that reflected in this role. You’ll develop relationships and team with our leaders, influencing decisions in a culture that recognizes and builds on successes. Our leaders will look to you to provide guidance and solutions on employee relations while driving our talent agenda forward to meet our business strategy. You can expect to be part of a world-class team, where creative thought and innovative ideas are cherished.

Your Key Responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for coordinating and facilitating human resources activities for a specific population. Working closely with other Talent team members, you’ll implement, execute and influence innovative HR programs and processes in line with our Talent agenda, including performance management, compensation and career development. You’ll address and resolve a wide range of employee inquiries and provide guidance to our business leaders. You’ll also be responsible for collecting and analyzing data related to staffing, headcount, budgets and compensation to identify trends and make appropriate recommendations.

Skills And Attributes For Success

- A proven ability to manage a diverse portfolio of projects
- Working knowledge of HR laws and practices
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to influence leaders around new programs and change

To qualify for the role, you must have

- A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
- Five-plus years of relevant experience with working knowledge of United States Labor Laws
- Proficiency in MS Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
- Strong command of English Language (written and oral)
- Cross boarder working knowledge
- Financial Services knowledge (ex. Banking, Capital Markets, Insurance and/or Wealth Management)

Ideally, you’ll also have

- Society for Human Resource Management certification
- Experience working within a professional services industry or complex matrixed environment

What We Look For

We’re interested in influencers with a broad and extensive knowledge of HR processes. You’ll need to be comfortable questioning ideas, processes and senior colleagues — all while overseeing multiple projects or employee issues. If you have a genuine passion for talent management and the confidence to take on new responsibilities proactively to stay ahead of demand, this role is for you.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

postings.title: Regional HR Manager - AMER
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1300+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Regional HR Manager at Canonical to support our AMER region.

With colleagues across 75+ countries, we require a People function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a regional lead that will report into our Global Head of HR who can help build our company as we go through continued growth plans. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. You will lead the Americas team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with senior leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.

The role entails the individual to:

- Lead and scale Canonical’s regional HR team
- Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy
- Interact closely with the broader People team to create tight-knit processes across all regions
- Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive high performing teams
- Work with senior managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
- Own as well as coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues, across multiple countries
- Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
- Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
- Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
- Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
- Present at Canonical events to articulate Canonical’s HR practices

What We Are Looking For In You

- Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
- HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
- People management experience
- Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
- A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines too
- Experience in working in a remote first organization
- Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
- Knowledge and practical implementation of HR practices and employment law across the Americas region
- Experience in handling and overseeing complex ER matters across multiple jurisdictions
- Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
- Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded, enthusiastic and energetic
- Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have Skills

- Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
- Professional HR qualification (SHRM or other)
- Facilitation skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
- Annual compensation review
- Recognition rewards
- Annual holiday leave
- Maternity and paternity leave
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
- Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
