Supervising Associate Talent Team Coordinator

Talent Enablement Center | Supervising Associate

Opening paragraph

The Supervising Associate Talent Team Coordinator is an experienced HR operations professional who partners with Talent Consultants and Talent leadership to coordinate employee life-cycle activities, guide team members, and strengthen consistent, high-quality service delivery.

The opportunity

As a Supervising Associate Talent Team Coordinator, you will combine hands-on operational expertise with team support. You will support complex Talent activities, coach coordinators, oversee quality and service delivery, and help improve processes, controls, tools, and the client experience.

ROLE FOCUS Operational excellence, client service, quality, development, and continuous improvement

Your key responsibilities

- Operational support to Talent Team Coordinators, including setting priorities, monitoring workloads, reinforcing established procedures, and helping the team meet service expectations.
- Coordinate the administration of employee life-cycle and Talent processes, which may include performance management, promotions, variable pay, orientation, people surveys, upward feedback, separations, and other assigned programs.
- Coach team members in real time, provide ongoing feedback, support development planning, and serve as a trusted resource for questions, escalations, and complex or non-standard requests.
- Lead or support onboarding and training for new hires, including scheduling, documentation, process education, system readiness, and consistent integration into the team.
- Conduct or support in-person candidate interviews and assess communication skills, professional presence, and alignment with role requirements and team culture.
- Oversee the timely and accurate completion of transactions, documentation, system updates, and tracking activities, including work performed in SuccessFactors and other firm tools.
- Interface with employees, Talent Consultants, Talent leadership, and partner teams; resolve routine and moderately complex inquiries and escalate higher-risk matters with relevant context and recommended next steps.
- Use metrics, quality reviews, trend information, and client feedback to identify service risks and recommend improvements to workflows, controls, documentation, and customer experience.
- Create and maintain workstream procedures, job aids, and training materials; promote consistent application of firm policies, confidentiality requirements, and data-handling practices.
- Support local administrative counseling processes, including feedback collection, documentation, system updates, and summary reporting to appropriate leadership.
- Lead or contribute to special projects, process improvements, and technology or automation initiatives that strengthen operational efficiency and service delivery.

Skills and attributes for success

How your skills and experience will make an impact:

- Strong client-service orientation with the judgment to balance responsiveness, consistency, confidentiality, and policy requirements.
- Ability to lead through influence, coach others, build trust, and maintain effective working relationships across a matrixed organization.
- Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions.
- Strong organization and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests, deadlines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.
- Clear written, verbal, presentation, and listening skills, including the confidence to communicate with Talent leadership and key client contacts.
- Ability to work independently with limited supervision while knowing when to consult or escalate.

To qualify for the role, you must demonstrate

- Five or more years of progressive experience in human resources operations, shared services, Talent coordination, or a related field.
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and common case-management, tracking, and HR systems.
- Broad working knowledge of HR policies, procedures, employee life-cycle processes, and the importance of safeguarding confidential information.
- Demonstrated experience training, mentoring, coordinating, or providing day-to-day direction to less experienced colleagues.
- Ability to work flexibly across time zones and during peak business periods, as needed.

Ideally, you'll also have

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
- Experience in a professional services or large, matrixed organization.
- Experience supporting process improvement, automation, quality assurance, or service-level reporting.

What working at EY offers

This role provides broad exposure to Talent operations and the opportunity to strengthen team capability, improve the employee and client experience, and build trusted relationships across the Talent organization. The role offers meaningful leadership experience while continuing to develop operational, technology, communication, and people-development skills.

About EY

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. Join us in building a better working world.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building people systems from the ground up in a startup environment.

Responsibilities:

- Own salary negotiations with incoming hires and run smooth, full-cycle onboarding, including clear and accurate contracts
- Manage a mixed workforce of employees and contractors, both in the US and internationally, and research the tax and legal requirements when hiring in a new US state or country
- Lead leadership and professional development initiatives that help coaches and consultants keep growing in their roles
- Lead capacity planning across the organization, forecasting hiring needs and confirming budget alignment before roles open
- Own performance planning across the organization, setting clear KPIs and goals that align each team with company priorities, and run regular performance reviews
- Mediate and resolve conflicts between team members and managers, finding fair solutions that keep working relationships strong
- Serve as a trusted, approachable resource for the team, helping people work through workplace challenges with a coaching mindset

- Support leadership with day-to-day HR needs while keeping a warm, relationship-first culture in a fully remote team

- 10+ years of experience in HR or People Operations
- Strong verbal and written English. C1 equivalent

- Working knowledge of employee vs. contractor classification, including international hires and multi-state US employment considerations
- Experience with Gusto
- Experience building people processes such as performance reviews, onboarding programs, or learning and development initiatives
- A warm, people-first communication style, with the ability to act as a coach and advocate rather than a compliance enforcer
- Comfortable with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
- Strong conflict resolution skills, including mediating issues between employees and managers
- Experience with capacity or workforce planning across an organization
- Experience designing performance management frameworks, including setting KPIs and goals across teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a small business or startup that grew from roughly 8 to 40 or 50 employees
- Experience with Asana and Airtable
- Experience supporting coaching, consulting, or other client services teams
- Familiarity with using AI tools to build presentations and streamline people processes

Benefits

- Compensation: $4,000 to $4,500 USD per month, depending on experience
- Schedule: Full-time, EST business hours
- Location: Fully remote from Latin America or the Caribbean
- We only accept CVs submitted in English**

postings.title: People Operations Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
HarZa is a remote-first team that has scaled e-commerce brands from 0 to 7 and 9 figures in health and wellness. We are 150+ people across 15+ countries, and we are now building the Oralux team.

This role exists to keep our people engine running on cadence. You will take recruiting coordination, onboarding, records, follow-ups and engagement programs off the plate of our Head of People & Compliance and turn them into a reliable, documented routine. But this is not an admin seat. We want someone who brings energy to a remote team, turns ideas into real initiatives, and keeps them alive after launch.

What You Will Own

- Engagement and culture. Run our engagement programs end to end: book club, wellness challenges, #momentum and recognition programs. Reminders, participation tracking, prize fulfillment, and fresh ideas that keep a distributed team connected. Success is measured by participation and by programs that keep running after month one instead of fading
- Onboarding that is complete on day one. Before every start date, new hires have their information collected, accounts requested and confirmed, onboarding call booked, and their manager and trainer looped in. Nobody waits on access or chases us for first steps
- Recruiting coordination without gaps. Every applicant gets a response, every CV reaches Talent Acquisition, and every interview and onboarding call is scheduled without back and forth. No candidate waits more than 48 hours to hear from us
- Offers and contractor agreements. Draft from approved templates, send, track to signature, file and log. Non-standard terms go to the Head of People & Compliance before anything is accepted
- The monthly 1:1 cycle. Build and assign check-in tasks, send reminders, and follow up until the cycle closes. Target: 100% completion by the deadline
- HRIS as the single source of truth. Workable reflects every joiner, leaver, title, manager and entity change within two business days
- First-line employee relations. Handle routine questions and attendance follow-ups, document everything, and escalate anything complex or sensitive the same day
- Function support. All-Hands presenter input, SaaS invoice routing to Finance, employment verifications, and support on LinkedIn and employer brand content

Within 90 days, the Head of People & Compliance no longer sends check-in reminders, chases signatures or answers onboarding logistics questions. When something is stuck, you bring the status and a proposed next step, not just the problem.

Requirements

- 2 to 4 years in People Operations, HR coordination, recruiting coordination or employee experience, where you owned a process end to end (onboarding, scheduling, records, engagement) and kept it accurate
- Startup or scale-up experience (e-commerce, DTC, SaaS, tech, HR tech). You are used to moving fast, building as you go, and working without a manual
- Proof that you have launched people initiatives yourself: an engagement program, a recognition ritual, a culture event, an onboarding improvement. Not just supported someone else's
- Experience supporting a team of 50+ people, ideally remote and across countries, with many requests running in parallel
- Proactive and creative: you spot what is missing, propose it, and execute it. Organized enough to close every loop on time
- Clear, warm written communication and the persistence to follow up with senior people on deadlines, politely
- Discretion with personal and sensitive data, and the judgment to know when to handle something and when to escalate
- Comfortable learning tools fast: ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Workable
- Fluent English. Spanish is a plus
- Availability to overlap with our collaboration window, 8am to 12pm EST, Monday to Friday

Payroll Experience Is Not Required.

How we hire: a combined Discovery Call and Core Values conversation with Talent Acquisition, then an interview with the Head of People & Compliance.

Benefits

- Performance bonuses
- Paid time off
- Sick leave
- Maternity and paternity leave

postings.title: Specialist, GSS Learning Projects
postings.descriptionText: Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is now seeking a Specialist, GSS Learning Projects to join our team at WHR Argentina in Buenos Aires, Argentina.Why Wyndham?By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of the largest hotel franchise company in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!The RoleThe Specialist independently manages assigned learning projects of varying complexity from initiation through implementation, with primary ownership of medium-complexity initiatives. Serve as the primary project contact for assigned initiatives, coordinating with business stakeholders and cross-functional partners to support alignment, approvals, and execution. Lead project coordination activities, including project meetings, action tracking, stakeholder follow-up, and communication of key decisions and dependencies. Track the readiness of learning materials and coordinate required reviews and approvals with Legal, Communications, and other applicable stakeholders to support project timelines and implementation readiness. Define and coordinate project-specific learner engagement and communication requirements in partnership with Learner Engagement, ensuring audiences, timelines, channels, dependencies, approvals, and required deliverables are clearly established and documented. Identify and communicate learner-facing and operational impacts to ensure Learner Engagement, Learning Operations, Training Administration are prepared for project launches and related learning activities. Provide project health, workload and risk visibility; escalate strategic decisions, major scope changes and capacity implications. You’ll be successful if you haveStrong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective cross-functional relationships. Ability to independently manage multiple learning projects of varying complexity in a fast-paced environment, with demonstrated capability to lead medium-complexity initiatives. Ability to translate complex project information into clear, actionable plans and communications for different audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate risks, dependencies, and potential delivery challenges. Ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate alignment, and drive accountability without direct authority. Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and execution excellence. Ability to navigate changing priorities and balance project demands within a broader learning portfolio. Required Qualifications/ExperienceBachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience in Learning & Development, project management, or related fields. 4+ years of relevant experience, including demonstrated experience independently managing projects or initiatives of moderate complexity. Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, deliverables, reviews, and approvals to support successful project execution. Experience translating business or project requirements into actionable plans for delivery teams. Experience identifying project risks and dependencies, coordinating mitigation actions, and escalating significant issues appropriately. Experience supporting learning initiatives and/or working within Learning & Development strongly preferred. Experience supporting U.S.-based or global teams, or working in a Shared Services environment, strongly preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management/tracking tools; experience with Smartsheet preferred. Fluency in English (written and verbal) required. Company OverviewWyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.Job Location: WHR Argentina, Maipu 1300 piso 18, Buenos Aires, Argentina C1006ACTEmployment Status: Full-timeEmployment DisclaimerIn some locations around the world, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts manages hotel properties on behalf of a third party owner. postings.title: Senior Manager Digital Adoption & Enablement
postings.descriptionText:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What The Digital Adoption & Enablement Senior Manager does at Worldwide

This person sits within the Global Organizational Learning & Development Team (GOLD), reporting into the People Strategy & Culture function. This role leads enterprise digital adoption, systems learning, and workforce enablement across in-scope corporate systems, while directly managing two Organizational Learning Advisors, Enterprise Systems.

The role oversees adoption strategy for platforms including Medidata, Certinia, LMS, Workday, Percipio, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams Rooms, Zoom, and other systems as assigned. It ensures implementations, releases, enhancements, new modules, new hire needs, refresher training, remediation, and sustainment are supported by role-based learning, performance support, stakeholder communications, LMS-integrated training, adoption metrics, and continuous improvement. Functional teams retain ownership of technical deployment, configuration, validation, security, compliance programs, and business outcomes; this role leads the learning and adoption strategy required to help employees use systems effectively and consistently.

What You Will Do

- Lead enterprise digital adoption and systems enablement strategy across Medidata, Certinia, LMS, Workday, Percipio, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams Rooms, Zoom, and other assigned systems, including governance, intake, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, annual planning, and KPI re-baselining.
- Manage Organizational Learning Advisors, Enterprise Systems, including coaching, feedback, goal setting, performance management, development planning, capacity planning, workload prioritization, and quality oversight.
- Establish consistent standards, templates, and operating practices for systems learning, including needs analysis, audience confirmation, learning objectives, curricula, assessments, LMS publishing, communications, approvals, release readiness, and sustainment planning.
- Oversee learning and enablement plans for system implementations, releases, enhancements, new modules, new hire training, refresher training, remediation, and adoption campaigns, ensuring alignment to go-live dates, release milestones, validated-system needs, financial controls, role-based workflows, and business adoption goals.
- Guide the development of role-based learning journeys, job aids, quick reference guides, instructor-led and virtual sessions, videos, eLearning, office hours, workshops, embedded guidance, and other performance support resources.
- Serve as the senior learning advisor and escalation point to determine whether stakeholder needs require training, communication, process clarification, system support, access guidance, remediation, or a combined solution.
- Partner with EPMO, IT, Clinical Systems, Finance, Project Operations, HRIS, QA/compliance, system owners, process owners, SMEs, Corporate Communications, instructional designers, LMS administrators, and business leaders to scope needs, validate readiness, coordinate approvals, and reverse-plan from go-live or release milestones.
- Ensure enablement coverage for Medidata and Certinia, including Medidata CTMS, Clinical Data Studio/CDMP, Rave Study Conduct/EDC, eTMF/RCM, eCOA/ePRO, RTSM/IRT/IWRS, RBQM/OPRA-related workflows, and Certinia time entry, resource management, forecasting, reporting, project management, revenue, financial operations, and related Salesforce-based workflows.
- Ensure enablement coverage for corporate platforms such as LMS, Workday, Percipio, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams Rooms, Zoom, collaboration tools, and other business systems, with emphasis on workflow adoption, practical use, accessible performance support, and measurable proficiency.
- Publish a recurring Digital Adoption & Enablement scorecard with adoption insights, utilization trends, learning completion, proficiency indicators, support trends, remediation themes, business value narratives, and recommended actions.
- Coordinate learning plans with business-owned communications so learners understand required actions, business rationale, system impact, and available support.
- Represent GOLD in cross-functional forums related to enterprise systems, clinical systems, financial/project operations systems, HR systems, LMS strategy, Copilot/AI, digital adoption, process adoption, and workforce capability.
- Maintain reusable governance artifacts, templates, communication assets, release materials, adoption toolkits, measurement approaches, embedded guidance standards, and AI-enabled content methods to scale support across systems, functions, regions, and roles.
- Use learner, SME, helpdesk, system owner, and stakeholder feedback to improve training, performance support, adoption, and remediation cycles.
- Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

What You Bring To The Role

- Strong people leadership, coaching, prioritization, delegation, performance management, and team-development capability.
- Strong instructional design, facilitation, consulting, systems training, digital adoption, and change management skills.
- Ability to translate complex system workflows, compliance expectations, financial or operational processes, and role-based tasks into clear learning and performance support.
- Ability to manage a portfolio of enterprise systems adoption work across platforms, stakeholders, priorities, release timelines, regions, and functions.
- Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills in a matrixed, global environment.
- Analytical mindset with ability to measure learning effectiveness, adoption outcomes, proficiency gaps, support trends, and remediation needs.
- Excellent written, verbal, visual, and executive communication skills.
- High digital fluency across enterprise platforms, LMS tools, content authoring tools, analytics, and AI-enabled productivity tools.
- Familiarity with the regulatory, quality, and operational environment of clinical research is advantageous.

Your Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Education, Communications, Information Technology, Life Sciences, Clinical Research, Organizational Development, or related discipline; master’s degree preferred.
- 8–10 years of experience in learning, enterprise systems enablement, digital adoption, change management, workforce enablement, systems training, clinical operations training, or enterprise application training, including experience supporting complex implementations, releases, adoption programs, or global rollouts.
- Prior L & D people management experience, including coaching, goal setting, performance management, workload prioritization, capacity planning, team development, and quality oversight.
- Experience leading or overseeing systems training and adoption across platforms such as Medidata, Certinia/CAIR, Salesforce-based tools, LMS, Workday, Percipio, Microsoft 365, Copilot, collaboration tools, ERP, HCM, CRM, or other global corporate systems.
- Experience partnering with system owners, SMEs, EPMO, IT, Clinical Systems, Finance, Project Operations, process owners, QA/compliance, HRIS, Corporate Communications, LMS administrators, and business leaders to scope needs, validate content, manage review cycles, coordinate publishing, and maintain materials after launch.
- Working knowledge of regulated or validated systems training, including GCP, 21 CFR Part 11, audit readiness, role-based access, controlled content, completion records, release impacts, and compliance-ready documentation where applicable.
- Ability to define, monitor, and act on learning and adoption metrics such as completion, readiness, proficiency, utilization, feature adoption, time-to-competency, support trends, remediation needs, and post-launch outcomes.
- Certifications such as Prosci, CCMP, ATD CPLP/CPTD, Microsoft Service Adoption Specialist, Microsoft 365 Certified, instructional design, or related enterprise systems/change certifications preferred.

At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation.

The salary range for this position is annually (For hourly paid positions, the stated salary range reflects hourly rates):

United States of America - $113,000.00 - $225,000.00

The salary range provided is intended to give candidates an understanding of potential earnings. Compensation will fall within the provided range, and it not a guarantee of exact salary. The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Quien se incorpore tendrá a su cargo la gestión integral de Prestaciones Médicas de la Delegación, liderando al equipo y los procesos de auditoría médica, con foco en la optimización de los circuitos de trabajo, los tiempos de respuesta y la productividad del área.

La posición tendrá un rol clave en la resolución de prestaciones y en la articulación con prestadores, el Jefe de Sede y las áreas correspondientes de Sede Central.

Principales responsabilidades:

- Liderar, organizar y supervisar el funcionamiento del área de Prestaciones Médicas.
- Conducir al equipo de médicos y administrativos, estableciendo prioridades, distribución de tareas y seguimiento de resultados.
- Supervisar los procesos de auditoría médica, asegurando la aplicación de criterios técnicos e institucionales.
- Intervenir en la evaluación y resolución de prestaciones y casos de mayor complejidad.
- Optimizar los circuitos internos, tiempos de respuesta y productividad del área.
- Realizar el seguimiento de la gestión prestacional, identificando desvíos y oportunidades de mejora.
- Mantener una relación activa con prestadores, clínicas, sanatorios y profesionales de la red.
- Articular con Sede Central criterios de auditoría y situaciones que requieran intervención conjunta.

- Formación: Médico/a graduado/a, con matrícula profesional vigente.
- Experiencia: experiencia en auditoría médica y gestión prestacional, con antecedentes en conducción de equipos.

Asistente al DTA

El propósito de este puesto es colaborar en la obra de salvación y exaltación brindando apoyo administrativo de nivel ejecutivo, como colaborador individual, a líderes organizacionales tales como un Director de Asuntos Temporales. Los empleados en este nivel trabajan con mínima supervisión y gestionan asuntos y problemas complejos que requieren un amplio conocimiento funcional, así como la capacidad de tomar decisiones independientes y no rutinarias, demostrando iniciativa, originalidad, ingenio y buen criterio.

Responsibilities

- Guiar a empleados de niveles inferiores mediante capacitación, mentoría y/o dirección diaria.
- Anticipar proactivamente necesidades futuras y realizar recomendaciones.

- Tomar minutas de reuniones y administrar la documentación correspondiente.
- Utilizar aplicaciones y software para programar reuniones, citas y administrar calendarios, generalmente para varios líderes.
- Gestionar las bandejas de correo electrónico de los líderes asignados conforme al nivel de apoyo acordado.
- Organizar viajes y logística relacionada.
- Realizar presentaciones en reuniones.
- Apoyar las operaciones de resiliencia de oficina y la respuesta ante emergencias.
- Planificar, organizar y ejecutar reuniones de gran escala, conferencias y otros eventos.
- Filtrar llamadas telefónicas, correspondencia escrita y visitantes.
- Actuar como enlace administrativo entre la alta dirección y otros líderes clave, tanto internos como externos.
- Proporcionar apoyo en un entorno de estricta confidencialidad.
- Realizar otras tareas asignadas.

Qualifications

- 4 años de experiencia relacionada, o cualquier combinación de experiencia relevante y avance hacia la obtención o finalización de un título universitario (nivel terciario/universitario) o una certificación reconocida por la industria.
- Conocimiento experto en administración ejecutiva.
- Amplio conocimiento de la estructura organizacional, funciones y personal clave de la organización.
- Conocimiento práctico de la doctrina, políticas y procedimientos de la Iglesia.

Habilidades Clave

Capacidad para:

- Comunicarse en inglés a nivel avanzado, tanto oral como escrito.
- Utilizar Microsoft Office y otros programas a nivel avanzado para programar citas, crear y analizar hojas de cálculo, preparar presentaciones, tomar notas y minutas, y crear y actualizar documentos.
- Realizar investigaciones avanzadas, análisis y síntesis de datos.
- Anticipar necesidades de forma proactiva y pensar estratégicamente.
- Adaptar procesos y procedimientos estándar para resolver problemas complejos y encontrar soluciones menos evidentes.
- Resolver conflictos y problemas complejos mediante una adecuada toma de decisiones.
- Organizar y priorizar el trabajo y las necesidades.
- Coordinar proyectos y eventos de manera eficaz.
- Operar y mantener equipamiento estándar de oficina.
- Relacionarse y trabajar con otras personas de forma profesional y productiva.
- Actuar con discreción, confidencialidad e integridad.

Para desempeñar exitosamente las funciones esenciales del puesto, pueden existir requisitos físicos tales como permanecer sentado durante largos períodos, desplazarse por la oficina para entregar correspondencia u otros elementos, y utilizar computadoras y equipos informáticos.

- Experiencia directamente relacionada con el puesto.

postings.title: HR Generalist (Temporal)
postings.descriptionText:
As the largest jewellery brand in the world, we a give a voice to millions of people’s loves every day. Our beautiful products empower people all around the world to express themselves. We are proud to be part of their stories and the most important moments in their lives.

Where original thinking is welcomed, and can turn into positive impact in a heartbeat, we can dream big, dare to act, and deliver with care and passion. At Pandora where you can each craft far more than just an incredible career.

Do you want to make an impact and drive the growth of a global brand? We are looking for a Human Resources Generalist (Temporary - 8 months) to join our Argentina team, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Main Purpose Of The Role

Under the direction of the HR Business Partner, the Human Resources Generalist (Temporary) acts as a strategic and operational partner to the business, supporting leaders and employees across the employee lifecycle with a strong focus on people management, employee relations, talent development and engagement. The role works in close collaboration with Payroll/Departmento Pessoal (DP), ensuring alignment and effective communication, while payroll execution and statutory ownership remain with the Payroll function.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Health (Non-Operational)

- Partner with HRBP and Talent Acquisition team to support workforce planning and hiring strategies, while end-to-end recruitment execution is owned by the dedicated Recruiter.
- Act as a strategic partner to recruitment in cases of high turnover, repeated vacancies or operational risk, particularly in retail or specific business units.
- Analyze hiring patterns and onboarding effectiveness, providing insights and recommendations to HRBP, Recruiter and business leaders.
- Support hiring managers in addressing structural or people-related issues impacting attraction, retention and performance.
- Participate in interviews or selection discussions when required due to business criticality or employee relations risks.
- Ensure alignment between Talent Acquisition efforts and broader HR initiatives related to engagement and retention.

Employee Relations, Ethics & Employee Support

- Act as a primary HR point of contact for employees on people-related matters, providing guidance on policies, processes and employee lifecycle topics.
- Act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on employee relations, performance management, conduct and conflict resolution.
- Support leaders through coaching, feedback and performance improvement guidance.
- Mediate and support workplace-related complaints and allegations, including conduct, harassment, ethics and labor-related matters.
- Support and participate in internal investigations, in coordination with HRBP and Legal, ensuring confidentiality, neutrality and due process.
- Ensure appropriate documentation, escalation and compliance in sensitive employee relations cases.
- Partner with Payroll/DP and Legal to monitor labor relations topics and mitigate people-related risks.

Partnership with Payroll / DP (Non-Operational)

- Partner with Payroll/DP to support employee understanding of payroll-related matters, acting as a facilitator when communication or context is required.
- Ensure payroll-related inquiries are properly routed to Payroll/DP, maintaining clear ownership and accountability.
- Provide contextual HR information to Payroll/DP when needed, without executing payroll calculations or statutory processes.

Talent Management & Development

- Partner with HRBPs and business leaders (DSM/RSM) to support performance management, talent mapping, succession planning, and development initiatives.
- Identify organizational and individual development needs, including training mapping per role, and support the design and delivery of targeted learning solutions.
- Collaborate with Retail Excellence to align training programs with capabilities priorities.
- Support employee retention through development-focused action plans.

Compliance, Policies & Governance

- Ensure HR practices align with local labor legislation, internal policies and global guidelines, in partnership with HRBP, Payroll/DP and Legal.
- Support the creation, update and communication of HR policies and procedures.
- Act as an HR representative during audits or inspections related to HR practices (excluding payroll execution).

Engagement & Culture

- Lead and support employee engagement initiatives, team building activities and internal communications.
- Promote company culture, values and employee experience initiatives.

Reporting & HR Analytics

- Ensure People Portal (employee data system management) is consistently updated and maintained as the central source of HR information and reporting.
- Collect, analyze, and interpret HR data related to turnover, engagement, recruitment, and performance.
- Provide actionable insights and reports to HRBPs and leadership to support informed decision-making.

Craft Your Career With Us If You Have

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or related fields
- Minimum of 5 years of experience as an HR Generalist, preferably within retail, complex, or multi-unit environments.
- Strong experience in employee relations, talent management, and HR business partnering, ideally supporting retail or field-based teams.
- Proven experience working collaboratively with Payroll/DP and external vendors in a fast-paced, operational setting.
- Willingness to travel as required to support multi-unit or store operations within territory.
- Strong interpersonal, communication and conflict management skills
- Ability to influence leaders and manage sensitive situations with professionalism
- High level of confidentiality and ethical judgment
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to adapt in a fast-paced and changing environment
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and HR systems
- Fluent English

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in this role and want to be part of Pandora’s future, we encourage you to apply. We process applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

postings.title: Account Executive, USA
postings.descriptionText:
Join our US sales team and win consumer businesses, with e-commerce as a key segment, using a proven product and playbook.

- Location: Remote, anywhere
- Hours: US working hours
- Languages: Native-level English
- Base salary: $5,000–$10,000 gross/month ($60k–$120k/year)
- Commission: 10% recurring revenue share, uncapped
- Bonus: Ramp bonus
Where you land in the range depends on your skills, experience, and track record.

About Octocom
Every day, support teams spend thousands of hours on the same questions. Where is my order? How do I return this? Which product should I choose? Can I change my delivery address?

Octocom builds AI agents for support and sales for consumer businesses. Our agents handle conversations independently across chat, email, and phone, from order tracking and returns to product guidance and order changes. Businesses get faster responses, lower support costs, and more sales.

We grew 10x in 2025 and are on track to do it again in 2026. Our AI has already handled hundreds of millions of customer conversations. We keep things direct: few meetings, no politics, clear responsibility, and honest feedback.

The role
You'll join our team of Account Executives in the US and own your pipeline from first conversation to close.

You'll sell a product US brands already rely on, with an established playbook and close support from the founders and the rest of the team.

What you'll do

- Build your pipeline. Find high-potential US consumer businesses, with e-commerce as a key segment. Start conversations and create qualified opportunities.
- Run the full sales cycle. Discovery, demos, proposals, negotiation, and closing.
- Win long-term customers. Turn opportunities into accounts that stay and grow.
- Build local partnerships. Agencies, technology partners, e-commerce platforms, and other channels that accelerate growth.
- Stay close to customers. Support early onboarding and bring market feedback straight into product and strategy.
- Make the team better. Share what's working in your deals so the whole US team closes more.

Who we're looking for
The most important thing is hunger. We want someone who works hard, has big ambitions, and is excited to build something meaningful. Everything else is secondary.

None of these are strict requirements, but they're strong advantages:

- Native-level English.
- Experience in B2B SaaS sales, business development, partnerships, or growth.
- Startup experience, especially early-stage or fast-growing. Ex-founders and operators are especially welcome.
- Comfortable owning the full cycle, from cold outbound to close.
- Commercially sharp and confident with senior decision-makers.
- High ownership, independence, and a bias toward action in a remote setup.

If you're ambitious, competitive, and learn fast, we'd rather talk to you than reject you because your CV doesn't look perfect.

Commission that compounds
You earn 10% of the revenue from every customer you close. Customers pay monthly or yearly, so your commission recurs for as long as they stay. There is no cap.

- One customer: Customers paying $10,000/mo ≈ $1,000/mo to you, every month
- A grown portfolio: Customers paying $50,000/mo ≈ $5,000/mo to you, every month

On top of your base salary and ramp bonus. The bigger the book you build, the more you earn every month.

- Strong understanding of the sales cycle, prospecting techniques, pipeline management, and opportunity qualification.

postings.title: Sales Business Developer
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Sales Business Developer

What if your next role actually changed lives, including your own?

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that learning a language abroad is one of the most transformative experiences a person can have. And we need passionate, driven people to help make that happen. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Sales Business Developer to join our team in CABA, Argentina. This is your chance to take your career to the next level in a global company, work alongside an energetic and ambitious team, and play a key role in expanding EF's reach across the market.

You'll be the bridge between EF and the institutions that shape young people's futures: building partnerships with schools, universities, and companies, generating leads, and creating real business opportunities. No two days look the same, just strategic thinking, meaningful relationships, and a team that's genuinely rooting for you from day one.

Your Main Responsibilities Business Development

- Identify and open new business opportunities with schools, universities, companies, industry associations, and academic institutions to generate partnerships, leads, and business growth.
- Generate leads and proactively reach out to prospective schools, universities, and businesses.
- Foster and develop long-term relationships with partners and clients, ensuring commitments are fulfilled with consistency and professionalism.
- Think strategically, seeing the bigger picture and setting goals to continuously develop and improve business.

Sales and Client Management

- Meet with customers and partners face to face, via Zoom, or over the phone.
- Negotiate and identify win-win solutions with a consultative and entrepreneurial approach.
- Create and execute a timely activity plan by participating in events such as fairs, exhibitions, presentations, and networking events.
- Meet weekly, monthly, and quarterly KPI targets, working with focus and resilience under pressure.
- Report on activities, pipeline progress, and performance metrics to your line manager.

Communication and Representation

- Deliver confident pitches and presentations to educational institutions and corporate partners.
- Representing EF with clear, structured, and impactful communication in every environment.
- Organize events and lead our referral and loyalty programs to strengthen brand presence and drive lead generation.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Communications, Tourism, or a related field.
- Relevant experience in sales and/or marketing. B2B or education/travel industry experience is a plus.
- Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken. A third language is a bonus.
- Having studied, worked, or lived abroad is preferred.
- Comfortable using CRM tools and sales software.
- Strategic thinker with strong organizational skills and a results-driven mindset.

Why You Will Love Working with Us

More than just a job, we offer a career, and the benefits grow with you.

From Day One, All EF Team Members Enjoy

- Benefits by local law
- Corporate benefits discounts
- Staff referral bonus (500 USD)
- EF Hello App
- Access to the Mental Health App "Foundation"

As a Sales Business Developer, You Also Unlock

- Global Mobile Office
- National KO recognition
- EF Summer Helper Nomination: 1 week as a group helper abroad
- Famtrip Nomination: travel to the USA
- Intercontinental Famtrip nomination
- Tuition reimbursement fee nomination
- English course with local school or EF
- Free language course week (minimum B2 level)
- Nomination to International Trainings
- New Manager Training Nomination

As you grow through our career ladder, even more doors open. Depending on your level, you may also unlock:

- Hub Office visits with training and networking opportunities
- Leadership development programs and international kickoffs

Benefits vary by career level and are subject to local labor laws and business eligibility criteria.

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we've helped millions of students discover new places, embrace diverse cultures, and gain fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to our mission of opening the world through education, harnessing the power of language learning to deepen the connection between people across the globe.

We offer immersive short-term and long-term language courses and programs across different languages in the countries where they’re spoken. postings.descriptionText:
Job Title: Sales/Account Executive
Location: Remote (LATAM)
Type: Full-Time | Remote
Language: Professional English (C1 and C2 scores)

WorkBetterNow provides full-time positions for professionals in LATAM looking to work with United States-based companies. Our remote professionals come first and are the most important part of our team. If you want to be part of a company that values work-life balance and supports your professional development, you’re in the right place.

Our Core Values:

- Put our Talent first
- Pursuit of excellence/continuous learning
- Integrity and transparency
- Ownership mentality
- Pursuit of growth
- Excellent attitude

The Ideal Candidate
You have advanced English proficiency at a C1 or C2 level and value work-life balance and remote flexibility. You take ownership of your work, communicate with integrity, and bring a great attitude to everything you do. You are genuinely excited about continuous learning and are looking for long-term commitment and stability. Most importantly, you align with our core values and want to grow professionally with a supportive team that truly puts you first.

Job Description:
A remote Sales/Account Executive will be responsible for managing qualified sales opportunities and supporting client relationship development throughout the sales cycle. This role focuses on conducting discovery calls, presenting solutions, preparing proposals, and closing deals under established sales processes. The Account Executive will also support early-stage account management to ensure a smooth client onboarding experience. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and comfortable handling structured sales conversations in a remote environment. While your duties will depend on the specific needs of your client, they will include, but not be limited to:

- Conduct discovery calls with qualified leads to understand client needs, business challenges, and purchasing criteria
- Present products or services using approved sales frameworks and tailored messaging based on client requirements
- Prepare and deliver proposals, pricing breakdowns, and follow-up documentation in a timely manner
- Manage assigned sales opportunities within the CRM, ensuring accurate updates, notes, and pipeline tracking
- Follow up consistently with prospects to maintain momentum and move deals toward closure.
- Handle basic objections and escalate complex negotiations or pricing discussions to senior leadership when required
- Coordinate internally with SDRs/BDRs, operations, and onboarding teams to ensure a smooth handoff after deal closure
- Support contract preparation and assist in gathering required documentation from clients.

Requirements:

- 2 years of experience in sales or account management
- Basic understanding of sales cycles, CRM systems, and pipeline management
- Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar tools
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously

Technical Requirements

- Processor: Intel 11th Gen (or equivalent AMD Ryzen 5000 series) for Windows users and M2 for Macs
- RAM: 16 GB minimum
- 25 - 50 Mbps Internet Speed (Min)

Please note that devices such as MacBook Neos and Chromebooks are not fit for our roles.

Benefits
Compensation & Growth
At WorkBetterNow, we believe in rewarding commitment and supporting long-term success. Our pay structure ensures your compensation evolves with your experience and tenure. Note: The figures below reflect our 2026 ranges; each tenure milestone will increase each year.

- 0-3 months: $1,200 USD/month
- After 3 months: You’ll receive a $50 monthly Wellness Bonus to support a healthy and balanced work life (total: $1,250/month).
- After 1 year: Salary increases to $1,340 USD/month
- After 2 years: Salary increases to $1,480 USD/month
- After 3 years: Salary increases to $1,540 USD/month
- After 4 years: Salary increases to $1,600 USD/month
- Two Annual Adjustments: Every year, you benefit from two salary increases: one on your work anniversary, recognizing your continued tenure with WorkBetterNow, and one at the start of each calendar year, when all salary ranges are updated company-wide.

Benefits & Perks

- 100% remote work — enjoy the comfort and flexibility of working from home
- 18 paid vacation days + U.S. federal holidays
- Paid maternity/paternity leave (up to 2 months with 50% salary coverage after 1 year)
- Client Growth Bonus: Your great work helps our clients scale. For every new hire added to the business you support, you will receive a $50 one-time reward. It’s our way of celebrating the growth you helped make possible
- A dedicated Talent Coordinator who serves as your guide and liaison between you, WorkBetterNow, and your assigned company—helping you navigate your role and continue growing professionally
- A supportive, people-first environment where your voice matters

Why WorkBetterNow
At WBN, you will be part of a team that genuinely puts talent first. We are not just a remote company, we are a community where people are valued, supported, and empowered to grow. We celebrate positive energy, support each other’s success, and believe that when you feel connected and appreciated, you do your best work.

Your stability, integrity, and positive attitude will help drive success for our clients while allowing you to build a fulfilling long-term career for yourself. In addition to meaningful work and professional growth, our team connects each month through activities such as talent shows, costume challenges, virtual learning sessions, and in-person get-togethers twice a year. If this sounds like the opportunity you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

postings.title: Banco de Talentos I Telesales Executive - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina. Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven, creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal, reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones.

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Telesales Executive trabaja bajo el modelo "híbrido", siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El área de Telesales tiene como misión estratégica impulsar la expansión del negocio mediante la adquisición sostenible de nuevas cuentas y el aporte de revenue.

El éxito del rol de Telesales Executive radica en la capacidad para gestionar el pipeline comercial, huntear oportunidades de mercado mediante inbound marketing y ejecutar procesos de venta consultiva.

Operan en un modelo de alta sinergia cross-functional, trabajando en colaboración con Marketing para la alineación de captación por plazas prioritarias, y con el equipo de Customer Success para asegurar un handoff sin fricciones que asegure el éxito del cliente y mitigue el riesgo de bajas tempranas (Churn).

Foco Comercial: Prospección masiva, generación de volumen en la base de clientes y aseguramiento del cumplimiento de los KPIs básicos de adquisición de cuentas nuevas en los segmentos iniciales.

Tus Responsabilidades

- Hunteo Comercial Activo: Identificar y prospectar de manera proactiva nuevas oportunidades de negocio inmobiliario mediante diversos canales digitales (llamadas telefónicas, WhatsApp Business y correo electrónico) de los leads recibidos por inbound marketing.
- Hunteo comercial activo telefónico a través de plataforma Genesys y derivación de gestión a distintas áreas.
- Cumplimiento de Metas: Alcanzar los objetivos mensuales de cantidad de cuentas nuevas ingresadas a la plataforma.
- Ejecución de Venta Consultiva: Realizar demostraciones vía meet/zoom de la plataforma, traduciendo características técnicas en beneficios de negocio y resolviendo las dudas operativas básicas del cliente.
- Gestión de Pipeline: Mantener actualizado de forma diaria el estado de las oportunidades en la plataforma registrando datos precisos y limpios del proceso comercial.
- Fomento de Métodos de Pago Automáticos: Impulsar de forma prioritaria la venta con adherencia a tarjeta de crédito o débito automático desde el cierre inicial para optimizar los cobros futuros.
- Gestión de Franquicias y Eventos: Liderar presentaciones de captación en eventos (presenciales/virtuales), capacitaciones según convenios de su zona y ser el responsable administrativo de las altas de franquicias asignadas.

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

- Experiencia: Mínimo 3 años en roles de Venta Consultiva B2B / SaaS; demostrando capacidad para realizar demos virtuales de la plataforma (vía Meet/Zoom), traduciendo funcionalidades técnicas del la misma.
- Gestión de Pipeline & Stack de Ventas: Experiencia intermedia/avanzada en manejo de CRM, manteniendo datos limpios, y plataformas de llamadas masivas/outbound como Genesys.
- Gestión de Canales Múltiples: Fluidez en etiqueta telefónica, WhatsApp Business y correos comerciales para contacto masivo y ágil de prospectos.

Soft Skills y Competencias

- Resiliencia y Tolerancia a la Frustración: Capacidad para mantener una actitud positiva y un alto nivel de energía ante objeciones recurrentes o rechazos de clientes.
- Comunicación Efectiva y Elocuencia: Destacada etiqueta telefónica y escrita, con fluidez verbal y claridad para transmitir la propuesta de valor.
- Organización y Velocidad de Respuesta: Habilidad para clasificar y priorizar un alto volumen diario de prospectos comerciales de manera ágil y expedita.
- Proactividad: para destrabar bloqueos operativos en el contacto inicial y mover con rapidez al cliente hacia el cierre.

¿Cómo es nuestro Proceso de Selección?

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

- Postulación y Revisión de Perfil.
- Entrevista Equipo de Reclutamiento.
- Entrevista con Hiring Manager.
- Evaluación Técnica (Caso práctico - desafío).
- Propuesta y ¡Bienvenido/a!

Importante: Evaluamos todas las postulaciones de manera individual y garantizamos respuesta para todas las personas. Toda la comunicación se realiza por correo electrónico, así que asegúrate de revisar tu bandeja de entrada y permitir los correos del dominio @quintoandar.com.br.

Beneficios

- Plan médico.
- Wellhub.
- Licencia parental extendida.
- Reintegro de Guardería.
- Gastos de teletrabajo (monto mensual).
- Descuentos en servicios del día a día.
- Día libre por cumpleaños, Día del Padre y Día de la Madre.

Diversidad e Inclusión en Grupo QuintoAndar

Durante la inscripción, verás algunas preguntas sobre diversidad. Estas son confidenciales y tienen como objetivo apoyar nuestras acciones de diversidad e inclusión. En vacantes afirmativas, la información podrá ser utilizada para verificar el alineamiento con el público objetivo de la oportunidad y, en estos casos, podría tener carácter eliminatorio. Para vacantes no afirmativas, esta información no afecta tu postulación y se utiliza únicamente para ayudarnos a mejorar continuamente nuestras prácticas e iniciativas de inclusión a lo largo de tu trayectoria con nosotros.

Privacidad y Protección de Datos

El Grupo QuintoAndar actúa de conformidad con las leyes de privacidad y protección de datos, y garante la seguridad de sus datos personales. Para saber más, consulte nuestro Aviso de Privacidad para Personas Candidatas. Si tiene dudas o desea ejercer sus derechos como titular de los datos, póngase en contacto con nosotros a través de nuestro Canal de Atención.

postings.title: Ejecutivo Comercial B2B (con experiencia en Proyectos y Equipamiento Industrial)
postings.descriptionText:
¿Te apasiona la venta consultiva B2B, la gestión de cuentas clave y el desafío de abrir nuevos mercados? ¡Esta es tu oportunidad!

Nuestro cliente es una sólida y reconocida compañía multinacional (con base en Europa y más de 35 años de liderazgo en Argentina) especializada en el diseño, provisión y postventa de bienes de capital y maquinaria industrial de alto nivel tecnológico. Hoy se encuentran en plena expansión de su equipo comercial y buscan incorporar un Ejectuvo Comercial estratégico, dinámico y con experiencia en ventas de productos industriales / maquinarias.

En esta posición clave, tendrás el desafío de introducirte en el mercado del sur del país en principio, con un foco estratégico en zonas de alta inversión como Vaca Muerta y la Patagonia (y también está pensado en el corto/mediano plazo gestionar parte de Buenos Aires)

Tu objetivo no será la venta transaccional, sino el diseño de proyectos a medida, la construcción de relaciones a largo plazo con la industria corporativa y la estructuración de sólidas redes de distribución.

Si buscas un rol de ventas con proyección de crecimiento, te interesa viajar para vender al sur del país y tienes experiencia aportando valor desde el lado técnico comercial B2B ¡queremos conocerte!

Responsabilidades Principales:

- Gestión de Proyectos B2B: Liderar el ciclo completo de venta técnica consultiva, diseñando y comercializando proyectos industriales integrales de alto valor añadido.
- Desarrollo de Mercado (Región Sur del país y parte de Buenos Aires): Identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y verticales industriales en la zona sur del país (foco estratégico en Neuquén/Vaca Muerta y la Patagonia). Adicionalmente, el territorio asignado contemplará, en una fase posterior o según la necesidad estratégica, la expansión y gestión comercial en la ciudad y la provincia de Buenos Aires.
- Gestión de Cuentas (Account Management): Administrar, fidelizar y potenciar la cartera de clientes existente en la región asignada, realizando seguimiento activo y articulación con las áreas internas (servicio técnico, administración).
- Redes de Distribución: Prospectar, desarrollar y consolidar la red de distribuidores y representantes técnicos locales en las provincias del interior.
- Inteligencia Comercial: Monitorear el mercado y la competencia, ajustando las políticas y estrategias comerciales para la región y reportando de manera directa al Director de Ventas Nacional.

Experiencia Requerida:

- + 3 años de trayectoria comprobable en ventas consultivas B2B, comercialización de bienes de capital, maquinaria industrial, servicios corporativos o insumos de alto valor agregado (ej. industria química, O&G, siderurgia o alimentación).
- Visión de negocio y desarrollo de canales: Experiencia previa en el desarrollo territorial, apertura de nuevas zonas geográficas y estructuración de redes de distribuidores o representantes en el interior del país.
- Perfil consultivo: Habilidad demostrada para liderar ventas de proyectos complejos y de largo ciclo.
- Perfil autónomo, resiliente, dinámico y con clara orientación a resultados y satisfacción del cliente. Capacidad analítica para desenvolverse en escenarios de decisiones rápidas.
- Disponibilidad: Contar con disponibilidad para realizar viajes periódicos a la Patagonia y el sur del país. (Es deseable, aunque no excluyente, contar con vehículo propio).

Qué se ofrece?

- Estabilidad y proyección: Ingreso directo a una compañía multinacional líder con 35 años de solidez en Argentina, que valora el crecimiento profesional cualitativo y fomenta la autonomía.
- Paquete de compensación competitivo: Salario fijo (bajo convenio de comercio) + Bono Anual por Objetivos.
- Modalidad Híbrida y Flexible: Base operativa en las oficinas propias en CABA. El rol contempla flexibilidad para combinar el trabajo en la oficina, visitas a clientes y días de Home Office.
- Gastos de movilidad y viáticos cubiertos al 100%: Para los viajes al interior, la empresa cubre íntegramente pasajes, alojamiento y alquiler de vehículo. En caso de usar vehículo propio en el día a día, se reintegran gastos de combustible y peajes.
- Capacitación continua: Plan de formación interna por parte de la empresa enfocado en el producto y mercado para acompañar tu ramp-up comercial.

Proceso de Selección:

Paso 1: Entrevista con una de nuestras recruiters
Paso 2: Entrevista con HRBP del cliente y Hiring Manager de la posición
Paso 3: Última entrevista con el Director General

Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking a high-performing, relationship-driven sales professional to help organizations transform the way they design, build, and make. In this role, you will own the sales strategy and business results for a defined territory, partnering closely with customers, channel partners, and internal teams to drive growth and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

You will serve as a trusted advisor, helping customers solve complex business challenges through Autodesk's industry-leading solutions while identifying new opportunities to expand adoption and long-term value.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, consultative sales environment and enjoy building strategic relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Drive Territory Growth:

- Develop and execute a strategic territory plan focused on revenue growth, customer acquisition, and market expansion
- Generate new business while maximizing existing customer relationships and recurring revenue streams
- Build, manage, and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities across your territory
- Consistently deliver against sales targets and business objectives

Build Customer & Partner Relationships

- Establish trusted, long-term relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders
- Collaborate with Autodesk sales teams and channel partners to identify opportunities and accelerate growth
- Lead customer conversations focused on business outcomes, digital transformation, and solution value
- Represent Autodesk at customer meetings, industry events, and partner engagements

Execute Strategic Sales Plans

- Create and implement business plans tailored to target industries, customer segments, and market opportunities
- Develop compelling proposals that align Autodesk solutions with customer business goals and measurable outcomes
- Drive adoption and expansion of Autodesk products across assigned accounts and territories
- Support partners in developing sales and marketing strategies that increase market awareness and demand generation

Forecast & Operational Excellence

- Deliver accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and territory reporting
- Ensure opportunities and customer engagement activities are tracked through CRM tools and Autodesk sales methodologies
- Assist with contract negotiations and deal structuring to ensure compliance with business and revenue policies
- Identify opportunities to improve processes, drive innovation, and enhance overall sales effectiveness

Collaborate Across Autodesk

- Partner with Marketing to support events, campaigns, and territory growth initiatives
- Leverage internal resources and cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences
- Actively contribute to a culture of collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and customer success

Minimum Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience in Enterprise Software, SaaS, or technology sales
- Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets
- Experience with consultative sales methodologies and complex solution selling
- Strong territory planning, pipeline development, and forecasting skills
- Ability to influence and build relationships across customers, partners, and internal teams
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
- Native or professional fluency in both Spanish and English
- Ability to adapt quickly, manage ambiguity, and maintain a positive, solution-oriented mindset

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
- Experience working with indirect channel partners and reseller ecosystems
- Knowledge of industries served by Autodesk, including Construction, Manufacturing, Media & Entertainment, or Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC)

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.
