Sumarse al área de ventas para comercializar soluciones de software orientadas al segmento empresas en Argentina, principalmente Bejerman ERP combinando generación de nuevos negocios con desarrollo de cartera activa.

La posición requiere un perfil comercial con experiencia en venta consultiva de productos intangibles, capaz de gestionar oportunidades de punta a punta, identificar necesidades del cliente, acompañar procesos de decisión con múltiples interlocutores y sostener un seguimiento comercial estructurado en ciclos de venta de mediana duración.

Key Responsibilities

- Formar parte del área de ventas suscriptivas del segmento empresas.
- Comercializar soluciones de software de gestión administrativa y productiva para pymes en Argentina.
- Realizar venta consultiva de productos intangibles, tanto de manera telefónica como presencial.
- Prospectar nuevos clientes para ampliar la cartera asignada. (Excluyente)
- Gestionar y desarrollar una cartera de clientes activa, promoviendo nuevas funcionalidades, ampliaciones de uso y oportunidades de upselling/cross-selling.
- Detectar necesidades, dolores y requerimientos del cliente para construir propuestas comerciales acordes.
- Acompañar oportunidades comerciales end to end, desde la prospección hasta el cierre.
- Brindar capacitaciones, presentaciones y demostraciones comerciales de producto, con fuerte capacidad de oratoria y manejo de relaciones interpersonales.
- Trabajar colaborativamente con otras áreas en temas de producto, compliance, alianzas y actualizaciones funcionales.
- Utilizar herramientas de IA para mejorar productividad comercial, preparación de mensajes, seguimiento y comunicación con clientes.

Required Qualifications

- Profesional graduado o estudiante avanzado de carrera universitaria, preferentemente en:Administración de Empresas,Contador Público,Comercialización,o carreras afines.
- Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en posiciones comerciales/ventas.
- Experiencia en venta consultiva y en manejo del ciclo comercial end to end.
- Experiencia en comercialización de productos intangibles.
- Experiencia en prospección activa y generación de nuevos clientes.
- Capacidad para desarrollar y mantener cartera de clientes.
- Buenas habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.
- Capacidad para brindar presentaciones, capacitaciones o demos comerciales.
- Manejo de algún software CRM; idealmente experiencia con Salesforce.
- Capacidad de autogestión, proactividad y orientación a resultados.
- Facilidad para trabajar en equipo.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experiencia en prospección y generación de nuevos clientes.
- Experiencia en uso de herramientas de IA aplicadas a procesos comerciales.
- Experiencia previa en venta de software, tecnología, suscripciones o soluciones B2B.
- Experiencia gestionando clientes con distintos interlocutores, como:jefes de área,responsables administrativos,finanzas,contadores internos o externos,perfiles de sistemas/IT,gerencias.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

- Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.
- Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.
- Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.
- Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.
- Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.
- Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).
- Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

Quiénes somos

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. En un momento en el que la objetividad, precisión, equidad y transparencia están bajo ataque, nos comprometemos a buscarlos. ¿Suena emocionante? Forma parte de nuestro equipo y contribuye a moldear las industrias que impulsan el progreso de la sociedad.

Como empresa global, confiamos en los antecedentes únicos, perspectivas y experiencias de todos los empleados para cumplir con nuestros objetivos comerciales. Para asegurarnos de poder hacerlo, buscamos colaboradores talentosos y calificados en todas nuestras operaciones alrededor del mundo, sin importar raza, color, sexo/género, incluyendo embarazo, identidad y expresión de género, origen nacional, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía, condición de veterano u otra clasificación protegida bajo la ley aplicable. Thomson Reuters se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades laborales, proporcionando un ambiente de trabajo libre de drogas.

Asimismo, ofrecemos adaptaciones razonables para personas calificadas con discapacidades y para aquellas con creencias religiosas sinceras, conforme a la legislación vigente. Puedes encontrar más información sobre cómo solicitar una adaptación aquí.

Descubre cómo protegerte de anuncios de empleo fraudulentos aquí. Para obtener más información sobre Thomson Reuters, visita nuestro sitio web en thomsonreuters.com

- Posicionar a PedidosYa como una alternativa de crecimiento para los Partners generando relaciones comerciales de valor desde el primer momento.
- Analizar la performance de ventas y proponer oportunidades de mejora en pos del alcance de los objetivos y comunicar a los partners las oportunidades de mejora identificadas para mejorar su desempeño.

Requisitos

- Experiencia en áreas de ventas, desarrollo de negocios o gestión de cuentas, preferentemente en industria tecnológica o de servicios.
- Motivación y mentalidad comercial. Actitud proactiva, flexibilidad, resiliencia y orientada a resultados.
- Habilidades de comunicación: Capacidad excepcional para conectar con otras personas, comunicar de forma clara y construir relaciones de confianza.
- Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, capacidad de organización y planificación y orientación al trabajo en equipo.
- Manejo de herramientas digitales: entorno Google o herramientas similares.
- Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de la ciudad o región según sea necesario.

Información adicional

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

,

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

Ready to be part of the experience?

Fever for Business (F4B) is our B2B organization, built around a simple idea: providing live experiences as a service to other businesses.

We help businesses, schools and global brands create memorable events without the usual complexity by providing a reliable, scalable, and high-quality service.

From intimate Candlelight Private Concert or a large-scale multi-city activation, we turn live entertainment into a repeatable business solution that drives employee engagement and brand differentiation. Our team owns the full journey from initial sales and strategy to global execution working closely with Fever Originals and Operations to scale B2B experiences smoothly and at a global level.

Join us if you are excited about redefining B2B entertainment, build global partnerships, and turn world-class culture into a seamless business service.

The Role

We are looking for a tenured Sr. Account Executive to help build and scale our emerging Fever for Business unit across LATAM, bringing the full power of Fever to corporate and institutional clients in a fast-growing market. In this role, you will take ownership of a targeted book of business within the Strategic & Enterprise segments, while also shaping our local go-to-market approach - defining strategy, advising prospects on their needs within the culture and live entertainment space and driving net new revenue. Your expertise in consultative selling, combined with strong deal execution and cross-functional alignment, will be critical to accelerating our expansion and establishing a high-impact B2B presence in the region.

What You'll Do

- Own the relationship with Fever’s Enterprise and Strategic prospects and clients in your territory

- Take ownership in pipeline creation and deal cycle management, applying MEDDIC-style Sales methodologies

Who You Are

- 5+ years in B2B sales (SaaS, Media, Entertainment, MICE or similar a plus)
- Proven track record of achieving Sales targets
- Experience with MEDDIC/SPIN or similar methodologies is preferred
- Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills; confident with senior stakeholders
- Entrepreneurial self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change
- Excellent written & verbal communication skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Growth mindset: coachable, data-driven, organized, optimistic
- Fluency in English and Spanish.

Why You'll Love It Here

- Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
- 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
- 20 days of paid annual leave to support your well-being and personal time outside of work.
- Private health & dental insurance: OSDE 410 plan fully covered by Fever.
- Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
- Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
- Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Buenos Aires office location.
- Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

Nuestra misión es proveer a la industria ganadera de las mejores herramientas para la producción de alimentos para el mundo de manera rentable y sostenible. - Mentalidad emprendedora.

- Contar con experiencia de entre 2 y 5 años en posiciones comerciales vinculadas al mercado asegurador.

- Residencia en la zona o barrios aledaños.

- Incorporación directa a un proyecto comercial sólido y en crecimiento.
- Esquema salarial competitivo: Sueldo básico asegurado + atractivo paquete de comisiones variables y premios por cumplimiento de objetivos.

postings.descriptionText:
Descripción del puesto Asesor Comercial Plan de ahorro, Santa Rosa, La Pampa, Argentina

¿Te apasiona el mundo de las ventas y los negocios? ¡Esta es tu oportunidad de unirte a nuestro equipo en Bahía Blanca! Buscamos un Asesor Comercial con experiencia en el área para formar parte de nuestro equipo. Si eres proactivo, orientado al cliente y entusiasta por alcanzar objetivos de venta, ¡te estamos buscando!

En esta posición, tendrás la oportunidad de interactuar con clientes, identificar sus necesidades, ofrecer soluciones personalizadas y cerrar acuerdos comerciales.

Como Asesor Comercial, serás responsable de mantener una cartera de clientes activa, desarrollar estrategias de venta efectivas, realizar seguimiento y contribuir al crecimiento de las ventas en la zona. Tu labor será fundamental para mantener la satisfacción de nuestros clientes y alcanzar los objetivos comerciales de la empresa.

Si te consideras una persona proactiva, con habilidades de negociación y comunicación, capaz de trabajar en equipo y orientada a resultados, ¡te invitamos a formar parte de nuestro equipo en Santa Rosa!

Requisitos

- Experiencia comprobable en ventas (mínimo 1-2 años en rubros similares, preferentemente automotriz o bienes de alto valor).
- Excelente capacidad de comunicación, persuasión y orientación al cliente.

Somos un conjunto de empresas familiares, conformado en la actualidad por las sociedades Guspamar S.A, Hector R. Resasco S.A, Vernon S.A, Genova Automotores S.A, GPM Credit S.R.L.

Nuestra historia se remonta al año 1961 cuando Héctor, junto a su padre Roberto, comienzan como concesionarios D.K.W Auto Unión. En 1970, la fábrica cierra y por tal motivo se inician relaciones comerciales con General Motors, para la comercialización de sus productos Chevrolet. Es así que nace Resasco Automotores S.A. como concesionario para la ciudad de Bahía Blanca.

En 1978, General Motors se retira del país. En ese entonces Héctor Resasco, decide continuar con la actividad, volcándose en la venta de unidades usadas. Para esto, funda junto a su señora, Lidia, la firma Héctor R. Resasco S.A.

Hacia fines de 1983 Ford Argentina los designa como concesionario oficial para la localidad de Coronel Dorrego y su zona de influencia. Es así que surge Guspamar S.A. como concesionario oficial Ford.

Debido al crecimiento y a la necesidad de ampliar la zona de influencia, en 1996 obtiene el nombramiento para la ciudad de Bahía Blanca, y más tarde en el año 2001 para la ciudad de Santa Rosa, provincia de La Pampa.

Por otra parte, en el año 2000 recreando la Firma Héctor R. Resasco S.A., se incorporan en Bahía Blanca a la red de concesionarios Chrysler para sus marcas Chrysler, Jeep y Dodge. En 2002 crean G.P.M. Credit S.R.L., una empresa dedicada a la financiación de las ventas con crédito del grupo.

En Julio del 2004 se integran a Peugeot con Vernon S.A. como concesionario Oficial en Santa Rosa y con influencia en toda La Pampa. En Abril de 2007 se suman a la red Fiat con Génova Automotores S.A., también en Santa Rosa, La Pampa. Finalmente, en junio de 2017, Vernon S.A incorpora la marca Citroen al grupo.

El día 16 de enero de 2021, se generó una fusión a nivel internacional entre Fiat Chrysler Automobiles y el francés Groupe PSA, dando luz a Stellantis V.V. Este grupo automovilístico unifica múltiples marcas incluidas Fiat, Citroen, Peugeot y Jeep.

Por esta razón, en enero de 2022, Hector R.Resasco traslada la marca Jeep a la provincia de La Pampa, y así, el Grupo Resasco, se convierte en el primer grupo automotor del interior del país en concentrar dichas marcas en un solo lugar.

postings.descriptionText:
Title: B2B Sales Associate — Growth Marketing (Agency)
Type: Full-time · Fully remote · Must work North American business hours (ET/CT/PT overlap, 9am–5pm ET core).
Reports to: Founder & CEO

Compensation: $3,000/mo base + 5% commission on every initial inbound contract sold (SEO or non-SEO) + $500 bonus per new closed client ($250 if the client is invoiced under $2,500).

Uncapped.

7% on outbound contracts sold.

About Web Tonic
Web Tonic is a performance-driven, 360° digital marketing agency: Google Ads, SEO, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, web design, and full growth marketing programs. We work with fast-scaling brands and enterprise accounts across North America, the Middle East and Asia. Our clients don't buy "services" — they buy revenue, and our sales conversations are strategic, technical and consultative.

The role
You own new business from qualified conversation to signed contract. You are not an SDR reading a script and you are not an account manager babysitting existing clients — you are a closer who can hold a credible strategy conversation about a prospect's Google Ads account, SEO footprint and Meta creative, then translate it into a scope the prospect wants to buy.

All of our leads are currently inbound but if you have contacts in the industry and want to bring your own leads/clients, that will be asset.

What you'll do

- Run discovery and closing calls with inbound leads and referrals (typically $5K–$25K/mo retainers).
- Diagnose a prospect's current paid + organic setup live on the call: account structure, wasted spend, tracking gaps, keyword/content gaps, creative fatigue.
- Build and present scopes of work, pricing and proposals with our strategy team.
- Handle objections on price, contract length, attribution and "we already have an agency".
- Own your pipeline end to end in the CRM: follow-ups, multi-threading, forecasting.
- Feed the delivery team a clean handoff so what you sold is what gets built.
- Contribute to outbound plays and partnership/referral sourcing when pipeline allows.

What you must have

- 2+ years selling in a digital marketing / growth agency as a sales associate, AE or closer (agency experience is non-negotiable).
- Documented closing record on retainers or projects of $5,000+/mo — you can name deal sizes, cycle length and win rate.
- Genuine working fluency in Google Ads, SEO and Meta Ads — enough to read a report, spot the problem and explain it in plain business terms.
- Understanding of growth marketing fundamentals: funnel math, CAC/LTV, ROAS, attribution, lead quality.
- Native level of English fluency
- Reliable home office, camera-on, quiet environment.
- Heavily using AI to optimize your work and efficiency levels (this will need to be demonstrated).

Nice to have

- French bilingual (part of our client base is in Quebec).
- CRM/automation comfort (Zoho, HubSpot, GoHighLevel), Looms and async proposal walkthroughs.

Compensation detail

- Base: $3,000/month.
- Commission: 5% of the initial contract sold (Inbound). 7% for outbound.
- New client bonus: $500 one-time per new closed client, any SOW, when the client is invoiced $2,500+. $250 if invoiced below $2,500.
- No cap. Paid monthly.

Compensation examples

Our average initial contract is around $20,000 USD. We are currently looking to close two clients per month, and we currently have around 150 inbound leads per month. Out of those, 60% are qualified, and 40% end up booking a meeting. Our conversion rate is too low right now, hence the need for an experienced sales associate.

How to apply

- Send your CV plus a short answer (written or 3-minute Loom) to these three:
- The largest agency deal you personally closed. Size, cycle, and what unlocked it.
- A prospect running Google Ads and SEO with flat revenue for 6 months: what are the first three things you ask?
- Which channel do you sell most convincingly, and which one would you need to lean on a strategist for?

Give me details of the B2B marketing packages that you are used to selling: pricing, inclusion, sales cycle length

postings.title: LATAM Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker
postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for enterprise sales people based in LATAM and fluent in Spanish. Colombia is currently the highest priority.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

- Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
- High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
- Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
- Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
- Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

- Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
- Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
- Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
- Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
- Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
- Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
- Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers’ business problems
- Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
- Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
- Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

- Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
- Experience of open source technology and solutions
- Detail oriented with effective follow-up
- Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
- Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
- Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
- Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
- Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional Skills Of Interest

- Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
- Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
- Annual compensation review
- Recognition rewards
- Annual holiday leave
- Maternity and paternity leave
- Employee Assistance Program
- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
- Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Sourcing, Supply Chain and Logistics Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About ITT:

ITT Inc. (NYSE: ITT) is a diversified global leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions serving the flow, aerospace and defense, transportation, industrial, and energy markets. Through operational execution, innovation, and disciplined capital deployment, including strategic acquisitions such as SPX FLOW, ITT partners with its customers to deliver enduring solutions to the key industries that underpin our modern way of life.

Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, ITT has a market cap of roughly $20 billion and employs more than 15,000 people across 40 countries and serves customers in approximately 125 countries. Following the acquisition of SPX FLOW, the company is expected to generate $5.4 billion in annual revenue.

Our businesses are organized in three distinct segments, each based around our core engineering DNA:

Flow Technologies: A global leader in, providing a broad portfolio of pumps, valves, mixing and agitation equipment, heat transfer, homogenizers, separation, water and wastewater treatment, and engineered process solutions.Our leading brands include the iconic Goulds Pumps (with more than 175 years of history), Anhydro, APV, Bornemann, Bran+Luebbe, C’treat, Engineered Valves, Gerstenberg Schröder, Habonim, Johnson Pump, Lightnin, Philadelphia, Plenty, PRO Cast, Rheinhütte, Seital Separation, Stelzer, Svanehøj, Tigerholm, Uutechnic, VIDAR, Waukesha Cherry-Burrell.

Motion Technologies: A global leader in brake pads (ICE and electrified brake pads) and shock absorbers (energy absorption solutions) for transportation applications. Our leading brands include Friction Technologies, KONI and Axtone.

Connect and Control Technologies: A leader in critical applications for the aerospace, defense and industrial markets, including harsh environment connectors and control components. Our leading brands include ITT Cannon, Enidine, Aerospace Controls and kSARIA.

Resumen de Posición

Manage and comprehensively monitor the company's import and export operations, ensuring their proper execution from cargo preparation or availability at origin to its arrival at the plant or delivery to the customer, as applicable.

This position will be responsible for coordinating the documentary, logistical, customs, banking, and administrative aspects associated with foreign trade operations, ensuring compliance with deadlines, costs, regulatory requirements, and established commercial terms.

It will also provide support to the Purchasing unit in issuing and tracking purchase orders, requesting and analyzing quotes, contacting national and international suppliers, and other activities necessary to guarantee the timely supply of materials, products, and services required by the company.

The role requires ongoing interaction with suppliers, customers, customs brokers, freight forwarders, carriers, and internal departments such as Planning, Engineering, Warehouse, Finance, Sales, and Contract Administration.

Responsabilidades Esenciales

- Comprehensive management of import operations, from cargo availability at origin to shipment entry and administrative closure; ensuring operations within expected costs and timeframes, as well as regulatory and documentary compliance at origin and destination.
- Comprehensive management of export operations, from cargo availability at our facility to delivery to the customer according to the agreed INCOTERM; ensuring on-time delivery and regulatory and documentary compliance at origin and destination.
- Management of purchase orders to foreign suppliers, from requesting quotes, comparing alternatives, reviewing terms/costs/deadlines, to awarding and formally placing the purchase order.
- Monitoring and activation of external purchase orders, focusing on meeting supplier-promised and customer-committed delivery dates, as well as consolidating shipments for cost optimization.
- Development of new suppliers according to the corporate process for adding, removing, and modifying suppliers.
- Support for local purchasing processes, both for production and non-production.
- Collaborate with Planning, Engineering, Quality, Warehouse, Finance, and Sales to ensure on-time and cost-effective delivery and identify opportunities for shared process improvement.
- Maintain up-to-date records of information and key performance indicators for the area to ensure traceability, control, and reporting of our work.

Requisitos del Puesto

Minimum professional and educational background required (including years of experience).

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Foreign Trade, International Trade, or Customs Administration
- Experience: 3 to 4 years of experience in import and export operations, preferably in manufacturing companies.
- Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office tools, especially Outlook. Intermediate/advanced English, primarily for reading and reviewing documentation, written communication, and contacting international suppliers.

Experience with ERP systems.

¡Bienvenidos a Rhenus!
El Grupo Rhenus es uno de los principales proveedores de servicios logísticos que operan a nivel mundial. Ofrecemos soluciones a medida a lo largo de toda la cadena de suministro para empresas de una amplia diversidad de sectores. Desde transportes multimodales hasta almacenes perfectos, desde un despacho aduanero fluido hasta servicios innovadores de valor añadido: siempre mantenemos el pulso puntual y estamos al lado de nuestros clientes.

¿Qué haras?

El puesto de Customer Service Import es responsable de coordinar y dar seguimiento integral a las operaciones de importación marítima, asegurando una comunicación fluida entre clientes, agentes, navieras y áreas internas. Su objetivo es garantizar que cada embarque se gestione de manera eficiente, desde la recepción de la instrucción de carga hasta la liberación y entrega final, brindando un servicio de calidad y una experiencia satisfactoria para el cliente.

¿Cómo contribuirás a nuestra visión?

- Inicio de la operación: Recepción y análisis de instrucciones del cliente o booking order, validación de datos críticos (tipo de carga, Incoterm, puertos, volumen y fechas) y coordinación inmediata con origen.
- Booking y coordinación: Gestión de reservas con navieras/agentes, envío de SOP, validación y aprobación de pre-bookings, revisión y aprobación de documentación (HBL/MBL), coordinación de retiro/entrega de contenedores y seguimiento del cumplimiento del booking.
- Gestión documental: Revisión de documentos y prealertas, solicitud y vinculación de órdenes de venta, generación de estimados de costos y gestión de correcciones documentales cuando corresponda.
- Seguimiento del embarque: Monitoreo continuo desde el zarpe hasta el arribo, envío de actualizaciones al cliente, emisión de avisos de arribo, prefacturación y control de disponibilidad documental.
- Cierre previo al arribo: Solicitud de seguros, coordinación de custodias o monitoreos cuando aplique y articulación con áreas internas para asegurar la correcta liberación y entrega de la carga.
- Coordinación logística: Organización de traslados a depósitos fiscales o privados, gestión documental y pagos asociados, y coordinación de la logística según las necesidades del cliente y los tiempos de arribo.
¿Qué habilidades y experiencia nos aportas?

- Estudiante avanzado o graduado/a de Comercio Exterior, Logística, o carreras afines.
- Experiencia previa en freight forwarding.
- Manejo de sistemas operativos (deseable)

¿Qué puedes esperar?

- Formación continua: Afina tus habilidades y mejora tu experiencia con nuestros programas de desarrollo profesional.
- Gran equipo: Son realmente las personas las que marcan la diferencia - y con nosotros te unirás al mejor equipo que hay.
- Jerarquías planas: Llega directamente a los responsables de la toma de decisiones gracias a nuestra estructura organizativa simplificada.
- Espacio para la innovación: Convierte tus ideas en acción en un entorno que defienda la creatividad y te emplace para liderar el cambio.
- Eventos: Desde salidas en equipo hasta fiestas navideñas y eventos de networking, construimos conexiones sólidas pasando tiempo de calidad juntos.
- Procesos de decisión rápida: Haz que las cosas ocurran más rápido con procesos simplificados que fomenten la eficiencia y la eficacia.

The Logistics Specialist reviews shipment and tank data, resolves system issues, and makes safety-based decisions to prevent delivery incidents before they occur.

It is ideal for individuals who are analytical, tech‑savvy, and quick learners, with an interest in logistics, safety, enterprise systems and people-oriented. What You Will Do

- Coordinate with Ecolab field teams and account representatives to resolve delivery or system issues
- Respond to Chemtrec alerts related to in‑transit incidents, damaged packages, or chemical events; assist with coordination when escalation is required
- Generate and maintain delivery compliance and safety data, supporting reporting and continuous improvement initiatives

Work Schedule

- Roles available across varied schedules, including Monday - Friday, weekends, evenings, and overnight shifts
- Work hours aligned to business needs and global delivery operations

Minimum Qualifications

- High School Diploma or equivalent
- 1 year of logistics, operations, supply chain, customer service or related experience or demonstrated ability to quickly learn complex operational roles
- Strong computer skills (including enterprise systems) with the ability to work across multiple systems simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

- 1 year of SAP experience (or strong aptitude and exposure to ERP or enterprise systems)
- Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Teams) or similar productivity tools
- Demonstrated ability to learn new systems quickly and adapt to changing processes
- Interest in logistics, safety, transportation, or operations environments

postings.title: AJC International: Logistic Facilitator, Logistic Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
AJC is a world leader in frozen and refrigerated food products, marketing poultry, pork, meat, seafood, vegetables and fruits around the globe. Our products and customers are located across more than 140 countries on six continents. Our multicultural workforce represents over 34 nationalities speaking more than 23 languages. For more than 40 years, we have focused on one goal — making our clients more successful. To learn more about AJC, visit our website at www.ajcfood.com

Position Overview

AJC is looking for a results-driven, dynamic and detail-oriented logistics professional to join our team in the role of Logistic Facilitator, Logistic Specialist. This person will be responsible for daily interfaces between our internal customers and external vendors. The position requires interaction with all functional departments of AJC, including 18 sales & operational regions, and around 20 outside vendors. The ideal candidate should have business acumen, extensive Logistic and Operation industry knowledge, and should be a creative problem solver.

Essential Duties

Including but not limited to:

- Handle the schedules of our main warehouses lit
- Update our system with the information of our schedules
- Work with our operations, warehousing and transportation team to coordinate the loading of cargo
- Overseeing the loading process with the warehouse. (Main focus on every stage of the cargo along the loading process)
- Daily communication with customer service representatives at cold storages
- Daily communication with dray carriers’ customer service
- Analyze daily vessel schedules and the impact on our schedules
- Work with our transportation and operations team daily on bookings, pulling empty cntrs, returning cntrs and any cost that may arise from it
- Analyze potential charges caused during the logistics and guide our operations team on how to proceed.
- Discuss discounts with external vendors
- Work with our Strategic supply on product availability and optimize the scheduling to keep a high quality standard of loading.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and performance. Offer ideas on how to implement positive changes.

Essential Skills

- Strong sense of urgency
- Results driven
- Exceptional organizational skills
- Creativity in problem solving
- High attention to detail
- Ability to multitask & prioritize
- Ability to work under stressful situations
- Able to clearly and concisely communicate verbally and via email.
- Able to work independently and with other team members.
- Quick learner

Education & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Foreign Trade or equivalent experience required.
- Ideally 1 - 2 years of experience in Logistics
- Knowledge of inventory and warehousing procedures is highly valued
- The ideal candidate should be pro-active, positive, energetic, and able to work under pressure.

Language Requirements

- Candidate is required to read, write, and speak Spanish and English fluently.

If you are organized, analytical, and ready to thrive in a high-impact logistics environment, we would love to hear from you.

postings.title: Import Global Trade Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

Position Summary

Ciena is seeking an Import Global Trade Analyst to play a vital role in supporting the organization’s import operations and ensuring compliance with North American trade regulations. This position is integral to managing daily operational tasks, including broker entry reviews, import classifications, and process optimization. The analyst will also oversee audits, record-keeping, reconciliation, and duty drawback processes, while fostering collaboration with internal teams and external partners to streamline import activities.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and proactive professional with a foundational understanding of international trade regulations, a commitment to continuous improvement, and a willingness to learn and grow in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Broker Entry Audits: Review broker entries for accuracy, timely clearance, proper payment of duties/fees, and compliance with Section 232 tariffs, USMCA requirements, and Certificates of Origin (CoO).
- Food & Drug Administration (FDA) Compliance: Verify FDA import details, manage broker requests, and follow up on required documentation.
- Day-to Day Import Activity Management: Monitor pre-alerts, broker requests, missing information, and exceptions to ensure timely and accurate filing and resolution.
- Duty and Fee Accounting: Assign Automated Clearing House (ACH) codes for accurate payment and reconciliation of duties and fees.
- Audits and Metrics: Conduct audits, including Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT), broker performance metrics, and Anti-Dumping/Countervailing Duties (AD/CVD) compliance.
- Temporary Import Bonds (TIBs): Track and ensure proper closure of TIBs.
- Corrections and Reconciliation: Prepare documents for Post Summary Corrections (PSC), 520(d) claims, flag reviews, and file submissions to customs authorities.
- Duty Drawback: Manage processes to recover eligible duties and taxes on exported goods.
- Record Keeping: Maintain accurate import records for audits and regulatory compliance.
- Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with customs brokers, logistics partners, and internal teams to resolve import-related issues and ensure smooth operations.
- Regulatory Compliance: Monitor global trade regulations and tariff changes, ensuring adherence to customs requirements and company policies.
- Reporting: Prepare regular reports on shipment status, duty costs, and compliance metrics.
- Process Improvements: Support special projects to optimize import operations and enhance trade compliance.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in International Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field.

Experience: Internship or coursework in international trade, logistics, or supply chain preferred but not required.

Skills And Knowledge

- Fluent in English communication both verbal and written.
- Basic knowledge of import/export processes and global trade regulations.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and identify trends.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with trade management software is a plus.
- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Problem-Solving: Ability to identify and resolve import-related challenges efficiently.
- Adaptability: Willingness to learn and adapt to changes in global trade regulations and business needs.
- Team Collaboration: Work effectively in cross-functional teams and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders.
- Time Management: Prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

postings.title: Jefe de Abastecimiento (Compras y Comercio Exterior)
postings.descriptionText:
Principales responsabilidades

- Conducir la operación diaria de Compras Locales y Comercio Exterior, liderando a los equipos y asegurando el abastecimiento oportuno para Producción y para la comercialización.
- Gestionar compras de insumos productivos (APIs, materias primas, materiales de empaque) y no productivos (mantenimiento, servicios y gastos generales).
- Diseñar e implementar una gestión por indicadores (KPIs) apoyada en SAP y otros sistemas, con reportes mensuales a la Gerencia.
- Elaborar y presentar planes anuales por categoría de compra, con objetivos de ahorro.
- Desarrollar contratos marco y acuerdos anuales con proveedores, migrando de un esquema de compras individuales a uno planificado.
- Liderar la homologación y el desarrollo de proveedores alternativos, en conjunto con Calidad.
- Participar en la definición de un esquema de niveles de aprobación para la liberación de órdenes de compra.
- Supervisar el proceso integral de importación y exportación, incluyendo regímenes de importación, documentación, clasificación arancelaria, pagos al exterior y coordinación con forwarders, despachantes y depósitos fiscales.
- Asegurar el cumplimiento normativo ante Aduana, ARCA, BCRA, ANMAT e INAME.
- Coordinar con Planeamiento, Producción, Calidad, Marketing y Finanzas para alinear necesidades, stocks y flujo de pagos.
- Acompañar los proyectos de transformación del área de Abastecimiento.

Requisitos Requisitos

- Título universitario en Ingeniería, Administración, Comercio Exterior, Logística o carreras afines.
- Experiencia comprobable liderando equipos de Compras y/o Comercio Exterior (mínimo 3 años en posiciones de conducción).
- Experiencia en industria farmacéutica, química o regulada.
- Conocimiento de compras de insumos productivos y de la dinámica con fabricantes y proveedores regulados.
- Conocimiento de normativa aduanera y cambiaria argentina y de los regímenes de importación vigentes.
- Experiencia en implementación de KPIs, reportes de gestión y planificación por categorías.
- Manejo de ERP (preferentemente SAP) y Excel avanzado.

Deseable

- Experiencia en negociación de contratos marco y acuerdos anuales.
- Participación en proyectos de transformación o mejora de procesos en áreas de abastecimiento.
- Inglés intermedio o avanzado.

Competencias

- Liderazgo y capacidad de gestión de equipos diversos y con trayectoria.
- Visión estratégica e integral del abastecimiento.
- Organización, planificación y orientación a resultados.
- Capacidad analítica y atención al detalle.
- Negociación y comunicación efectiva con áreas internas y actores externos.
- Gestión de riesgos regulatorios y operativos.

Beneficios

Se ofrecen excelentes condiciones de contratación.

Sobre la posición

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Jefe/a de Abastecimiento para sumarse a un importante laboratorio farmacéutico en un momento de crecimiento y transformación del área.

La posición tendrá a cargo de forma integral las áreas de Compras Locales y Comercio Exterior. Será la persona responsable de conducir la operación diaria y de impulsar una gestión más estratégica, basada en indicadores, planificación por categorías y desarrollo de proveedores.

Modalidad 4x1 I CABA

postings.title: AI-Driven Lead Engineer (Logistics & Transportation)
postings.descriptionText: Company OverviewAt Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.Position DescriptionWe're looking for an experienced technical lead with an AI-driven mindset, who already knows how to get more out of a team by working alongside AI agents.The team combines developers and QA engineers with AI agents covering product, business, development and QA work, all building production systems for one of North America's largest transportation companies. Deciding what each of them works on, giving them the right context and reviewing their output sits at the center of the job.Much of the work happens close to the business. Workshops with product owners and stakeholders are where assumptions get challenged, scope gets negotiated and goals become clear, buildable work. Delivery runs in short cycles: build something real, validate it with stakeholders, learn and adjust. Keeping architects, QA, product, and the DevOps and cloud teams aligned, and coaching the wider team in this way of working, completes the picture.Responsibilities Own delivery. Take full responsibility for what the team ships, including quality, timelines and production stability. Lead people. Manage a team of dev and QA engineers, covering priorities, growth and team health. Work with the business. Run discovery and requirements workshops with product owners and business stakeholders, negotiate scope, and turn the outcomes into clear specs. Product decisions stay with the client. Iterate in short cycles. Ship working increments quickly, validate them with product, business, QA and architecture, and feed what you learn into the next cycle. Align stakeholders. Keep architects, QA, product, and the DevOps and cloud teams on the same page, and explain trade-offs in terms each audience understands. Run AI agents. Coordinate agents across product, business, dev and QA work: break down tasks, run them in parallel, verify the output. Own the architecture. Design and evolve .NET microservices on Azure, built around events on Confluent Kafka. Curate the agents' knowledge. Maintain the specs, ADRs, conventions and skills that make agents reliable, and keep them up to date. Hold the quality bar. Test-first development, automated pre-PR gates, and security and correctness review of all AI-generated output. Coach the team. Help engineers adopt AI-augmented ways of working, mainly by example.Workplace: This is a remote position open to candidates based in LATAM willing to work Central Timezone hoursMust Have SkillsLeadership and communication10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years as technical lead of a mixed team (dev, QA, DevOps) of at least 5 people.Has delivered and supported production systems, APIs and UI products.Track record of delivering in short build-and-validate cycles, getting regular feedback from stakeholders and adjusting direction based on it.Experience facilitating workshops with both technical and business audiences.Comfortable working with architects, QA, product owners, business leaders, and DevOps and cloud teams.Client-facing experience; English at C1/C2 level, spoken and written.Technical depth (demonstrable without AI).NET 10+ and C# at expert level.Azure: Functions, Container Apps/AKS, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Managed Identity.Event-driven microservices on Kafka, ideally Confluent (Schema Registry, delivery semantics, idempotency).API design, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and testing strategy.Preferred SkillsOkta / OIDC / OAuth2Cosmos DB, Redis, OpenTelemetryTrucking, freight, telematics/IoT or fleet domain experienceGitHub Copilot agent mode, Claude Code, MCP or RAGProfessional SkillsStrong English written and verbal communication Excellent problem-solving skills and comfort operating in a fast-paced, iterative environmentStrong organizational and time management skillsStrong team and individual playerMaintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by natureHigh standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality resultsHow We Work With AIThis is how we build, and we'll help you go deep on it. Hands-on experience with any of the following is a strong plus; the rest you'll pick up with us.Running agents on real work. Coordinating several AI agents at once on delivery work, not just using a chat assistant.Giving agents the right context. Writing rules files, skills and specs that noticeably improve what agents produce.Building the harness, not just the prompt. Setting up tools and guardrails (analyzers, architecture tests, type and contract checks, hooks, pre-commit gates, MCP tools) that keep agents on track and make their output accurate by design.Proving the output is right. Where correctness isn't obvious, such as a front-end, creating ways for agents to check their own work: Playwright E2E flows, visual regression baselines, screenshot diffs, contract tests and golden datasets. "Done" means proven, not assumed.Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

postings.title: Gerente de operaciones
postings.descriptionText:
En Cerro Indumentaria S.A. nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Gerente de Operaciones para liderar, coordinar y optimizar los procesos operativos de la compañía, garantizando la eficiencia de la producción textil, el abastecimiento, la gestión de inventarios y la logística y distribución.
Buscamos un perfil con capacidad de liderazgo, visión integral del negocio y orientación a resultados, que impulse la mejora continua, optimice los recursos disponibles y asegure el cumplimiento de los objetivos operativos y comerciales.
Principales responsabilidades

- Producción Textil: planificar y controlar la producción en las plantas de Mendoza y San Luis, coordinando las etapas de fabricación, la distribución de cargas de trabajo y la disponibilidad de materias primas e insumos.
- Gestión de calidad: garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares y especificaciones de los productos, supervisar los controles de calidad y promover acciones preventivas y correctivas.
- Abastecimiento e inventarios: coordinar con Compras las necesidades de insumos y mercadería de reventa, controlar los niveles de stock en plantas y sucursales, y asegurar la exactitud de los inventarios físicos y del sistema.
- Logística y distribución: supervisar la preparación, el embalaje y el despacho de pedidos, coordinando el transporte y asegurando entregas completas, correctas y dentro de los plazos establecidos.
- Liderazgo y gestión de equipos: dirigir y desarrollar equipos de trabajo, organizar tareas, evaluar el desempeño y fomentar una cultura de eficiencia y mejora continua.
- Análisis y mejora de procesos: monitorear indicadores clave de gestión (KPIs), analizar resultados, identificar desvíos e implementar mejoras para optimizar costos, tiempos y productividad.
- Gestión transversal: trabajar en conjunto con las áreas Comercial, Compras, Finanzas y Recursos Humanos, participar en proyectos de implementación de herramientas y procesos, y elaborar informes de gestión para la dirección.

Requisitos y perfil buscado

- Formación universitaria completa en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Logística o carreras afines.
- Experiencia en gestión de operaciones, planificación y control de producción, abastecimiento, inventarios y cadena de suministro.
- Experiencia liderando equipos de trabajo y gestionando proyectos de mejora de procesos.
- Sólida capacidad analítica para interpretar datos, indicadores y resultados operativos.
- Habilidades de organización, planificación, priorización, toma de decisiones y resolución de problemas.
- Manejo avanzado de herramientas informáticas y sistemas de gestión (ERP/CRM).
- Buenas habilidades de comunicación, coordinación y trabajo interdisciplinario.
- Orientación a resultados, eficiencia operativa y mejora continua.
Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en la industria textil, indumentaria o retail.
Propuesta
La posición representa una oportunidad para asumir un rol estratégico en la gestión operativa de la compañía, liderando procesos clave y contribuyendo al crecimiento, la productividad y la eficiencia del negocio.

En DHL Supply Chain nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un(a) Gerente de Desarrollo de Negocios Logístico (Business Development) para la gerencia de Business Development con base en Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Es una posición estratégica responsable de identificar, desarrollar y cerrar oportunidades comerciales en el mercado argentino, impulsando la expansión de DHL Supply Chain en el país.

Responsabilidades principales

- Liderar el desarrollo y la venta de nuevos negocios logísticos, potenciando el crecimiento de la compañía en Argentina.
- Identificar, analizar y desarrollar oportunidades estratégicas en los sectores logísticos, de transporte y supply chain del mercado local.
- Diseñar y ejecutar el plan de ventas según productos, sectores y clientes claves.
- Construir y fortalecer relaciones comerciales de largo plazo con clientes estratégicos y actores relevantes del ecosistema logístico argentino.
- Elaborar y presentar propuestas de valor, soluciones integrales y presentaciones técnico-comerciales.
- Gestionar procesos comerciales y de licitación, asegurando seguimiento, disciplina operativa y cumplimiento de los procesos internos.

Requisitos

- Título profesional en Ingeniería o carreras afines.
- Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en roles comerciales o de venta de servicios logísticos.

postings.descriptionText:
Ecolab Services is seeking an Associate Planning Manager to join our Global Business Solutions (GBS) organization in Buenos Aires. This is a highly cross-functional position connecting procurement, suppliers, manufacturing facilities, finished good planning, and additional stakeholders/resources. In this role, you will be accountable for developing and leading the execution of raw material plans to resolve material supply gaps, ensuring customer requirements are met while balancing service, inventory, and cost objectives.

You will act as a key liaison between production and both internal and external stakeholders, manage performance against key organizational KPIs, and apply project management skills to participate in and/or lead significant continuous improvement initiatives with measurable business impact. Additionally, you will provide onsite leadership support for other planners located in BA.

What’s In It For You

- Opportunity for a long-term career path that allows for exposure into all areas of Ecolab’s supply chain
- Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology
- Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture, and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world

What You Will Do

- Effectively communicate and collaborate with procurement, suppliers, internal plant personnel, central planning, supply chain management, and others. Own the communication, coordination, and solution when our network is facing supply issues/shortages, escalating and leading hypercare discussions when appropriate. Must show ability to recognize future stock-out dates, inventory needs, and future requirements, then clearly show the path to resolution.
- Directly manage a small team of raw material supply planners. Support recruiting, onboarding, talent planning, and training for both direct and indirect reports. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and motivational team environment. Drive local team engagement initiatives and resolution of onsite technical and operational issues.
- Understand and resolve areas of risk in the material planning processes that could disrupt the greater supply chain.
- Coach the network materials team to drive continuous improvement of the material planning processes. Identify and implement best practices to improve results for our Key Performance Indicators as part of the OGSM management process.
- Collaborate with procurement and material planners on supplier transitions & improvement opportunities.
- Identify and implement best practices to improve results for assigned metrics. Lead complex, high-impact, cross-functional supply chain projects that impact safety, quality, service, and cost.
- Manage inventory and achieve required inventory levels across network stocking locations to meet customer service levels. Address inventory imbalances and implement corrective actions.

Minimum Qualifications

-

- Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or related field of study
- 6+ years of work experience in supply chain planning, manufacturing, logistics, or related discipline
- 1+ years experience leading others and effectively resolving conflicts
- High level of proficiency with ERPs and MS Office (primarily Excel)
- Demonstrated ability to implement communication strategies that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
- Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills to drive decisions and build consensus among stakeholders
- Ability to successfully navigate through ambiguous and complex situations
- Fluent in English
- Visa to travel to the US, ability to work typical Eastern Standard Time business hours
Preferred Qualifications

-

- Advanced technical or business degree, MBA preferred
- SAP Experience highly desirable
- Experience in operational excellence and project management such as TPM, Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, Green Belt, etc.
- APICS Certification
Nuestro compromiso con una cultura de inclusión y pertenencia

Ecolab está comprometido con el trato justo e igualitario de todas las personas colaboradoras y postulantes, y con la promoción de los principios de igualdad de oportunidades en el empleo. Reclutaremos, contrataremos, promoveremos, transferiremos y brindaremos oportunidades de desarrollo con base en las calificaciones individuales y el desempeño laboral, en todos los aspectos relacionados con el empleo, la compensación, los beneficios, las condiciones laborales y las oportunidades de crecimiento. La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cooltura y nuestra organización. The Opportunity

We are looking for a strategic, technology-forward leader to help modernize how Group Benefits Finance delivers sales reporting, analytics, and performance insights. In this role, you will shape the future of reporting by building scalable, trusted, and cloud-enabled analytics capabilities that help senior leaders make faster, data-driven decisions.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of finance, data, technology, and transformation. You will partner across Finance, Distribution, Compensation, Operations, Technology, and Enterprise Data to advance self-service analytics, automation, AI-enabled solutions, and modern data platforms, including Azure cloud and Databricks.

- Create executive dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and self-service analytics tools that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
- Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting activities, improve data quality, and simplify how teams consume and act on information.
- Translate business needs into practical data, analytics, and technology solutions that support growth, efficiency, and better decision-making.
- Influence and collaborate across Finance, Distribution, Compensation, Operations, Technology, and Enterprise Data to align modernization priorities with business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in finance, analytics, reporting, business intelligence, data management, sales operations, or a related field, preferably within insurance or financial services, with experience leading reporting modernization, data transformation, or technology-enabled process improvement initiatives.
- Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal) – mandatory requirement.
- Strong technical fluency with modern analytics tools and platforms, including Power BI, Power Platform, Alteryx, SQL, and cloud-based data environments such as Azure and Databricks or similar cloud analytics platforms.
- Ability to turn business questions into data models, dashboards, automated workflows, and clear recommendations.
- Experience leveraging generative AI and emerging technologies to improve business processes, enhance analytical capabilities, increase productivity, and accelerate data-driven decision making. Demonstrated ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs, apply appropriate governance and controls, and drive responsible adoption across teams.
- Strong data governance, metric definition, data quality, and control mindset.
- Ability to build strong relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional partners, influence priorities, and lead through change.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise data modernization, cloud migration, reporting transformation, or self-service analytics programs.
- Certifications in Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Power Platform, Alteryx, AI, analytics, business intelligence, or data science.

MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Economics, or a related discipline

postings.title: Data Analytics Engineer
postings.descriptionText: About ToptalToptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.Job Summary:Toptal prides itself on being a data-driven organization. The primary objective of the Data Analytics Engineer is to help drive business impact and better decision making by laying the data foundation for a world-class analytics function. This role will be critical to fostering trust in our data and confidence in our decisions.Our Data Analytics Engineers focus on creating a data environment that is conducive to analytics and business decision making. You will own and maintain the data transformation layer. This will require data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security), data modeling (structure, relationships, integrity), technical communication (data dictionaries, user training), quality control (code reviews, data validation), raw data analysis, and building AI data systems and pipelines. You will be the product owner for our data warehouse and will coordinate closely with our functional Business Analysts on one side, and Data Engineers on the other.This role sits within the Business Analytics Center of Excellence and will ensure trustworthy data is available for all downstream data users. Positive relationships with both Data Engineers and Business Analysts will be key, but you must also think independently and bring your own point of view. To be successful in this role you must live and breathe SQL daily and be a critical thinker, problem solver and self-starter.This role requires an AI-heavy workflow and skillset. We’ve transformed our codebase to be instrumented for agentic development and continue to build our internal AI tooling, and you will be part of this process. Fluency with using LLMs and agentic coding tools is a requirement of this role. The flip side of that is the part machines cannot do: understanding our business and metrics deeply, and making decisions on what matters and what doesn’t in terms of pushing the company’s business objectives forward.This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.Responsibilities:The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.Design, write, review and ship SQL models across our repositories that transform raw data into usable data products for all organizational stakeholders. Own and maintain the transformation layer. Proactively work with the Data Engineers to ensure new data sources are added and available, and then modeled and published in our data warehouse. Proactively monitor the data warehouse and extract insights to identify opportunities to improve data operations, data accuracy and quality, coverage, integrity, structure, and general usability. Turn ambiguous business asks into modeled data. Run requirements gathering with stakeholders. Establish the grain, surface the edge cases, write down the business rules, and push back when the request would produce a misleading number. Implement measures and processes to improve data quality, accuracy, coverage, lineage, access and retention across dozens of source production databases. Own the data dictionary. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer. Diagnose and resolve data incidents. Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment. Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making. Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations. Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse. In the first week, expect to:Onboard and integrate into Toptal, and begin learning our history, culture and vision. Get your environment running end to end: GCP access, BigQuery, the Dataform repositories, and our agentic development tooling. Shadow the teams whose data you will own to learn the core of Toptal’s operations and capabilities, including Growth, Talent Operations, Enterprise, and SMB. In the first month, expect to:Understand the data generated through company operations and activities and where/how that data is stored. Understand our ETL processes, timing, tools, monitoring, roadmap, and pain points. Understand our source systems, and where they fit into our business processes. Start receiving and researching inbound data questions from Business Analysts. Build your first Dataform pull request independently and start reviewing your teammates’ PRs. In the first three months, expect to:Develop a mastery of our core data elements and entities. Begin standardizing definitions and creating SQL logic to push definitions into the data layer. Be a first responder for data incidents, diagnosing root cause with evidence and a methodical approach. Begin documenting data flows, definitions, calculation methodologies, and data elements to continuously build and improve the semantic layer. In the first six months, expect to:Contribute architectural ideas that impact our data environment and pipelines. Exercise discretion and independent judgment. Be an integral part of the analytics team that ensures a world-class data warehouse service to our stakeholders. In the first year, expect to:Play a critical part in setting up the Business Analytics Center of Excellence for success. Be the person the organization trusts about what a number means and whether it can be believed. Have made the warehouse meaningfully more usable by both analysts and AI agents. Qualifications and Job Requirements:Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field. 4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models. Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python. Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. You already use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent as part of your daily working practice. You know where they are reliable, where they should not be used, and how to verify their output. Experience with cloud data warehousing, such as BigQuery or Snowflake. Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands. Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment. Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. You can read a DAG, understand its schedule and dependencies, and find out why a task failed. Process discipline. Jira, ticket hygiene, and code review etiquette. It’s mandatory you understand how to avoid shipping unverified LLM-generated code. Experience in doing exploratory/raw data analysis, data modeling, and data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security, etc.). Experience translating business logic and objectives into SQL code and linking data and analytics to business strategy and operations to drive real impact. Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.). Detail oriented, methodical, and thorough. Team player who builds strong relationships and collaborates with others. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues in a simple and intuitive way. Ability to work collaboratively and independently; take ownership of quality, accuracy, and timeliness of deliverables. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. For Toptal Use Only: #northamerica #centralamerica #southamerica
