Dexerto Entertainment Group is an award-winning publisher and creative studio at the heart of digital culture.

Across gaming, entertainment, sports, technology and food, we build highly engaged communities and help brands become part of the conversations that matter to them.

Through social media, branded content, creator marketing and advertising technology, we connect our partners with hundreds of millions of gaming and entertainment fans around the world.

With more than 30 million social followers and over two billion monthly social impressions, Dexerto combines the reach of a global media publisher with the creativity and production expertise of a modern content studio.

From viral social campaigns to original branded series and custom video productions, we create work that engages audiences and delivers meaningful results for our brand partners.

The Role:
We are looking for a talented Video Editor to join our branded content and commercial video team.

This is a hands-on editing role working across a broad mix of branded video content, from fast-turnaround social-first campaigns to long-form content and commercial productions.

The successful candidate will be a creative and adaptable editor, able to adjust their approach depending on the platform, audience, campaign and production scale while maintaining consistently high editorial standards.

You will work closely with our Video Production, Creative, Commercial and Marketing teams to turn campaign ideas, talent shoots and raw footage into engaging content that connects brands with audiences across gaming, entertainment and online culture.

You will be comfortable taking ownership of edits, bringing strong storytelling instincts, creative ideas and technical ability to each project while working closely with Producers and the wider post-production team.

The role is fully remote and must be based in South America, with working hours aligned to US Eastern Time (ET) to ensure sufficient crossover with colleagues in the United Kingdom and United States.

Fluent written and spoken English is essential, as the role involves daily collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across the United Kingdom and United States.

Key Responsibilities:

Edit branded video content across short-form, social-first, long-form and commercial formats, taking projects from initial assembly through to final delivery.
Shape raw footage into engaging, well-paced content with strong storytelling, structure and visual style, adapting the approach to suit the platform, audience and campaign.
Collaborate closely with Producers, Creative Strategists and the wider Video Production team to deliver the strongest possible creative execution.
Edit a variety of content including talent-led interviews, creator content, branded entertainment, multi-camera productions and platform-first social video.
Create and integrate motion graphics, titles, animation, sound design and other visual treatments where appropriate.
Adapt content across multiple platforms, formats, aspect ratios and campaign deliverables while maintaining consistency and quality.
Manage internal, agency and client feedback effectively, balancing creative standards with deadlines and campaign requirements.
Manage multiple concurrent edits through to final delivery, maintaining strong organization, technical standards and a high standard of finishing across color correction, audio mixing, sound design and overall visual and audio quality control.

Essential Experience and Skills:

Experience editing branded content, commercial video, digital content or social video within a media company, publisher, creative agency, production company or similar environment.
A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent editing, storytelling and technical ability across a range of styles and formats.
Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.
Strong understanding of pacing, structure, music, sound design, motion graphics and visual storytelling.
Experience editing both short-form and long-form digital content for platforms such as YouTube, TikTok and Instagram.
The ability to work independently, take ownership of projects and make confident editorial decisions.
Strong organization and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and rounds of stakeholder and client feedback.
Experience preparing projects and assets for external motion graphics, VFX, animation, audio and finishing workflows, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues and maintain quality control throughout the process.
Fluent written and spoken English, with experience collaborating effectively with remote and international teams.

Portfolio Requirement:
Applicants must provide links to relevant work demonstrating their editing experience across digital, social or branded video.

Applicants without a portfolio will not be considered.

postings.descriptionText:
Estamos revolucionando las finanzas en América Latina 🚀

Fundada en 2017, Ualá nació con la misión de llevar los servicios financieros en América Latina al Siglo XXI. Hoy, ya somos el neobanco de más de 11 millones de usuarios y seguimos creciendo para transformar la industria en la región con soluciones fáciles y accesibles.

Con presencia en Argentina, México y Colombia, seguimos expandiendo nuestro ecosistema con productos innovadores en Medios de Pago, Crédito, Inversiones y soluciones para comercios con Ualá Bis. Además, logramos la ronda de inversión más grande de la región en los últimos años y seguimos sumando talento para hacer realidad nuestra visión.

Si querés ser parte de un equipo de +1100 personas que desafía lo establecido, trabaja con la mejor tecnología y siempre pone a las personas en el centro, ¡sumate a Ualá!

#LoMejorEstáPorVenir

Buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Credit Profitability Analyst que tendrá como misión diseñar, evaluar y optimizar las estrategias de pricing y la estructura de rentabilidad de productos crediticios y de captación maximizando el margen y el retorno financiero del portafolio.

Tendrás El Desafío De

Estructurar propuestas de pricing diferencial por cluster de riesgo y plazos para préstamos personales, tarjetas y POS, evaluando curvas de tasas y su impacto en la rentabilidad.Desarrollar, mantener y monitorear modelos de crédito (riesgo, pricing, pérdida esperada), asegurando su precisión, vigencia y mejora continua.Diseñar, monitorear y evaluar experimentos de pricing (Champion-Challenger / Test de tasas) midiendo la conversión (CR), ticket promedio, plazo e impacto en mora temprana (FPF).Ejecutar el seguimiento diario y por cosecha de la originación, asegurando el backtesting de la política (Loan loss, tenors, precancelaciones, gastos y métricas TIR/ROE).Colaborar con ALM, Underwriting y Credit Risk para garantizar el alineamiento entre targets de retorno, Unit Economics y proyecciones de incobrabilidad.Realizar análisis de Unit Economics, margen neto, payback y valor del cliente por cohortes. (cosecha), identificando desvíos versus lo planeado y sus causas raíz.Participar activamente en la construcción de procesos de Forecast y Budget dentro de la vertical, liderando el armado de escenarios y supuestos.Elaborar y revisar informes de gestión periódicos, garantizando la integridad de los datos y la claridad en el análisis.

Qué buscamos para este rol

Experiencia de 1 a 2 años en posiciones analíticas de Pricing, Rentabilidad, Planning & Control o Riesgo de Crédito en entidades financieras, fintechs o bancos (deseable)Manejo sólido y fluido de bases de datos mediante SQL y BigQuery (excluyente).Universitario completo o en curso en carreras afines a Finanzas, Economía, Administración, Ingeniería o Sistemas.Manejo de herramientas de visualización de datos como Looker Studio, Tableau o Power BI (excluyente).Conocimiento en metodologías de rentabilidad (deseable).Comprensión de métricas de riesgo crediticio (Loan Loss, FPF, Bad Rates, Provisiones) (deseable).Uso de asistentes analíticos de IA para optimización de queries y automatización.

¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá?

¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá?Queremos compartir con vos...

Ambiente laboral flexible, en crecimiento y con un enorme potencial de desarrollo profesional.Acceso a formación en instituciones educativas de primer nivel con descuentos en capacitaciones, cursos y carreras.Valoramos el equilibrio entre la vida profesional y personal, por eso contamos con tres semanas de vacaciones, licencias extendidas, día libre en tu cumpleaños, políticas de trabajo flexible y más.También brindamos cobertura de medicina prepaga para grupo familiar, descuento en gimnasios, cashback del 70% en tus compras con la tarjeta de Ualá con tope de reintegro, bono por referidos y otros beneficios que te acompañan dentro y fuera del trabajo.

Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de la diversidad de miradas y experiencias, por eso, creamos un espacio seguro y colaborativo, en el que todas las voces cuentan.En Ualá contamos con representantes de 11 nacionalidades, de diversos orígenes y experiencias. El 46% del equipo son mujeres, un hito en una empresa tecnológico-financiera. Si lo comparamos con América Latina, menos del 30% del personal que trabaja en empresas fintech son mujeres. Esa diversidad nos fortalece y es la única manera de desarrollar un producto inclusivo para competir con las mejores empresas de la región y el mundo.Si te motiva transformar la industria y hacer las cosas de otra manera, te estamos buscando. Porque desde el primer día construímos el equipo con una máxima: sólo el mejor equipo puede hacer el mejor producto. Por eso contratar, retener, y apostar al talento es lo más importante que hacemos.

#Sumate

postings.descriptionText:
Estamos en búsqueda de una persona con mirada estratégica y espíritu de mejora continua para integrarse al equipo de Administración y Finanzas. Su misión será transformar las prioridades estratégicas del negocio en soluciones concretas procesos más ágiles, información confiable y una operación más eficiente que acompañe nuestro crecimiento.

Buscamos a un profesional proactivo y creativo. Si te apasionan los desafíos y formar parte de una empresa en constante evolución,

¡esta oportunidad es para vos!

Las principales funciones serán

Gestión de proyectos Liderar proyectos transversales; coordinar cronogramas, riesgos y avances; interactuando con áreas internas y proveedores para asegurar el cumplimiento de objetivos. Administración de costos y presupuesto Participar en la elaboración del presupuesto anual del área; realizar el seguimiento presupuestario y el control de costos; analizar desvíos entre lo real y lo presupuestado y proponer acciones correctivas; identificar oportunidades de ahorro y optimización de recursos. Automatización y transformación digital Identificar oportunidades de automización y optimización de procesos administrativos y contables; participar en implementaciones de ERP y herramientas que permitan rediseñar circuitos, estandarizar y procedimientar hacia la mejora continua. Reporte de gestión Ser referente del proceso de informes administrativos; diseñar modelos de información; coordinar datos con Contabilidad y otras áreas; desarrollar y mantener tableros; automatización de reportes; asegurar oportunidad y calidad de la información; proponer nuevos indicadores..

Requisitos

Formación Contabilidad, Administración o carreras a fines.Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en tareas de administración de costos, presupuestos, gestión de proyectos y reportes.Liderazgo en proyectos y conocimiento de herramientas de mejora continua. Conocimiento en ERP y sistemas de gestión. Uso de Power BI / herramientas BI y excel avanzado.Manejo de IA y transformación digital.

Se valoran habilidades de

Liderazgo. Comunicación efectiva. Planificación y organización. Proactividad y autonomía. Adaptabilidad al cambio.

Beneficios

Formar parte de una empresa en constante crecimiento y expansión.Cultura de trabajo basada en la ayuda, colaboración y el trabajo en equipo.Capacitaciones constantes y aprendizaje continuo.Oportunidades para aportar ideas, innovar y generar impacto.Excelente ambiente laboral orientado al respeto y al buen trato.Experiencias enriquecedoras junto a universidades y programas de formación.Sentido de pertenencia y propósito compartido dejar una huella de ayuda y colaboración.

El 10 de agosto de 1994, en Mendoza, dos amigos —Andrés Musacchio y Eduardo Herrera— decidieron transformar una visión compartida en realidad crear una farmacia centrada en las personas, con atención cálida, confiable y profesional.

Así nació la primera Farmacia Del Plata, un pequeño local que pronto se ganó el corazón de la comunidad mendocina. Con cercanía, profesionalismo y compromiso, fue creciendo y sumando propuestas pensadas para el bienestar de cada cliente.

Hoy, a 30 años de aquel inicio, Del Plata Salud es una red de 28 puntos de venta físicos. Además, cuenta con otras unidades de negocio como Del Plata Express (venta telefónica), E-commerce y Droguería del Valle, que abastece a todas las sucursales.

Está presente en once de los dieciocho departamentos que conforman la Provincia de Mendoza con un amplio stock, horarios extendidos y asesoramiento farmacéutico personalizado.

La innovación, la capacitación constante y el compromiso con la experiencia del cliente son pilares que guían a Del Plata Salud desde el primer día.

postings.descriptionText: Campari Group es hoy un actor importante en la industria global de bebidas espirituosas de marca, con un portafolio de más de 50 marcas premium y super premium, comercializadas y distribuidas en más de 190 mercados en todo el mundo, con posiciones de liderazgo en Europa y América.Con sede en Milán, Italia, Campari Group posee 25 plantas en todo el mundo y tiene su propia red de distribución en 26 países, empleando aproximadamente a 4.700 personas.Las acciones de la empresa matriz Davide Campari - Milano N.V. están listadas en la Bolsa de Valores Italiana desde 2001. Hoy, Campari Group es el sexto mayor actor mundial en la industria de bebidas espirituosas premium.Detrás de cada decisión comercial hay un dato, y alguien que lo hizo confiable. En Sales Intelligence de Campari Argentina buscamos un/a Analytics Engineer que quiera aplicar su experiencia en datos al mundo comercial. Vas a trabajar junto a los equipos de ventas, construyendo la base de información que usan para decidir cómo llegan nuestras marcas a cada canal del país.Misión del puesto:Liderar la arquitectura de información comercial del área: transformar datos crudos y dispersos en una capa de datos única, versionada y confiable, sobre la cual Sales Intelligence construye insight, no reportes.El foco es lograr la construcción y el mantenimiento del sistema de información comercial del área, unificando fuentes de datos hoy fragmentadas (sell-in/sell-out, scentia,precios, ejecución, inversión) en una capa de datos única y confiable, sobre la cual el equipo construye tableros que se actualizan de forma automática.El impacto al negocio es reducir el tiempo que los recursos de Sales Intelligence, gerentes de canales, KAMs y KAEs invierten en actualizar y reconciliar reportes, y redirigir ese tiempo a generación de insight y toma de decisión comercial.Principales Responsabilidades y ActividadesDiseñar y mantener el modelo de datos comercial único (“single source of truth”), integrando fuentes de distribuidores (sell-in/sell-out, scentia,precios, ejecución, inversión)Construir y automatizar la capa de tableros, priorizando que se actualicen de forma autónoma en lugar de requerir armado manual periódico.Definir estándares de calidad y estandarización del dato para que los prinicpales stackeholders (sales intelligence, gerentes de canal, KAMs y KAEs, CCCM) operen sobre un número confiable sin verificarlo dos veces.Traducir necesidades de negocio en modelos de datos, trabajando en conjunto con el equipo de Sales Intelligence y las áreas comerciales.Priorizar qué procesos automatizar primero en función del impacto en horas-analista liberadas, no de la complejidad técnica del desafío.Relaciones ClaveInternas:Gerentes de Venta de Canales: Coordinación de estrategias y ejecución comercial por zonaSales Intelligence: Seguimiento de los KPI´s de planes de canal y marca.Equipo IT: Coordinacion de proyectosExternas:Proveedores de Información: Scentia, Lacarss, Compass, etc.Competencias ClaveCapacidad para actuar como puente entre las necesidades del negocio y los equipos técnicos, traduciendo requerimientos en soluciones de datos.Experiencia en análisis de calidad de datos, detección de inconsistencias, investigación de problemas y resolución de causas raíz.Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, gestión de stakeholders y coordinación de iniciativas transversales.Conocimiento de gobierno de datos, gestión de metadatos, definiciones de negocio y marcos de calidad de datos. ambigüedad.Contexto para IA: Enriquecer esquemas, metadatos y documentación en el repositorio para alimentar modelos de código/IA (como Claude Code o Copilots) y maximizar el autoservicio técnico del equipo.Calidad y Calidad de Datos: Definir e implementar frameworks de pruebas (dbt tests), monitoreo de alertas y observabilidad para asegurar la consistencia del dato en toda la años especializados en Analytics Engineering.Stack Core: Dominio avanzado de SQL y experiencia sólida con dbt (o Dataform) en entornos cloud (GCP BigQuery, Snowflake o Redshift).Product Analytics: Experiencia sólida trabajando con arquitecturas de datos basadas en eventos (event-driven analytics) y gobernando la ingesta/salida para herramientas como Amplitude, Mixpanel o similares.Modelado de Datos: Experiencia práctica en metodologías de modelado analítico (Kimball, Star Schema, Data Vault).Ingeniería de Software: Control de versiones con Git, flujos de CI/CD para datos (DataOps) y conocimientos intermedios de Python.Gobernanza: Experiencia implementando y manteniendo Catálogos de Datos (Datahub, Atlan, dbt Docs, etc.) y capas semánticas.Habilidades Blandas: Capacidad comprobada para traducir requerimientos de negocio complejos en modelos técnicos escalables y guiar a otros ingenieros.Porque te encantará trabajar en CasheaEn Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Escuchamos y damos espacio a las ideas y al feedback. Todos pertenecen y lo que es importante para ti, también lo es para nosotros.Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.Si quieres trabajar con nosotros, llena la aplicación. ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

work with Shopify brands doing up to $4M/month in sales, where a winning experiment can translate into hundreds of thousands of dollars in additional revenue.We scale eCommerce stores through customer research, experimentation, and conversion-focused design.We test everything from offers, pricing, bundles and buy boxes to messaging, landing pages, listicles, navigation and PDPs, then use those learnings to keep pushing RPV higher.Now we’re hiring an experienced CRO Strategist who loves building hypotheses, prioritizing experiments, analyzing results, and figuring out why customers buy, or don’t.If you enjoy digging into GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, customer research and test data, then turning those insights into experiments that actually move revenue, this is your role.What you’ll doYou’ll own CRO strategy across multiple Shopify brands and help them increase RPV through research, experimentation, and continuous iteration:build and prioritize A/B testing roadmaps based on potential impact, data, and customer researchdevelop and run experiments across offers, pricing, bundles, buy boxes, PDPs, landing pages, listicles, messaging, positioning, navigation, upsells, and moreanalyze test results, understand why something won or lost, and turn those learnings into the next hypothesisreview CRO redesigns using our internal frameworkanalyze GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, customer behavior, and quantitative + qualitative dataidentify conversion bottlenecks and uncover opportunities across the funnelturn data into clear hypotheses and actionable recommendationswork closely with designers and developers to take experiments from hypothesis → design → development → live testown the CRO strategy and performance of your assigned accountslead client communication with clarity and confidencerun onboarding calls and recurring strategy callssend progress updates and communicate test results, learnings, and next stepskeep accounts moving forward and constantly look for the next opportunity to improve RPVYou’ll work across multiple brands, run experiments constantly, and see the commercial impact of your ideas, not spend six months waiting to ship one test.What you bring3+ years of hands-on CRO experience, ideally within an agency environmenta strong track record of running A/B tests and producing measurable winshands-on experience with Shopify and DTC/eCommerce brandsyou already understand experimentation—you don’t need to be taught how to build a hypothesis, read a test, or prioritize an experimentation roadmapstrong experience with GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, and behavioral datayou can look beyond whether a test won or lost and understand whystrong commercial thinking—you understand that CRO is ultimately about increasing RPV and revenue, not just CVRstrong communication, curiosity, and speedwell written and spoken Englishconfidence presenting strategy, defending your thinking, and communicating results directly to clientsability to manage multiple accounts without losing clarity or momentumBonus points for:deep experience with offer testing, pricing, merchandising, PDPs, landing pages, and funnelsCRO copywritingbasic HTML/CSSexperience with Intelligems / Convert / VWO / Optimizelyexperience running experiments on high-traffic Shopify brands with enough volume to reach statistical significance quicklyWhy FuelerateWe’re not a slow corporate agency.CRO isn’t an add-on service here. remoteno pointless meetingshigh volume of experiments and real customer datawork directly with experienced designers and developersownership over CRO strategy—not just executionmentorship & growthreal impact on high-growth DTC brandsThe volume and variety of experiments you’ll run across multiple brands means you’ll be constantly exposed to new problems, hypotheses, and learnings.Challenges (honest bit)This is not a passive role.You will:manage multiple clientsswitch contexts quicklymake decisions when the data isn’t always perfectly clearcome up with new hypotheses constantly—not recycle the postings.title: Operational Excellence Coordinator
postings.descriptionText: OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE COORDINATOREn Cabify creemos que una nueva forma de movilidad urbana es posible. Un ecosistema que permita tener menos coches privados en las calles, vehículos más sostenibles y rutas más eficientes.Ciudades en las que sus calles estén pensadas por y para las personas, y no para los coches. Productos y servicios que, mediante alternativas de movilidad sostenibles y eficientes, generen valor económico, social y medioambiental.Y no solo es que creamos en ello, sino que trabajamos la magia para hacerlo posible. Si compartes con nosotros el mismo propósito, sigue leyendo porque… ¡Este es tu sitio!Sobre el puestoCómo Operational Excellence Coordinator tu rol será colaborar e impulsar la consecución de esta misión y objetivos para los mercados de Argentina y Uruguay, garantizando el mejor servicio y la mejor experiencia posible a los pasajeros particulares y a los clientes corporativos de Cabify, buscando su fidelización a largo plazo.El puesto se encuentra dentro del equipo de Operational Excellence (OEX), el cual pertenece al área de Customer Operations (COPS). Dentro de COPS, los equipos de OEX y Customer Support tienen la misión de ser los garantes de los estándares de servicio por los cuales Cabify se destaca. El área de COPS es quizás el área más transversal de Cabify, teniendo que trabajar con todos los departamentos, lo que garantiza mucho aprendizaje, desafíos y diversión.Liderarás el equipo de OEX para las audiencias de demanda —pasajeros particulares y clientes corporativos (B2B)—, consolidando bajo una misma mirada la experiencia de quien viaja y la rentabilidad de las operaciones que diseñamos para las empresas.¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir con nuestra misión?Siendo la principal referencia estratégica y operativa dentro del equipo de OEX para las audiencias de demanda (pasajeros particulares y clientes corporativos) y liderando este equipo.Operativizando y controlando la propuesta de valor definida para pasajeros y empresas, con foco en garantizar un servicio seguro, fiable y superior a través de la optimización y control de procesos eficientes, confiables y sin desperdicios, teniendo la capacidad de transformarlos.Detectando oportunidades de mejora en las distintas etapas del customer journey de nuestros pasajeros y clientes corporativos: desde que inician su registro para ser nuevos usuarios y durante toda su experiencia en viajes y posterior a los viajes en Cabify.Entendiendo los principales puntos de fricción para cada uno de los procesos y estableciendo propuestas de mejora, basándose siempre en el análisis del valor de cada una para la toma de decisiones.Liderando proyectos de mejora para el área, en la búsqueda continua de soluciones efectivas, escalables y eficientes.Trabajando de la mano con equipos de soporte para asegurar la mejor calidad de servicio, desde el punto de vista de la atención al cliente.Optimizando procesos críticos a través de la implementación de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (LLMs, Prompt Engineering, OCR, etc) y de la automatización de tareas para escalar las operaciones, en conjunto con equipos locales y globales.Alineando directrices de proyectos globales para su eficiente implementación local y escalando necesidades del mercado hacia equipos globales mediante la documentación de requerimientos y evidencia cuantitativa.¿Qué buscamos?Profesional en Ingeniería o afín con experiencia de al menos 3 años en cargos de optimización de procesos, mejora continua o en posiciones similares en empresas de tecnología. Será considerado como un plus tener experiencia en estos roles dentro de empresas de tecnología.Experiencia excluyente de al menos 2 a 3 años liderando y gestionando equipos de forma directa, preferentemente con perfiles analíticos o técnicos.Manejo avanzado de herramienta Excel / Google Sheets (excluyente).Manejo de herramientas de Business Intelligence (Tableau, Power BI, o Looker, etc) para consultas de bases de datos, armado de gráficos y desarrollo de tableros básicos, con demostrada capacidad para hacer análisis e interpretación de indicadores (excluyente).Experiencia comprobable en la implementación de flujos con herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) con el fin de optimizar procesos operativos.Capacidad de manejar muchos frentes simultáneamente y de dialogar con múltiples interlocutores, logrando mantener una agenda ordenada de trabajo por objetivos.Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, con capacidad para interactuar eficazmente con diversos stakeholders, escalar problemas, dar visibilidad a iniciativas y validar cursos de acción.Personas proactivas, autónomas y con ganas de impulsar un cambio.¿Qué ofrecemos?Somos un equipo repleto de gente feliz y motivada. Flexibilidad, buen ambiente, crecimiento e impacto ¡asegurados! Cabify viene cargado de beneficios para que los disfrutes en tu viaje junto a nosotros:🏥 Plan de medicina prepaga OSDE 210🤸 Horario flexible, teletrabajo y semanas full remote🎟️ Beneficios y descuentos con Club LA NACIÓN🔋 Recharge Day: el tercer viernes del mes ¡libre!🏝️ Cabify days: Una semana extra de vacaciones🎉 Eventos divertidos para disfrutar junto a tu equipo🖥️ Equipo de trabajo para que desarrolles todo tu talentoCabify se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con crear un entorno inclusivo para todas las personas, independientemente de su origen, género, religión, orientación, edad o capacidad. ¡Únete a nosotros!

postings.title: Actuary - Dental Pricing
postings.descriptionText: Join MetLife’s Financial Management Group (FMG), a strategic financial engine driving critical decision-making through financial planning, analysis, and risk management. As a member of the team, you'll be involved in topics including financial reporting, treasury, corporate actuarial, tax, investor relations and mergers and acquisitions. Positioned at the intersection of finance and strategy, you'll help ensure that MetLife meets customer obligations while supporting strategic objectives. Develop expertise across disciplines in a collaborative, results-driven environment while maintaining the financial strength and competitive edge of one of the world's leading institutions.The OpportunityAs an Actuary on the Dental Pricing team, you will play a central role in maintaining and advancing the pricing capabilities that support MetLife’s Dental business. You will own critical pricing tools, systems, actuarial studies, and regulatory deliverables, using your technical expertise and business judgment to influence pricing strategy, financial performance, and customer value.This role offers broad exposure across the Dental organization and the opportunity to become a trusted subject-matter expert for Underwriting, Product, Contracts and Compliance, Valuation, and other business partners. You will lead work ranging from state rate filings and pricing-system updates to renewal analysis, product initiatives, and actuarial studies. If you enjoy solving complex business problems, modernizing established processes, and translating detailed analysis into clear recommendations, this role provides a strong platform for professional growth and organizational impact.Key ResponsibilitiesOwn and enhance critical dental pricing tools, by recommending and implementing data-driven updates, maintaining sound calculations, clear documentation, and effective controls while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate recurring work. Manage pricing system updates and implementation activities in support of accurate manual and experience rating. Coordinate requirements, testing, validation, communication, and production implementation so that Underwriting has accurate and timely pricing capabilities. Lead recurring financial and strategic analysis, including renewal cycle reviews, experience studies, and data analysis supporting pricing and finance decisions. Translate results into clear recommendations for leaders and business partners. Lead dental regulatory pricing work, including rate filings, Minimum Loss Ratio filings, and other state regulatory requests. Prepare actuarial support, respond to objections, and partner with Contracts, Compliance, Legal, and state regulators to secure required approvals. Serve as a strategic actuarial partner for Underwriting, Product, Contracts and Compliance, Segment Finance, Centers of Excellence, and Valuations. Support product initiatives such as incentive provisions, connected benefits, benefit expansions, and pricing methodology enhancements, while responding to complex business inquiries and emerging priorities. Required QualificationsStrong experience with actuarial or financial modeling, large datasets, and analytical problem-solving, including the ability to evaluate results, identify risks, and develop practical business recommendations. Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with programming, database, or data-analysis tools such as SQL, Alteryx, Databricks, or comparable platforms. Proficiency using AI-enabled tools, such as Copilot or generative AI platforms, to accelerate analysis, improve documentation, automate repeatable work, and support decision-making, along with a commitment to responsible use and continued AI fluency. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex actuarial and financial concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and work with external regulatory stakeholders. A proactive, ownership-oriented approach with strong attention to detail, sound judgment, thoughtful documentation, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities across teams. Preferred QualificationsBachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science, finance, or a related field; actuarial credentials or demonstrated progress toward an actuarial designation. Experience with insurance pricing, including familiarity with claims experience, pricing systems, state rate filings, regulatory requirements, and renewal analysis. Experience modernizing processes through Power BI, Qlik Sense, Alteryx, Databricks, AI-enabled tools, or similar data and automation technologies. Associate of the Society of Actuaries designation.Beneficios que OfrecemosNuestros beneficios están diseñados para cuidar tu bienestar integral mediante programas de salud física y mental, bienestar financiero y apoyo a las familias. Ofrecemos cobertura de atención médica para ti y tu familia, descuentos en seguros para proteger tu hogar, automóvil y mascotas, así como licencia parental. También ofrecemos una membresía premium de gimnasio para ti y tus familiares directos, tiempo libre para voluntariado, descuentos en universidades seleccionadas, viernes flexibles, reembolso de gastos de conectividad y mucho más.Acerca de MetLifeReconocida por Fortune entre las compañías más admiradas del mundo y los mejores lugares para trabajar, MetLife es una de las compañías líderes de servicios financieros a nivel global. A través de nuestras subsidiarias y afiliadas, ofrecemos seguros, anualidades, beneficios para empleados y soluciones de gestión de activos a clientes individuales e institucionales. Con presencia en más de 40 mercados, ocupamos posiciones de liderazgo en Estados Unidos, Latinoamérica, Asia, Europa y Medio Oriente.Como parte de nuestra estrategia New Frontier, estamos construyendo un futuro centrado en las personas e impulsado por la Inteligencia Artificial. Buscamos personas curiosas, adaptables y con mentalidad de crecimiento, que quieran aprovechar el potencial de la IA para transformar la forma en que trabajamos, mejoramos la experiencia de nuestros clientes y generamos valor para nuestras comunidades. En MetLife, la IA es una herramienta que complementa el criterio humano, potencia la creatividad y promueve la mejora continua, siempre de manera responsable y ética.Nuestro propósito es simple: ayudar a nuestros colaboradores, clientes, comunidades y a la sociedad en general a construir un futuro más seguro y confiable. Guiados por nuestros valores Ganamos Juntos, Hacemos lo Correcto, Generamos Impacto por Encima de la Actividad y Pensamos en el Futuro, trabajamos para transformar el futuro de los servicios financieros.#AllTogetherPossible. Súmate a MetLife.

Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.Now we’re doing something harder. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. We also offer the option of working from our Buenos Aires offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.As a Staff Software Engineer, you will act as a premier technical anchor and individual contributor for our engineering organization. Operating with a line-level and organization-wide scope of impact, you will own the technical strategy and architectural roadmap of complex, large-scale products or platforms that are critical to the company's long-term vision.We believe that technology scales execution, but senior talent scales judgment. This is an advanced leadership role that requires navigating cross-team technical architecture, managing technical alignment with stakeholders, and handling organizational and product dynamics across multiple structures.Key Responsibilities (What you will do):Architectural direction & strategy: Set the core architectural direction for complex platform scopes. Identify and generate new org-wide technical opportunities, defining the technical strategy and roadmap required to execute them.Simplifying complex challenges: Break down vague, unstructured, and highly ambiguous problems into execution-ready technical scope. Create simple, highly maintainable systems with clear documentation and well-defined interfaces that can be easily operated even by junior engineers.Engineering excellence & trade-off ownership: Drive the technical quality for larger or complex team scopes by establishing engineering standards and best practices. Act as a technical advisor, defining policies and proactively mitigating obstacles for software, product, and data quality across multiple domains.Team influence & mentorship: Act as an absolute reference in technical leadership within Engineering. Provide senior technical assessments to management to inform project strategy and composition. Actively mentor senior engineers (including B6 and B7 levels), accelerating their technical growth without relying on formal authority.Guard the tech bar: Act as a lead interviewer for senior and principal technical roles, setting the bar during our hiring, sourcing, and internal allocation processes.Position & technical challenges:Because we are scaling multiple strategic fronts simultaneously, we run a unified hiring process for our Staff positions. Instead of locking you into a single team from day one, we focus on assessing your leadership, systemic thinking, and architectural skills first.At the final stage of the process, we will present you with 2 or 3 of our most critical technical challenges across different products and platforms. Together, we will choose the allocation that best aligns your expertise and career aspirations with our highest-impact business needs.Regardless of the final allocation, your day-to-day will deeply involve solving systemic issues where multiple services cannot be understood in isolation. You will step into environments requiring high-concurrency solutions, complex data consistency, and the decoupling of mission-critical systems.What we are looking for (Requirements):10+ years of experience in software development, with a consolidated background leading the delivery of high-volume, high-concurrency, and mission-critical distributed systems.Deep knowledge of modern software architecture paradigms, distributed data consistency, fault tolerance, and system optimization. Proven ability to analyze and articulate engineering trade-offs concretely (e.g., simplicity vs. flexibility, velocity vs. reliability, build vs. buy).Demonstrated capability to remove barriers to collaboration, conduct difficult structural conversations smoothly, build strategic roadmaps, and foster an inclusive engineering culture.Experience designing systems that cross team boundaries and remain maintainable as teams and products scale.Fluency in Spanish and excellent English skills (verbal and written) are mandatory, as we use English daily for code, architecture documentation, and global alignment.ImportantOur hiring process starts with the application! If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants.All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.Hiring Process StagesThe stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:ApplicationTechnical CV screeningPeople Interview with RecruitersTech Screening with Engineering Team (Code AI live case)Technicals Interviews (architecture live cases and tech leadership)OfferBenefitsMedical planWellhubExtended parental leaveReinstatement of GuarderiaTelework expenses (monthly amount)Discounts on day-to-day servicesFree day for compleaños, Father's Day and Mother's DayDiversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndarWe value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.Privacy and Data ProtectionThe Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. postings.title: Software Development Engineer II
postings.descriptionText: About Amperity—Why This, Why NowMost customer data is a lie by omission.Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.The RoleAt Amperity, we empower businesses to unlock the full potential of their customer data. Our clients are industry leaders making bold investments in cutting-edge customer data infrastructure. postings.title: Software Engineer Full Stack & AI First
postings.descriptionText: En Homie estamos transformando la forma en que las personas rentan vivienda en LATAM. No somos un portal de anuncios: administramos la renta de principio a fin en representación de los propietarios desde la captación y las visitas hasta el contrato, la gestión de la renta y la dispersión a los dueños.Después de casi diez años operando, estamos modernizando y reconstruyendo el núcleo de nuestra tecnología sobre bases AI-first: sistemas simples, bien probados y altamente apalancados en IA, capaces de operar todo el ciclo de renta con velocidad y calidad.Buscamos a alguien que construya con criterio: que use la IA como multiplicador real no como autocompletado, que sepa exactamente qué no construir y que se obsesione con la simplicidad, la calidad y los datos limpios. Si te emociona resolver problemas de negocio reales con apalancamiento de IA y tener impacto directo en un producto que mueve el mercado, queremos conocerte. Misión del rolDiseñar y construir con alto apalancamiento de IA, un núcleo de software simple, robusto y bien probado que habilite una mejor experiencia para propietarios, inquilinos y equipos internos, y que pueda evolucionar rápido sin acumular complejidad ni deuda.Tu trabajo no es solo escribir código: es construir los sistemas, las barreras de calidad y la observabilidad que permiten al equipo y a la IA entregar rápido y con confianza.Elevas el estándar técnico, mantienes los datos como activo central del negocio y aseguras que todo lo que sale a producción esté probado, sea reproducible y aporte valor real.TareasConstruir de punta a punta (full-stack), diseñas e implementas funcionalidades completas del ciclo de renta de la base de datos a la interfaz, con ownership end-to-end y comodidad para moverte por todo el stack.Usas agentes de IA (p. ej. Claude Code) como forma principal de construir, orquestándolos para generar código, pruebas, documentación y exploración de soluciones, siempre bajo tu criterio y revisión.Revisas y validas críticamente el código propio, del equipo o generado por IA detectando errores lógicos, alucinaciones, riesgos de seguridad, ineficiencias y problemas de mantenibilidad.Pruebas unitarias, de integración y end-to-end, CI/CD y "barreras de salida" que impidan que algo roto llegue a producción. Esa automatización es lo que hace seguro apalancarse en IA.Instrumentas tracking de errores, de generaciones de IA y de producto; detectas problemas antes que el usuario y cierras el ciclo de mejora idealmente hasta conectar el error con una propuesta de solución.Mantienes infraestructura, configuración y proveedores versionados y reproducibles, de modo que todo sea trazable y reversible, nada de configuraciones críticas que vivan solo en el panel de un proveedor.Modelas con claridad las entidades centrales del negocio (propietarios, propiedades, inquilinos, contratos, pagos) en un core de datos bien estructurado, multipaís y multimarca, pensado para reutilizarse.Priorizas sin piedad, eliminas complejidad y te enfocas en el 80% que mueve el negocio. Resistes la tentación de lo "brillante" que no aporta valor.Diseñas con foco en optimización de recursos y control de costos en AWS, tratando la salud financiera del stack como parte del trabajo de ingeniería.Incorporas seguridad desde el diseño y proteges el activo más valioso de Homie: sus datos. En dónde viven, cómo se acceden y qué los toca.Propones estándares, documentación y mejores prácticas que multiplican la capacidad de toda la organización con IA no solo la tuya, y colaboras de cerca con Producto y Operaciones para traducir necesidades reales en soluciones simples.RequisitosExperiencia sólida como ingeniero full-stack senior: dominio de TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js y Node, además de servicios de backend y modelado de datos (SQL). Cómodo y con ganas de tomar ownership de extremo a extremo.Experiencia real construyendo con agentes de IA (Claude Code o similares) como forma principal de desarrollo, no solo autocompletado, con el criterio para revisar, probar y corregir lo que producen.Disciplina fuerte de testing (unitarias, integración, e2e), CI/CD y observabilidad.Experiencia con AWS y mentalidad de costo/eficiencia.Conocimiento sólido de seguridad en el desarrollo, aplicada desde el diseño.Sesgo por la simplicidad: capacidad de modelar datos limpios y de elegir la solución más simple que resuelve el problema. Aplicas buenos patrones y criterio de ingeniería al servicio de la mantenibilidad, no de la complejidad.Alta autonomía, pensamiento sistémico, criterio de negocio, ownership y sentido de urgencia.Comunicación clara para explicar decisiones técnicas y colaborar con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos. Español fluido; inglés para documentación y herramientas.Valoramos si:SaaS multitenant / multipaís, idealmente en LATAM.Dominio en real estate, fintech o productos financieros.React Native (tenemos en el horizonte una app para propietarios).Familiaridad con stacks legados (Ruby on Rails, Java) para apoyar la transición mientras construimos lo nuevo.Experiencia integrando plataformas de negocio como HubSpot.Cómo trabajamosAI-first, con humanos al mando. La IA construye gran parte del código; las personas deciden qué construir y responden por la calidad. Primero invertimos en hacer la base segura para que la IA contribuya bien.Preferimos un núcleo simple y sólido a una constelación de sistemas. Decidir dejar de hacer cosas es parte del trabajo.Calidad y datos como cimiento. Testing, observabilidad y un core de datos limpio desde el día uno.Apalancamiento a nivel organización. El objetivo no es darle una herramienta a cada ingeniero, sino elevar la capacidad de todo Homie.Colaboración internaEste rol trabaja principalmente con el equipo de Tecnología en el diseño, construcción y evolución de la plataforma. También colabora de cerca con Producto para traducir necesidades del negocio en soluciones técnicas simples; con Operaciones para entender flujos internos, automatizaciones y puntos de fricción; y con las áreas comerciales y de servicio cuando haya que construir soluciones que impacten directamente la experiencia de propietarios, inquilinos o equipos internos.En Homie creemos que los mejores equipos se construyen con perspectivas distintas. Valoramos la diversidad de experiencias, trayectorias, identidades y contextos, porque nos ayuda a tomar mejores decisiones y a construir soluciones más completas.Buscamos un entorno donde cada persona pueda aportar con libertad, aprender, retarse y crecer. Si quieres sumarte a una empresa que está construyendo una mejor experiencia de renta para LATAM y te interesa la tecnología con impacto real, nos gustaría conocerte.

Perform unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing support. Monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues. Manage system updates, code changes, deployments, and ongoing maintenance. Follow development best practices, including version control, change management, and technical documentation. Provide recommendations on system architecture, integration design, and automation opportunities. Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to non-technical team members. Strong knowledge of Oracle NetSuite customization, development, and administration. Hands-on experience with SuiteScript 2.x and NetSuite APIs. Proven experience developing and maintaining integrations using Celigo integrator.io. Practical experience integrating NetSuite with Shopify. Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, data mapping, and integration architecture. Experience working with JSON, XML, and other data exchange formats. Understanding of ERP workflows, including order management, inventory, fulfillment, and financial transactions. Experience troubleshooting complex system and integration issues. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. Excellent documentation, communication, and project management skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical projects.Preferred Skills Experience supporting e-commerce or direct-to-consumer businesses. Experience with Shopify order management, product catalogs, inventory synchronization, and fulfillment workflows. Familiarity with NetSuite financials, purchasing, inventory management, and warehouse-related processes. Experience with additional integration platforms, middleware, or third-party APIs. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Experience with sandbox environments, deployment processes, and release management. NetSuite certifications or relevant technical certifications. Experience managing high-volume e-commerce transactions and complex system integrations.Personality You are a senior-level developer who combines deep NetSuite technical expertise with practical experience connecting ERP systems to e-commerce platforms. postings.descriptionText: About StensulStensul is the Governed Creation™ Platform for enterprise marketing teams that need to create campaigns quickly, safely, and at scale. We bring creation, collaboration, and control together in one connected platform, combining AI-enabled creation, no-code production, embedded governance, and seamless integrations across the marketing tech stack. The result: faster output, lower costs, reduced risk, and work that stays consistently on brand.At Stensul, we’re just as intentional about how we work as about what we build. We’re a people-first team that values inclusive collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to help define the future of marketing creation, we’d love to meet you.Why This Role MattersWe're looking for a Technical Lead to own the technical direction of our email builder team: where enterprise marketers assemble campaign emails and check them against brand, legal, and rendering standards before the email ever goes out for review. Get it right here and the review cycle is short. Get it wrong and the whole campaign stalls in rework. It is Stensul's original product surface and its most heavily used, so anything that breaks here is felt by customers immediately. You would join a long-lived, cross-functional team where Engineering, Product, and Design work together on the same domain, owning it from idea through production and into long-term maintenance. Nobody hands the team a spec and nobody hands the team's output to someone else to run. You would own technical direction as an individual contributor, partnering with the Engineering Manager who owns people, capacity, and delivery. You'll navigate the tension between technical sustainability and business urgency, making architectural decisions that compound over time in a B2B platform serving large, heavily regulated, demanding organizations. If you care as much about how a team works as about what it builds, and you'd rather model good practices than mandate them, this is the kind of role where you'll thrive.What makes this problem interestingEmail is one of the last genuinely hostile target environments in software. There is no single rendering standard, the clients that matter most disagree with each other, and the people producing the output are marketers, not engineers. Our job is to let someone with no technical background assemble something complex and have it come out correct every time, in every inbox.Then add the harder constraint: many of our customers are large financial institutions. For them, "on brand" is not a preference and "approved" is not a formality. A campaign that goes out with the wrong disclosure is a regulatory problem, not a design problem. So the guardrails cannot be a review step at the end. They have to be built into the creation experience itself, tight enough to guarantee compliance and flexible enough so people can still do their work.That is the tension you would spend your time on, and it is getting sharper. You are comfortable in front of client executives, demoing your work and answering questions on the spot.Excellent written English and strong async habits. Clear written updates, risks flagged early, and you unblock yourself.Solid overlap with US Eastern time, because our clients are in the US.You think like a product owner, and you have taste. postings.descriptionText: The salary range for this role is $1,500 - $4,000 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!About the Role:We are seeking a talented and motivated Junior Software Engineer with a unique blend of accounting experience who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This role is tailored for professionals who started their careers in accounting but pivoted to engineering and now want to leverage their domain expertise to solve technical challenges in fintech. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. The Junior Software Engineer will assist us with the design, development, and installation of software solutions. Your duties will include development, writing code, and documenting functionality. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design.Interview ProcessWe believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.Application submitted (you are here)Wonderlic test (30-40 min)Coding assessment (:1.5 hours)Interview with recruiters (30 min)Interview with engineers (1 hour)Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)OfferSezzle Technical Stack:Golang backend, React / React Native front-endGrafana / Loki / Prometheus metricsKubernetesAWSAmazon Aurora (MySQL) RDSGitlab CI/CD deploymentsUnit, Integration, and end-to-end testingWhat You'll Do:Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.Be an integral part of the software development lifecycle.Work as an integrated team member developing new features.Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.What We Look For:Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.Proficient in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiar with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.Experience with backend API development.Experience with relational database storage and retrieval.Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field.Sezzle’s Technology Stack:Languages: Golang, Typescript, PythonFrontend: Typescript - React and React NativeBackend: GolangDatabase: MySQL, Postgres, ElasticsearchDevOps & Cloud: AWS, KubernetesVersion Control: GitCI/CD: GitlabTesting: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testsSezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!About You:You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do thingsYou need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.#Full-time

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform
postings.descriptionText: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!Compensation:For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.About the Role: We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.What You’ll Do: Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering. Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery. Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt. Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations. Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own. Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.What We Look For:6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience. Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days. Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python. Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure. Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus. Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring. Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate. Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.Preferred Knowledge and Skills:Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope. Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence. Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA). Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer. Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right. Experience with threat modeling at a system level.About You: You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better. You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it. You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things. You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. Sezzle’s Technology Stack:Languages: Golang, Typescript, PythonFrontend: Typescript - React and React NativeBackend: GolangDatabase: MySQL, Postgres, ElasticsearchDevOps & Cloud: AWS, KubernetesVersion Control: GitCI/CD: GitlabTesting: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit testsOpen Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.#Full-time

Your work will bring cloud platform technologies to a wide range of users and computing environments, from desktops to bare metal servers. This role requires a python software developer with a passion for automating infrastructure as code.Applicants should be passionate about the future of the software defined datacenter, distributed systems, and open source. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.What you’ll doCollaborate proactively with a distributed teamWrite high quality code to create new featuresDebug issues and produce high quality code to fix themReview code produced by other engineersDiscuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutionsEnsure the success of OpenStack and Ceph on multiple architecturesWork from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external eventsWho you areYou love technology and working with brilliant peopleYou are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountableYou value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivatedYou have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degreeYou have experience with PythonYou have interest and experience with two or more of the following:Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, AI/ML, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, C, Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, scalable web servicesYou have experience with non-x86 architectures, including s390, arm64, power and othersYou have experience with OpenStack, OVN, Openvswitch and other related cloud technologiesWhat Canonical OffersLearning and DevelopmentAnnual Compensation ReviewRecognition RewardsAnnual LeavePriority Pass for travelFlexible working optionCanonical believes a diverse workforce enhances our ability to deliver world class software and services which meet the world’s computing needs. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.About CanonicalCanonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.Canonical is an equal opportunity employerWe are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
