postings.title: AI Systems Lead
postings.descriptionText: AI Systems LeadSustain Media | Remote | Full-time contractor | $5,000 to $7,000/monthSustain Media helps home service businesses get more customers through local SEO and Google Ads. We're hiring an AI Systems Lead to build and run the internal systems our team uses to deliver that work.A big part of this job is turning ideas into builds. Someone on the team describes a problem they deal with every week. You ask the right questions, whiteboard a solution with them, and turn it into a system the team can depend on.We run a lot of the business off Viktor, an AI agent that lives in our Slack. It pulls data from our ad accounts and tools, runs SEO audits, tracks rankings and builds reports. A lot of work has already gone into Viktor and it runs well. Your job is to keep making it better and to build what comes next, including our own CRM and suite of SEO/Ads automations. You'll also own the systems around Viktor, including our Airtable bases. We need someone who can take a problem from the first conversation through launch and keep the system working after people start using it.The kind of builder we wantYou're practical. You'd rather ship a working version this week than spend a month on the perfect setup. But you don't leave a mess behind. You document what you built well enough that the team can use it and another engineer could pick it up.You also think about where a system will be in a year. When you pick a tool or decide how data is structured, you can explain why, and you've checked that it won't box us in once we have twice the clients and twice the team. Choosing Airtable as our system of record is the kind of call we mean.What you'll ownTurn ideas into builds. Sit with our SEO, Google Ads and client success teams and learn how the work runs today. Take their user stories, whiteboard a solution with them, and turn a rough idea into a clear plan before you build. You're comfortable doing this live in front of a group. Tell us when something isn't worth automating.Connect our tools. Most of the work runs through Airtable, Slack, Google's ad and search tools, and LLM APIs. Write custom code when an existing connector falls short. Use n8n or Zapier when that's the faster call.Make Viktor perform way better. You don't need to build an agent from scratch (for now). Most of the work is tuning one that's already built: improve its instructions and workflows, connect it to the right data, and pick the right model for each job. When we do build new agents, you harden them with test cases, scheduled jobs and reviews so they stay on the path they're meant to follow.Make architecture decisions you can defend. Write down why you chose a tool, a data structure or a place for data to live, so the next person understands it and we don't get stuck later.Own reliability. Test before launch, handle missing data and duplicate events, and validate data on the back end, not just the front end. Set up canaries, logs and alerts so nothing fails without someone knowing, and fix failures before they become recurring problems.Make the systems usable. Write simple documentation and handoff guides so a non-technical manager can understand what you built and train the team on it. Adjust the workflow when it does not fit the team's day-to-day work.Keep projects moving. Set clear milestones, flag blockers early, and explain what shipped, what changed and what you're working on next.Examples of the workSome of this is already running and some is on the list: an onboarding portal for new clients, a Google Maps rank tracker, AI-drafted replies to Google reviews, a flow that hands tasks to the right person on the team, billing clients based on their Google Ads spend, and research that runs automatically before sales calls. You'll inherit some of it, improve it and build the rest. You'll help choose and scope new work based on its value to the business.What we're looking forYou've built automations that real teams rely on. You can show what you personally built, explain the decisions you made, and describe what happened after launch.You've worked on both the front end and the back end. You understand back-end validation and authentication, and you know how to make an AI-built app safe before it goes live. Ideally you were writing code before AI tools made it easy.You can read and understand a new API quickly and work within MCP connections. You can write and debug JavaScript or Python, including checking and repairing AI-generated code.You've built and managed databases that a team uses every day, in Airtable or other tools. You understand why different systems structure data the way they do, and you spot data problems that will break a workflow later.You've used LLMs inside working systems. You understand structured outputs, tool calling, model selection, testing, cost and the limits of model reliability.You can explain your choices. When you design a system, you can say why you built it that way, what you traded off and what would make you change it.You're easy to work with. You ask good questions before building, troubleshoot on your own, and can explain how a system works to people who aren't engineers. You're comfortable telling us when an idea won't work.Experience with marketing agencies, SEO, Google Ads, reporting or CRMs is incredibly useful. So is experience running or tuning your own models. We care most about the quality of your work and your ability to take ownership. A specific degree or AI framework is not required.You're probably not a fit ifYou care more about code quality scores and server setups than whether the team's problem got solved.Your experience is mostly prompts and LLMs, and you haven't connected real apps through APIs.You'd rather get a finished spec than talk to the people doing the work.What success looks likeWhen the team brings you an idea, it turns into a working system quickly. The team spends less time moving data, checking routine work and chasing information. They trust the systems because the outputs are accurate, failures are visible, and someone owns the fix. Your documentation makes it possible for another person to understand and maintain what you built.Why this roleYou'll work directly with the team and the people using your systems, and you'll see the effect of your work. You'll have room to recommend better ways of doing things and influence which problems we tackle next. This role grows with the company, with room for bonuses and a clear path to higher pay. You won't manage people or run operations. The job is building, with a lot of time spent talking to the people you build for.

Al menos 1 día por semana vamos a la oficina. Un equipo chico donde lo que construís llega a producción en díasEn cada interacción, valoramos los resultados por encima de los egos o jerarquíasCómo es trabajar en KlevaEquipos chicos, talentosos y emprendedores. We're Yalo! We're on a mission to revolutionize how businesses sell in an omnichannel way with our intelligent sales platform and intelligent agents powered by cutting-edge AI. Imagine a world where businesses seamlessly connect with their customers across every channel—offering personalized experiences, anticipating needs, and delivering what they want with ease. That's the reality we're building at Yalo.Born in Latin America and driven by its spirit of innovation, we're transforming sales for businesses around the globe. From empowering businesses in emerging markets to helping enterprises scale intelligently, we're redefining how companies engage with their customers and drive growth.At Yalo, we believe the future of sales is personalized, omnichannel, intelligent, and conversational. Join us as we empower businesses to build stronger relationships and achieve remarkable results worldwide!Job Summary 🧾We're looking for a Sr. Staff Data Engineer to own the data platform that powers Yalo's analytics, dashboards, and AI agents. This is a senior technical ownership role — not a management track. You'll define the architecture, set the standards, and be the deepest technical authority on how data moves from raw platform events to governed, trusted, agent-ready information. If you think in systems that need to be reliable at 99.9% uptime, care as much about a clean semantic layer as a fast pipeline, and want your technical judgment — not your headcount — to be your leverage, this one's for you.Your mission?Own and evolve the infrastructure that turns Yalo's raw platform events into the trusted data foundation for dashboards, business decisions, and AI agents like IRIS. You'll work daily with Engineering (event generation), Business Analytics (dashboard consumers), and the ML/AI team (agent consumption) — without owning any of those teams — to keep the whole pipeline reliable, well-governed, and fast to build on.What are the responsibilities for this role? 🧠 Own and evolve Yalo's data platform, ensuring 99.9% uptime and clear SLAs across analytics and AI use cases. Define a modular, real-time, agent-ready data architecture — modeled for both human dashboard consumers and LLM-based agents like IRIS. Own the semantic layer — the single source of truth that keeps metrics consistent across Looker, Power BI, and IRIS. Prevent the dashboard sprawl and definition drift that comes from ungoverned, ad hoc modeling. Build and maintain a semantic and annotated data layer that lets both agents and humans reason over Yalo's core business concepts, not just query raw tables. Own data governance — the tiered, role-based access framework (CSM/PM/Ops/Power User) that routes all access through governed data. Define stage ownership and interfaces — the explicit boundary between Data Engineering (ingestion/modeling) and Business Analytics (dashboard build), so both teams can move independently without stepping on each other's data. Drive cost governance across BigQuery, dbt, Kafka, and Airflow — targeting 20%+ infrastructure cost efficiency improvement, continuing the team's track record (a prior tooling consolidation already cut one cost line by 95%). Lead technical incident response when pipelines break or produce incorrect data, especially where client-facing dashboards or agent outputs are affected. Set technical standards and mentor engineers across teams who touch the data layer — through code review, documentation, and architecture decisions, not people-management authority. Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, the incoming Analytics PM (stakeholder synthesis), Business Analytics, and the ML/AI team to keep the full pipeline — events → ingest/model → dashboards/agents — running end to end.Job Requirements? 💻Education: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.Experience: 8+ years in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering, including significant time operating at a staff/principal level of technical ownership (architecture decisions, cross-team standards) rather than as a people manager.Technical Skills Deep, hands-on expertise with modern data stacks: Airflow, dbt, BigQuery, Kafka, and GCP-native tooling. Strong understanding of streaming pipelines, orchestration, ELT, and real-time data systems. Proficiency in Python, SQL, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent). Experience designing and operating semantic/metrics layers (dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Cube, or equivalent) serving multiple downstream consumers. Familiarity with ML systems in production well enough to architect data for them — monitoring, drift detection, A/B testing context — without owning the model deployment itself (that's a separate function). Experience with data governance and access-control frameworks (role-based access, data classification, audit trails).Problem-Solving: Comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-team architecture problems — this role exists specifically because "who owns which stage of the data pipeline" hasn't had a clear technical owner.Soft Skills that matter to us 🫀 Agentic mindset – You think in systems that act, not just flow. You build infrastructure to enable autonomy, not just availability. Ownership – Accountable from architecture to uptime, without needing direct reports to get there. Clarity communicator – Explains complex systems in business terms and aligns stakeholders without jargon. Influence without authority – Sets technical direction and raises the bar for teams you don't manage, through credibility and documentation. Proactivity – Doesn't wait for roadblocks; prevents them. Customer obsession – Cares about internal data customers (CS, Product, leadership) as much as the end user.Metrics to measure 📈 99.9% uptime of critical data pipelines. 95%+ of core KPIs covered by the semantic layer or a governed data API (vs. raw/ungoverned sources). ≥20% cost reduction across BigQuery, dbt, and streaming infrastructure. 100% of critical pipelines migrated to automated, observable frameworks. Time-to-build for new dashboard/agent data needs, trending down as the semantic layer matures.What do we offer? 🥰 Unlimited PTO policy Competitive rewards on the market range Remote/Hybrid working available (Córdoba preferred; Guatemala City, São Paulo, Mexico City also open) Flexible time (driven by results) Start-up environment International teamwork You and nothing else limit your career hereWe care,We keep it simple,We make it happen,We strive for excellence.At Yalo, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that embodies our core values: caring, initiative, excellence, and simplicity. We believe in the power of diversity and inclusivity, where everyone's unique perspectives, experiences, and talents contribute to our collective success. As we embrace and respect our differences, we strive to create something extraordinary for the benefit of all.We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal opportunities to individuals regardless of race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Our commitment to fairness and equality is a fundamental pillar of our company.At Yalo, we uphold a culture of excellence. We constantly challenge ourselves to go above and beyond, delivering remarkable results and driving innovation. We encourage each team member to take initiative and make things happen, empowering them to bring their best ideas forward and contribute to our shared goals.

We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being.About the RoleWe’re looking for an MLOps Engineer to join our Engineering team as the senior technical reference for ML and AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on architecture and leadership role, working embedded with a global fintech client: you won’t own product models yourself, but you will shape how every model and AI component is trained, deployed, monitored and run in production, enabling Data Science and AI teams to take their work from idea to production in a reliable, observable and compliant way.Key ResponsibilitiesYou will define and evolve the end-to-end ML platform architecture (data, training, model registry, serving, monitoring and governance) used by multiple squads, and set the standard patterns teams build on: reproducible training pipelines and experiment tracking, model packaging, versioning and promotion flows from dev to production, and online and batch inference with safe rollout strategies such as canary, shadow deployments and rollback. You will balance reliability, performance and cost for ML workloads, working closely with SRE, Infrastructure and FinOps.You will be the go-to reference for complex MLOps questions, reviewing and challenging the design of new models and data pipelines so they meet platform standards and non-functional requirements. You will partner with product squads such as Fraud and Anomaly Detection to establish clear SLAs and SLOs, proper logging, metrics and alerting, and you will strengthen on-call readiness through playbooks, dashboards and incident reviews.A core part of the role is using agents and AI services to automate as much of MLOps as possible: feature store operations (pipelines, backfills, parity checks, data quality and drift monitoring), training and evaluation pipelines, promotion gates and rollbacks, runbook generation, alert triage and incident enrichment, and cost optimization recommendations. You will define the infrastructure, contracts and guardrails to consume these AI services safely, and contribute to their evaluation, observability and safety (prompts, policies, PII redaction and auditability) together with the AI team.You will also set technical standards for model and data access control, PII handling, auditability of model changes and deployments, and environment separation, working with InfoSec and Architecture to stay aligned with regulatory requirements while keeping the platform practical for engineers and data scientists. Finally, you will mentor MLOps and Data/ML engineers on system design, reliability, observability and CI/CD for ML, and lead design and architecture reviews that help teams converge on simple, robust solutions.Required ExperienceSolid experience owning or designing MLOps platforms or ML infrastructure used by multiple teams.Strong hands-on experience building and operating production ML workloads on Databricks, including Feature Store (ideally with Unity Catalog), MLflow experiment tracking and model lifecycle management, and batch and real-time model deployment.Experience building production-grade ML pipelines: experiment tracking, reproducible training, model registry, CI/CD for models and data pipelines, and online and batch inference at scale.Strong background in distributed systems and data/stream processing (Spark, Flink or similar).Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) and container-based deployments.Strong understanding of observability for ML systems: metrics, logs and traces, as well as data and model drift, freshness and quality checks.Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating infrastructure and AI/ML trade-offs into business language.Especially ValuedExperience rolling out AI assistants inside engineering organizations (code or infra copilots, AI-powered log analysis), including policies and best practices.Exposure to LLM and AI infrastructure such as gateways, vector stores and evaluation harnesses.Prior experience as Technical Referent, Tech Lead or Architect for platforms or shared services.Contributions to internal standards, RFCs, guilds or tech communities.Benefits20 paid days off per year.Hybrid work model.Flex Days: monthly team activities.Professional development courses.Internal clubs (soccer, padel, running, cinema).LocationMontevideo, Uruguay.Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Corrientes or Chaco, Argentina.· Hybrid work arrangement

postings.title: Senior Data Engineer (LATAM based)
postings.descriptionText: Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact, guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.We’re hiring a Senior Data Engineer to build the structured core of a governed data foundation on Databricks, used by AI agents, applications, and business teams. You own everything that has to be exact: business entities reconciled across systems that use different identifiers, facts with their source and validity period, business definitions turned into certified tables, access control, and the APIs and MCP tools that serve this data with the caller’s permissions.Conflicting definitions and identifiers are business problems as much as joins. The right person has spent years on Databricks making data correct and consistent, has enforced access control in production, and knows where platform controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start. You work autonomously with business stakeholders and ask the uncomfortable questions about definitions and permissions early.You’ll work in a small team (solution architect, AI engineer, full-stack engineer, data quality lead, product and project managers) alongside the client’s data platform team. You follow their conventions and hand over what you build. The AI engineer owns the parts that need a model: knowledge from documents, retrieval, agent behavior, and evals. You give them the trusted data those parts depend on. AI tools speed up your modeling, SQL, testing, and documentation every day, and you know exactly when to trust the output and when not to.Required Qualifications6+ years of professional data engineering, building production-grade pipelines and data models3+ years hands-on with Databricks in production, including Unity CatalogExpert SQL and Python: writes, debugs, optimizes, and refactors pipelines unaided. Spark/PySpark a plusStrong data modeling, including history-aware techniques (SCD Type 2, effective dating, temporal validity), with provenance and lineage designed in from the startData quality and testing discipline: tests and expectations in pipelines (dbt tests, Great Expectations, or similar) and CI/CD for dataReconciling data across systems: entity resolution or master dataIncremental and change-driven processing (CDC, streaming, or incremental frameworks) against freshness targetsPractical data governance: has implemented access control in production (row-level security, column masking, or role/attribute-based access) and knows where platform-level controls stop and application-level enforcement has to startHas built APIs or services that serve dataSenior judgment: works autonomously, challenges unclear definitions, prioritizes by risk, owns outcomes without micromanagementDaily use of AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar), with the judgment to know when to trust the outputC1 English; comfortable working fully remote and directly with a client teamPreferrableExposing data to applications through APIs or MCPsMulti-tenant data isolation for customer-facing products, with security and negative testingFinance or CRM data (NetSuite, Salesforce)Consolidating data across acquired companies or business unitsIngesting and governing unstructured content (documents, wikis, contracts) alongside structured dataTurning business definitions into a shared semantic or metrics layer with business or finance stakeholdersFinOps / cost attribution on data platformsWhat This Person Will Own And Do Day-to-dayIngestion and source strategyBuild and maintain ingestion and ETL pipelines from business systems (ERP, CRM, product databases), operational tools, and document repositories. Build data lakes in Databricks that software, people, and AI agents can all query. Decide per source whether to ingest, index and link, or query live, based on volatility, volume, and which system is the record. Work with raw data in its source-system shape without waiting on upstream cleanup.Entities and factsImplement the entity model defined with the solution architect and resolve identity across systems, reusing existing matching work and sending ambiguous matches to the owner who decides. Model facts with source, validity period, validation status, and documented exceptions. Turn business definitions validated by their owners into certified tables, recording who signed off. Implement authority rules per data item and keep unresolved conflicts visible. Deliver finance numbers that are deterministic, reproducible, and traceable to source records.Access and isolationImplement access policies in Databricks and carry them into derived data. Enforce isolation at the database, tool, and application layers for consumers who aren’t Databricks users, such as external customers. Build isolation tests at the data and API layer, including similarly named customers, and run them as a release gate.Structured sources and freshnessIntegrate the structured sources each increment needs (CRM, ERP, payment processors, product data, spreadsheets), starting from what’s already in Databricks. Meet freshness targets and expose freshness with each fact. Track dependencies so facts and certified tables are updated or flagged when a source or definition changes. Own data quality checks, observability, and cost visibility.Data interfacesBuild the APIs, webhooks, and MCP tools that query and filter facts deterministically, carrying the caller’s identity and permissions on every request. Log every access with the sources it used.Collaboration and handoverGive the AI engineer the facts, entity IDs, and access rules that knowledge and agents depend on. Work with the full-stack engineer on the owners’ review interface and with the data quality lead on acceptance criteria. Be the technical voice on data feasibility in discovery and design sessions, and document and hand over your work to the client’s team.AI-augmented engineeringUse AI tools daily for SQL and Python, schema mapping, definition drafting, test generation, and documentation. Review every AI-assisted output with care: a force multiplier, not a shortcut.Perks💵 Monthly USD Service Fee🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays🐣Caregiver Time Off💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!🚀An entrepreneurial environment.About UsIn 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

postings.title: Client Technology - Engineering - Architecture - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText: Hands-on architecture leadership for EY Fabric, EY’s global technology platformThis is an architecture role for someone who combines strategic judgement with practical engineering delivery. The successful applicant will shape direction and define robust designs, while staying close to implementation through prototyping, code and design reviews, technical problem-solving and direct collaboration with engineering teams.The opportunity and EY FabricEY Fabric is EY’s global foundational technology platform for building, running and scaling technology solutions. It brings together reusable cloud, data, intelligence, developer and business-enablement capabilities, supported by self-service workflows and built-in governance, so teams can deliver secure products faster and more consistently.In this role, you will be part of the Client Technology Architecture function and will work within a team leading key aspects of the architecture of EY Fabric, part of the wider Fabric engineering function. You will work across business, product, architecture, security, platform and engineering teams to translate outcomes into pragmatic technical direction and successful delivery.The role spans the full delivery lifecycle. You will help shape product vision and roadmaps, develop architecture options and detailed designs, support planning and investment decisions, and remain actively engaged hands-on as solutions are built, tested, operated and improved. You will be expected to move comfortably between senior stakeholder conversations and detailed technical work with engineers, doing hands-on coding and engineering where needed to progress work through to production.Key responsibilitiesPartner with Product Managers and other stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify requirements and translate them into pragmatic product and platform architecture.Lead aspects of the EY Fabric architecture, owning or guiding the technology and design direction for assigned platform capabilities from early concept and option analysis through delivery, adoption, operation and evolution.Ensure designs work coherently across EY Fabric, including its platform APIs, developer workflows, portal and user experience, reusable cloud capabilities, identity and access patterns, data services, observability and integration points.Produce clear architecture blueprints, designs, architectural decision records, reference patterns and implementation guidance, using your judgement as to what is required.Design secure, scalable and reusable services, APIs, integration patterns, datastores, user-facing capabilities and common platform components.Work directly with engineering teams to turn architecture into working software, including hands-on prototyping, proof-of-concept development, code review, pair design, troubleshooting and design assurance.Solve complex problems where an established solution may not exist by evaluating technologies, testing assumptions, considering build-versus-buy options and presenting evidence-based recommendations.Provide technical leadership throughout delivery, ensuring implemented solutions remain aligned with the intended architecture, quality expectations and enterprise standards.Participate in product and delivery planning, estimation and forecasting; manage architecture work and technical debt; balance cost, risk, quality, security, maintainability and time to market.Mentor engineers and architects, encourage experimentation and knowledge sharing, and contribute to architecture and engineering communities.Monitor relevant technology and industry trends, including AI-assisted engineering, and apply them responsibly where they provide measurable value.Required Skills And ExperienceSignificant experience in solution or technical architecture within complex, large-scale product or internal developer platform environments, with a strong record of successful implementation and adoption.Demonstrable hands-on software engineering capability in at least one modern language such as C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, together with confidence reading, reviewing and improving production code.Broad architecture experience across cloud-native applications, integration, data and security, with the judgement to balance governance, technical quality and delivery pace.Practical Microsoft Azure or other cloud experience across compute, storage, networking, security and identity, including Entra ID, RBAC, Key Vault, Azure Policy and tenant-aware identity patterns.Expertise designing distributed and scalable products and platforms using APIs, microservices, containers and Kubernetes, preferably AKS, across cloud or hybrid environments.Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and DevSecOps practices.Knowledge of modern API design and API Management, including topics such as security, versioning, discoverability, etc.Understanding of secure-by-design practices, compliance expectations, in-application security and operation within enterprise technology standards.Experience designing for reusability, reliability, maintainability, observability, performance, cost optimisation and effective technical debt management.Working knowledge of architecture and design patterns, including microservices, containerised systems, event-driven architecture, data streaming and data platforms.Strong analytical, collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex decisions to senior stakeholders and work effectively across globally distributed teams.Desirable experienceInnerSource, internal developer platforms, reusable engineering assets, platform marketplaces or shared-services models.AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools and workflows, with an understanding of appropriate security, quality and governance controls.Low-code or no-code capabilities, workflow automation, enterprise user-experience patterns, data management or data governance.Architecture or security certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, TOGAF, SAFe or comparable credentials.A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, computer science, information technology or a related discipline.What we are looking forA self-starting, collaborative architect who enjoys solving difficult problems and taking responsibility for outcomes. You should be equally credible with senior stakeholders and engineering teams, comfortable operating across multiple initiatives, and willing to engage directly in design and implementation detail. This role suits someone who views architecture as an active delivery discipline and who can lead through both influence and practical contribution.

postings.descriptionText: About FullStackFullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. of professional experience in Software Engineering, MLOps, ML Engineering.Advanced English is required.Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.Extensive experience building and operating MLOps platforms and production machine learning workflows.Hands-on experience with Vertex AI, MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar MLOps tooling.Strong background in feature stores, feature into engineering workflows.Solid understanding of scalable, reliable, and production-ready ML systems.Familiarity with search or recommendation systems, real-time systems, and latency/performance to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.Forensic attention to detail.A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.Nice To HaveWe’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant PlusCursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.Work Authorization RequirementsApplicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.What We OfferCompetitive pay.100% remote work.The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.Continuing education opportunities.Opportunity to grow and expand your career.Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

postings.title: Consultor/a SAP IS-Oil Retail – Estaciones de Servicio (SSR / RFNO)
postings.descriptionText: Remoto | Full Time | Freelance | Front-End y Back-End | Argentina y LATAMMaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group busca Consultores/as SAP RFNO (Retail Fuel Network Operations), para roles Front-End y Back-End, para sumarse a un servicio AMS de largo plazo sobre SAP S/4HANA en una compañía líder del sector energético / Oil & Gas.Los roles se integran a una célula ágil de consultores funcionales y técnicos, con foco en la operación de la red de estaciones de servicio, sus movimientos y liquidaciones.EL DESAFÍOLa red de estaciones de servicio genera un volumen enorme de movimientos diarios: ventas, entregas, mediciones y liquidaciones que tienen que reflejarse correctamente en el sistema.Según el rol, vas a ser referente funcional o soporte especializado de RFNO dentro de una célula ágil, sosteniendo la operación diaria y llevando adelante evolutivos sobre S/4HANA.RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALESFront-End: ser referente funcional de SAP RFNO en el servicio de soporte y evolución.Back-End: dar soporte funcional y resolver GAPs del módulo junto al referente.Gestionar los procesos de operación de la red de estaciones, movimientos y liquidaciones.Relevar requerimientos con usuarios clave y traducirlos en diseño funcional.Configurar el módulo y acompañar desarrollos, pruebas integrales y pruebas de aceptación (UAT).Resolver incidentes y evolutivos dentro de los acuerdos de nivel de servicio, con análisis de causa raíz.Documentar soluciones y transferir conocimiento al equipo y a los usuarios.REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTESExperiencia funcional comprobable en SAP RFNO (Retail Fuel Network Operations), según el rol: Front-End (referente funcional), al menos 10 años en la especialidad; Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs), al menos 3 años.Experiencia en procesos de redes de estaciones de servicio: movimientos, conciliaciones y liquidaciones.Experiencia real en SAP S/4HANA (proyectos o servicios AMS). No aplica experiencia limitada a R/3 / ECC.Ciclo funcional: relevamiento de requerimientos, diseño funcional, configuración y pruebas.Para el rol Front-End: experiencia con SAP Activate o ASAP.CONOCIMIENTOS DESEABLESExperiencia previa en IS-Oil SSR (Service Station Retailing) y migración a RFNO.Integración con SD, FI y sistemas de punto de venta.Experiencia previa en la industria Oil & Gas.CONDICIONES DE LA POSICIÓNModalidad: Remoto, con reuniones presenciales puntuales en Puerto Madero (CABA) para residentes en AMBADedicación: Full timeContratación: Freelance / contractorRol: Front-End (referente funcional, senior experto) o Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs)Inicio: A coordinarDuración: Servicio de largo plazoUbicación: Argentina o LatinoaméricaPara residentes en Argentina, prepaga de salud 100% bonificada. El CV es evaluado por el cliente final, que puede entrevistar a los candidatos antes de la incorporación.POSTULACIÓNSi querés trabajar en una solución clave para la operación de una de las principales compañías de energía de la región, esta es tu oportunidad.Postulate por este mismo medio con tu CV actualizado, indicando tarifa pretendida por hora (con moneda), país de residencia y disponibilidad para comenzar.
locations: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina

postings.title: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging)
postings.descriptionText: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.We are hiring talented Software Engineers with strong Python, Packaging and Linux skills and who want to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap, rock and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.What we are looking for in youYou have expertise in Python.You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.Use your familiarity with languages, toolchains, frameworks, integrations, and CI systems to extend the snap build ecosystemWork with external open source and commercial projects to understand how we can better serve community needs.What we offer youYour base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annumAnnual compensation reviewRecognition rewardsAnnual holiday leaveParental LeaveEmployee Assistance ProgrammeOpportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company eventsAbout CanonicalCanonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.Canonical is an equal opportunity employerWe are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world, and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. postings.descriptionText: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.Key responsibilitiesBuild and lead a team of engineers in your regionDevelop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career developmentDemonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goalsSet and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholdersLead modern, agile software development practicesEnsure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company valuesBe an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisationBuild automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelinesEngage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partnersWork from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external eventsValued Skills And ExperienceYou love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing itYou are knowledgeable and passionate about software developmentYou are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality softwareYou have experience and commitment to agile development methodologiesYou have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degreeSoftware development experience in Python or GolangEffective written and verbal communication skillsPractical experience with Linux system administrationWhat we offer colleaguesWe consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in shaping and executing the vision and roadmap of our internal AI automation and enterprise workflow orchestration initiatives. systems such as n8n, Claude Code, ServiceNow, and modern AI services, ensuring a holistic approach to enterprise automation.The Senior AI Systems Engineer will work closely with teams across IT, systems, workflows, and services while maintaining governance, stability, and operational rigor.ResponsibilitiesServe as a key contributor in defining the vision, standards, and technical roadmap for handling, logging, error management, and human-in-the-loop controls.Partner with Security, Legal, Privacy, and IT leadership to ensure automation and AI implementations align with governance, compliance, and enterprise security requirements.Help standardize the enterprise automation stack, including orchestration tools, integration patterns, connectors, approval flows, and observability practices.Evaluate platforms, frameworks, and vendors to support long-term maintainability, interoperability, and cost efficiency.Work directly with internal stakeholders to identify manual, repetitive, or high-friction workflows that can be improved through automation, integration, and AI-assisted processes.Build, test, deploy, and support workflow solutions using tools such as n8n, Zapier, ServiceNow, and other orchestration or integration platforms.Develop proofs of concept and production-ready solutions that demonstrate measurable business value, efficiency gains, and improved user experience.Translate complex business and technical requirements into scalable automations, system integrations, and service workflows.Design and maintain reusable components, templates, and integration patterns to reduce duplication and accelerate delivery.Architect and implement integrations between enterprise platforms such as ITSM, collaboration tools, identity systems, knowledge systems, ticketing platforms, and AI services.Build and maintain automation flows that leverage REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven triggers, database connectors, and secure credential handling.Support AI use cases involving LLM APIs, prompt orchestration, tool calling, workflow routing, contextual enrichment, and response validation.Collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure automations are resilient, observable, and aligned with platform best practices.Contribute to environment setup, release processes, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance for automation services.Monitor automation health, reliability, usage trends, error rates, and performance across platforms and workflows.Troubleshoot complex workflow failures, integration issues, API errors, authentication problems, and data handling gaps across systems.Establish support processes, technical documentation, runbooks, and operational standards for ongoing maintenance and service continuity.Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce operational cost, simplify workflows, and increase platform adoption.Track platform usage and help optimize licensing, vendor utilization, and AI/API consumption where applicable.Partner with cross-functional technical and business teams to prioritize automation opportunities and align execution with Medallia IT goals.Present architecture recommendations, implementation plans, status updates, and technical proposals to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Mentor peers and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.Act as an escalation point for complex L3 issues related to workflow automation, orchestration, integrations, and enterprise platform logic.Work onsite at our office as needed to collaborate and drive initiatives forward; flexible work arrangements available otherwise.Candidates based in the Buenos Aires vicinity will be prioritized as this role is Hybrid, 3 days per week onsite.QualificationsMinimum QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.4+ years of experience in systems engineering, platform engineering, enterprise applications, automation, or related technical roles.Demonstrated experience with enterprise workflow and automation tools such as Claude code, n8n, Zapier (optional), ServiceNow, or equivalent integration/orchestration platforms.Demonstrated experience designing and supporting complex integrations using APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, authentication methods, and event-driven workflows.Practical experience working with modern AI services and frameworks, including LLM-based workflows, prompt design, automation logic, and tool orchestration.Demonstrated understanding of enterprise systems, service workflows, IT operations, and support models in complex environments.Demonstrated experience with scripting or automation using one or more languages such as Python, JavaScript, Bash, or PowerShell.Demonstrated troubleshooting skills across workflow logic, integration failures, API behavior, authentication, and platform dependencies.Demonstrated experience documenting technical designs, support procedures, runbooks, and operational standards.Ability to work from the office as needed and travel to various global offices for various projects as needed.English proficiency, both written and oral.Preferred QualificationsExperience implementing AI-enabled enterprise automation use cases across IT, support, operations, or business systems.Familiarity with agentic or orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, semantic workflow tooling, vector-backed retrieval patterns, or similar technologies.Experience administering or integrating with ServiceNow modules related to ITSM, request management, knowledge workflows, or catalog automation.Experience with SaaS integrations across systems such as Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Jira, Salesforce, Okta, or similar enterprise platforms.Understanding of governance considerations for enterprise AI, including approval patterns, prompt/version control, access boundaries, auditability, and usage tracking.Experience with observability, monitoring, dashboarding, and reporting for workflow reliability, SLA performance, and platform usage.Familiarity with ITIL-based service delivery environments.Experience working in a fast-paced, flat, agile, and globally distributed organization.Certifications in ServiceNow, Azure, automation platforms, integration technologies, or relevant cloud/AI technologies.At Medallia, we celebrate diversity and recognize the value it brings to our customers and employees. Medallia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, genetic information, veteran status or military service, or any other status protected by state or local law. Individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to apply please contact us at ApplicantAccessibility@medallia.com. For information regarding how Medallia collects and uses personal information, please review our Privacy Policies. postings.descriptionText: Building the Future of Open FinancePayward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.The teamFounded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. maintaining design systems or component libraries at scaleA track record of thriving in fast-paced environments and delivering projects quicklyA passion for establishing best practices and improving developer experience across teamsStrong communication skills to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers across the organizationSkills You Should HODL4+ years of experience in advanced CSS and translating design mockups into pixel-perfect, responsive interfacesExperience building or contributing to design systems or component librariesStrong experience with modern frontend build tools and tooling (webpack, vite, etc.)Experience with API design and integration (RESTful APIs, GraphQL)Proficiency with frontend testing frameworks and component testing best practicesExperience working with or integrating a CMS (custom-built or headless)Strong understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and UI/UX best practicesExperience within a large technology organization or fast-growing startupStrong written and verbal communication skills in EnglishNice to havesKnowledge of the cryptocurrency industry and blockchain technologyExperience with Next.js and postings.title: Senior Database Administrator (SQL Server)
postings.descriptionText: Company OverviewAt Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.Position DescriptionWe're seeking a Senior Database Administrator to own the health, performance, and reliability of our on-premises Microsoft SQL Server estate, with growing exposure to Azure SQL. This is a hands-on role for a seasoned DBA who is equally comfortable tuning a stubborn query, architecting a high-availability topology, and troubleshooting the Windows Server layer beneath the database. You'll be the senior technical authority on all things SQL Server and a key partner to engineering, infrastructure, and application teams.Responsibilities Database Administration & Operations Install, configure, patch, and maintain SQL Server instances across production, staging, and development environments Manage database security: logins, roles, permissions, encryption (TDE), and auditing Own backup and recovery strategy, including regular restore testing and RTO/RPO validation Manage capacity planning, storage growth, and database file/filegroup layout Performance & Optimization Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks using execution plans, wait statistics, DMVs, Query Store, and Extended Events Tune indexes, statistics, and T-SQL; partner with developers to improve query and schema design Establish and maintain performance baselines, alerting, and monitoring High Availability & Disaster Recovery Design, implement, and maintain HA/DR solutions: Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering, log shipping, and replication Conduct failover testing and maintain documented, tested recovery procedures Windows Systems Administration Administer the Windows Server layer supporting SQL Server: OS patching, service accounts, disk/storage configuration, and Windows Failover Clustering Troubleshoot at the intersection of OS, storage, network, and database Manage Active Directory service accounts, group policy considerations, and NTFS/share permissions relevant to SQL Server Automation & Maintenance Automate routine administration, deployments, and monitoring using PowerShell and T-SQL (e.g., dbatools, SQL Agent jobs, Ola Hallengren's maintenance solution) Build and maintain repeatable, documented processes for provisioning and configuration Cloud (Azure SQL) Administer and support Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance workloads Assist with hybrid connectivity and on-prem-to-Azure migration efforts as the estate evolves Must Have Skills 6+ years of hands-on SQL Server database administration in production environments Deep expertise in performance tuning, query optimization, and index strategy Proven experience designing and operating HA/DR solutions (Always On AGs, clustering, log shipping, replication) Strong Windows Server administration skills, including Windows Failover Clustering, storage, and service account management Proficiency with T-SQL and PowerShell scripting for automation Solid understanding of backup/recovery, security, and disaster recovery best practices Experience with SQL Server monitoring and diagnostic tooling (DMVs, Query Store, Extended Events, Profiler/traces) Strong troubleshooting instincts and a calm, methodical approach under pressure (including on-call/incident response)Documentation discipline and a bias toward automating repetitive workPreferred Skills Experience with Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance and hybrid cloud environments Familiarity with the dbatools PowerShell module and community maintenance solutions Experience with SSIS/SSRS/SSAS or related BI components Exposure to CI/CD for database changes (e.g., dacpac deployments, source-controlled schema) Relevant certifications (Microsoft SQL Server / Azure Database Administrator Associate) Experience across multiple SQL Server versions and large or highly transactional estates Professional SkillsClear written and verbal communication; able to explain database concepts to non-DBA stakeholdersCollaborative partner to developers, infrastructure teams, and application ownersMaintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by natureHigh standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality resultsSelf-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or interventionDemonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

postings.title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
postings.descriptionText: About AIOSAIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan:Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOSBeing a Web Designer at AIOSWe’re building a world-class team.As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)Key responsibilitiesYou’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks. High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time. Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land. Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy. Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer. AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand. Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high. Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does. Need to haveExperience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals. User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision. Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land. Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential. AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further. Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it. Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week. Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed. Nice to haveCRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests. Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next. Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints. Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries. Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale. Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages. SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed. Our cultural standardsWe aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. 🎯"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."Compensation & BenefitsYou get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equityBenefitsThe stuff below is cool as well.Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate). Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely. Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching. Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps. GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s. Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy. Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm. Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed. What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture. How to applyApply via Ashby and be sure to include:your resume and portfolio2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversiona short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today
