postings.title: Solutions Engineer
postings.descriptionText: Job Title: Solutions EngineerAbout Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.What You'll Do:Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration pathLead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholdersDesign integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responsesSupport merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoffValidate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlementTroubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchantTranslate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenueBuild and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every callAct as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yetWhat We Look For:4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account managementExperience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaksExperience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacksHands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation criticallyWorking knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScriptFamiliarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into itUnderstanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product managementAbility to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineersStrong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely onComfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environmentAbility to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementationDemonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.Preferred QualificationsExperience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL providerFamiliarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkoutExperience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrationsBachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experienceAbout You:You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do thingsYou need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.#Full-time

This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experienceAbout the Role: We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.What You’ll Do: Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.What We Look For:6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments. Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages. Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs. Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.Preferred Knowledge and Skills:Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products.Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security.Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.About You: You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.Sezzle’s Technology Stack:Languages: Golang, Typescript, PythonFrontend: Typescript - React and React NativeBackend: GolangDatabase: MySQL, Postgres, ElasticsearchDevOps & Cloud: AWS, KubernetesVersion Control: GitCI/CD: GitlabTesting: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit testsOpen Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!Compensation:For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experienceAbout the Role: We are seeking a hands-on, high-impact Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response, to strengthen security operations at Sezzle: detection, incident response, and vulnerability management across our cloud infrastructure and applications.You will join the team that runs our SIEM and detection capability — from log ingestion and audit coverage to detection rules, alert tuning, and investigation workflows — so that access to sensitive systems is attributable and suspicious activity is caught and attributed by our own detections. You will operate the vulnerability-management loop end-to-end, and when incidents happen, you will lead the investigation and see the long-term fix through. You should consider yourself a DOer - someone who is comfortable diving into logs, analyzing systems, validating findings, and working end-to-end to get issues resolved.You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and network and zero trust — your detection and response work is what proves their controls hold. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to work on real-world security problems at scale. At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows for alert triage, investigation, and threat hunting that multiply what the team can cover.What You’ll Do: Build, operate, and mature SIEM/XDR capabilities, including log ingestion, detection rule development, alert tuning, and investigation workflowsDesign and implement detection strategies for suspicious activity, including data exfiltration patterns using application and database telemetryExtend audit and attribution coverage across the estate — Kubernetes audit logs, database audit logging, SSO and access-path telemetry — so access to sensitive data is attributable to a person or workload, with retention aligned to compliance requirementsInvestigate and respond to security incidents across cloud infrastructure and applications, performing root cause analysis and driving long-term fixesRun proactive threat hunts across cloud and identity planes, building agentic hunting workflows that make hunts repeatableOperate vulnerability management across infrastructure, platforms, and applications - including internal scans, dependency analysis, and external findings, validating true positives and driving remediation with engineering teamsTriage and validate external security findings (including bug bounty reports), distinguishing true positives and coordinating remediationContribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for the detection, logging, and incident-response implications of new systemsApply strong AWS and Kubernetes judgment to secure the systems you operate and advise owning teams on remediationSupport and implement security controls aligned with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other compliance requirements — with your logging and detection work producing the audit evidence as a by-productDevelop and implement automation (including AI) to improve efficiency in security operations, detection, and responseParticipate in the on-call rotation for detection and response and the services you ownWhat We Look For:6+ years of experience in security, software, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on experience securing cloud-based production systems and working with real-world security challenges Experience working with SIEM platforms (e.g., Wazuh, Splunk, ELK) for detection engineering, monitoring, and incident response Experience designing and tuning detection rules, reducing alert noise, and improving investigation workflows Strong hands-on experience in vulnerability management — scanning, triage and validation of scanner and bug-bounty findings, remediation coordination, and verification Strong knowledge of AWS, Linux, and Kubernetes infrastructure, including security architecture and operational best practices Ability to investigate issues directly using logs, cloud tooling, and system-level data Experience assessing the detection and logging implications of new systems in design reviews Knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies (OWASP, SANS, etc.) Working knowledge of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC 2, particularly logging, monitoring, and evidence expectations Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today, and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't Preferred Knowledge and Skills:You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — triage, enrichment, or huntingFamiliarity with log-based detection, telemetry pipelines, and security analytics use casesExperience with internal penetration testing or adversarial exercises, and translating results into detection and remediation workStrong understanding of cloud-native security controls, including IAM, network segmentation, and container securityExperience with container and dependency security tools (e.g., Snyk, Trivy, Grype) as an operator of their findingsExperience aligning technical security work with regulatory and compliance expectationsExperience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environmentsAbout You: You think like an investigator - you turn telemetry into detections and detections into answers, and you are not done until the root cause is fixed.You treat attribution as an engineering deliverable - every access to sensitive data has a name on it, and every finding has an owner and a date.You are excited to use automation and emerging technologies (including AI) to take repetitive security work off the team's plateYou balance strong security standards with business needs and can support privacy and compliance requirements in a practical, scalable wayYou have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do thingsYou need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.Sezzle’s Technology Stack:Languages: Golang, Typescript, PythonFrontend: Typescript - React and React NativeBackend: GolangDatabase: MySQL, Postgres, ElasticsearchDevOps & Cloud: AWS, KubernetesVersion Control: GitCI/CD: GitlabTesting: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit testsOpen Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.#Full-time

postings.title: Senior Security Engineer - xStocks
postings.descriptionText: Building the Future of Open FinancePayward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.The teamxStocks brings real-world assets on-chain as tokenized securities that are regulated, fully-backed, and tradable across multiple blockchains. Built within Payward, the xStocks team runs the infrastructure that issues, custodies, and settles these instruments across EVM, Solana, TON, Tron, and more. The platform moves real value, so security is not a feature bolted on at the end. It is a property of everything the team ships. This is a hybrid engineering and security seat built for someone who is genuinely both: you ship products alongside the engineering team when the security queue is quiet, and you own security work end to end when it lands. You report into engineering and partner closely with the Payward security, CISO, and compliance functions.The opportunityOwn security deliverables end to end. Coordinate and review smart-contract audits, respond to security questionnaires and due-diligence requests, support CISO and compliance initiatives, and turn findings into tracked, closed-out fixes.Run offensive assessments against our own platforms. Pentest the web apps, APIs, backend services, and on-chain components, and build the tooling to do it repeatedly rather than once.Continuously assess posture. Threat-model new and existing systems, review architecture and key-management flows, and maintain a living view of the risks and their mitigations.Review code for security. Be a default reviewer on changes touching auth, cryptography, custody, signing, and fund movement across our chains.Harden the platform. Improve secrets handling, IAM and least-privilege, dependency and supply-chain hygiene, and detection and logging for security-relevant events.Secure custody and signing workflows. Review and harden transaction signing flows, MPC and HSM integrations, signer permissions, admin roles, approval policies, and break-glass procedures.Contribute to product engineering. Pick up regular backlog work in TypeScript so you stay close to the codebase you are defending.Support incidents. Help with detection, triage, response, and post-mortems, and feed the lessons back into the program.What you bringAn engineer first. You write and review production code comfortably, TypeScript and Node.js in our stack, and you understand systems deeply enough to break them.Strong application and infrastructure security fundamentals. The OWASP-class vulnerability landscape, authn and authz, injection, SSRF, supply-chain risk, and secure design. You have done real offensive work in pentesting, vuln research, or red-team.Applied cryptography and blockchain security. Symmetric and asymmetric primitives, hashing, signatures, and key management, plus the security model of EVM, Solana, and ideally TON or Tron. You can read a smart contract and reason about how it fails.Ownership. You can take an ambiguous security item, an audit, a questionnaire, or an incident, and drive it to closure without being managed through it.Clear communication. You can explain a risk to engineers, to a CISO, and to an auditor, and tailor the message to each.An automation instinct. You do not want to catch the same issue manually twice, so you turn findings into tests, alerts, controls, documentation, or platform improvements.Risk judgment. You can tell a theoretical issue from a material one, and communicate severity, likelihood, impact, and remediation tradeoffs clearly.Nice to haveExperience commissioning or remediating third-party smart-contract audits.Familiarity with custody and signing infrastructure such as HSMs, MPC, and ForDefi-style providers, and with on-chain transaction security.Cloud security depth in GCP or AWS, IAM, and container and runtime hardening.Detection engineering and security observability, including SIEM and log-based detections.Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or GWAPT.Prior work in a regulated fintech or tokenization/DeFi environment.Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.Our commitmentPayward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.Stay connectedFollow us on TwitterLearn on the Kraken BlogConnect on LinkedInCandidate Privacy Notice

postings.title: Cloud Security Engineer - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText: Security Technology – Cloud Security EngineerEY TechnologyToday’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.The opportunityWe are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer to join our Security Technology Services Engineering team. In this role you will help design and deliver organization-wide secure development capabilities, including standardized CI/CD patterns that embed security tooling and quality gates, so teams can build and ship securely at scale. You will also contribute to cloud security engineering across Azure, AWS, and GCP, including CNAPP platforms such as Wiz, and support selective use of AI to strengthen security workflows and guide secure AI adoption. You will work alongside like-minded engineers, partner across technology and security teams, and help make security automated, consistent, and easier for developers to adopt.Your Key ResponsibilitiesAs an individual contributor, you’ll bring your engineering expertise into efforts which introduce new technologies and upgrade existing ones. You will work closely with Teams across EY such as: Security Architects, Service Delivery, Security Operations, and Cyber Defense for the enablement of security solutions and services. You will also provide consulting services to other teams and act as a level four contact for operational issues.Provide technical oversight of Information Security technologies that fall under the team’s responsibilities, confirming they are operating within agreed service levels and at peak possible performanceRepresent the team in specific Project activities, including Leading projects and managing the activity of others towards successful completion.Engineer security solutions and services following all relevant EY standards and practices for On-Premises, Hybrid and Cloud-Based environments.Lead the design, implementation, testing of security solutions and services for a large or more complex project to its completion which includes production support and documentation.Take accountability for the design, delivery, and maintenance of new and existing security solutions or services, driving compliance with and contributing to the development of relevant standards.Apply modern standards/principles, global product-specific guidelines, security standards, design standards, to security solutions and services as appropriate.Improve existing security solutions and services in use by partnering with Security Architecture, Service Owners, and Security Operations. Drives automation and innovation across the security solutions supported.Work in a diverse, global environment and build strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically, and culturally dispersed organization.Be flexible to work out of regular office hours to accommodate the team and organizational calls and meetings. Weekend or late-night work may occur during project and early life cycle support phases.No direct supervision responsibilities though technical leadership required within assigned projects.Articulate technology issues/concerns that may emerge at any level of the technical stack, and from any component across the ecosystem, to senior business and technology leaders.Skills And Attributes For SuccessWe are interested in engineers who blend DevOps/automation and security in large enterprise environments; people who improve developer experience by making security standardized and easy to adopt, while also applying strong cloud security judgment across platforms and tooling. Success in this role means collaborating with technical teams, stakeholders, and internal customers to deliver practical, scalable solutions.To qualify for the role, you must haveHands-on experience designing or operating DevSecOps / secure CI/CD pipelines that integrate security controls and gate checks (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, or equivalent).Practical experience with several application and software supply-chain security capabilities, such as SAST, SCA/OSS scanning, secrets scanning, DAST, and container image scanning, and helping teams adopt them through standards, templates, or reusable patterns.Hands-on experience with cloud security across one or more major providers (Azure, AWS, GCP), with the ability to apply security controls, automation, and good architectural judgment in cloud environments (Azure experience strongly preferred).Experience with CNAPP / CSPM / CWPP / KSPM capabilities, ideally including Wiz (or comparable platforms), and using findings to drive remediation and secure-by-default patterns.Proficiency in scripting and automation with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar languages.Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent).4+ years of experience in security, DevOps/platform engineering, or software delivery with a strong security focus.Proven track record of working with a team as well as managing projects and initiatives.Proficiency with change control management processes.The ability and desire to train and mentor staff in technical process and best You will work closely with product, engineering and operators to make sure the platform works and keeps working.This is a hands-on, detail-focused role. You will spend your days in the product, testing what’s new, checking what should already work, and writing up what you find so it gets fixed.Test the platform regularly. Cover new releases, rule changes, and edge cases, and run regression checks to make sure existing features still work.Find bugs and document them clearly, with steps to reproduce, severity, and impact. Follow them through until engineering fixes them and you’ve verified the fix.Monitor platform performance and agent activity, flag anything that looks wrong, and escalate it to the right person.Work the approval queues daily. Keep items moving and make sure nothing is left unreviewed.Check agent output against defined checklists and standards, and escalate anything unclear or risky.Note where flows are confusing or inconsistent, and flag them to the team.Write and maintain documentation: test plans, QA checklists, runbooks, and release notes.What You BringExperience in QA, testing, operations, support, or analytics, ideally on a software product or complex systemExceptional attention to detail. Your bug reports and documentation should be easy for anyone to follow.Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard and tell when a number looks off.Fast learner. You pick up new tools and systems quickly and ask thoughtful questions.AI-native habits. You use AI tools in your own work every day, and you’re curious about where they get things wrong.Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputsReliability. un proyecto de calidad de software en una entidad del sector bancario.El rol forma parte del equipo de calidad y se enfoca en el diseño y la ejecución de pruebas técnicas sobre arquitecturas que combinan diferentes tecnologías, con las herramientas que soportan el modelo operativo.EL DESAFÍOAsegurar la calidad técnica de soluciones con arquitecturas y modelos de datos complejos: performance, PRINCIPALESDiseñar y ejecutar pruebas técnicas sobre arquitecturas y modelos de datos complejos que combinan distintas tecnologías.Realizar pruebas de performance y revisión de código estático.Automatizar pruebas y virtualizar servicios con las herramientas del modelo operativo.Gestionar datos de prueba y su enmascaramiento (TDM).Explotar datos con SQL, Python y DB2 (mainframe) para validar resultados.Acompañar implementaciones y pasajes entre ambientes dentro del ciclo de vida de pruebas (STLC).REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTESFormación en sistemas, ingeniería, administración de postings.title: Analista PO Proxy
postings.descriptionText: En Claro promovemos una cultura de respeto e igualdad de oportunidades. Seleccionamos a nuestros talentos basándonos en el valor que pueden agregar a nuestro negocio.Buscamos personas que impulsen resultados con foco en la satisfacción de nuestros clientes con impacto en el negocio, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y actuando con integridad en cada decisión.Tu rol será:Garantizar la soberanía funcional de los dominios de Claro Pay. Serás responsable de transformar las necesidades de negocio en unidades de ejecución técnica ( Slices ) de alta precisión, asegurando que el Definition of Ready (DoR) actúe como un filtro estricto ante el proveedor externo.Tus principales desafíos serán:Slicing Funcional: Fragmentar épicas complejas en historias de usuario verticales y vetar lo que no esté refinado a nivel atómico.Dual Track (Discovery): Anticipar riesgos de negocio, regulatorios y transaccionales para asegurar un impacto nulo en el Core.Auditoría de Proveedores: Validar las historias de usuario granulares, flujos alternativos y tickets de Jira armados por el BA externo.Requerimientos No Funcionales: Definir criterios obligatorios sobre el comportamiento transaccional (reintentos, reversiones, saldos) junto al Tech Lead.Sinergia de Equipo: Articular la viabilidad funcional con el Product Lead, el tamaño de los Slices con Agile Delivery y la integridad técnica con el Tech Lead.Métricas de Éxito: Controlar la varianza en la estimación funcional, mitigar bugs por definición ( Change Failure Rate ) y acelerar la eficiencia de refinamiento.Qué necesitamos de vos:Formación: Estudiantes recibido o avanzado de la carrera en sistemas o afines.Experiencia: Perfil Senior analista de sistemas con experiencia en (Core Banking, Billeteras Virtuales o Gateways de Pago).Conocimientos: Flujos de conciliación, estados de transacciones, motores de reglas y dominio experto de Jira/Confluence como herramientas de auditoría.Competencias: Perfil analítico con alta capacidad para la negociación estratégica con clientes y proveedores. Especialista en diagnósticos rápidos, resolución de problemas y priorización efectiva en entornos dinámicos.¿Que esperamos de vos?Orientación a Resultados: Que orientes tu gestión y tus esfuerzos al logro de los objetivos del negocio, manteniendo un compromiso permanente con la calidad del servicio y la satisfacción de los clientes. Que impulses el avance de tu gestión definiendo prioridades y haciéndote responsable por los resultados alcanzados, buscando permanentemente oportunidades para generar valor y mejorar la experiencia de nuestros clientes.Excelencia: Que trabajes con altos estándares de calidad. Que planifiques tus acciones con precisión, realizando el seguimiento necesario para asegurar resultados sostenibles promoviendo la mejora continua de procesos.Integridad: que actúes con honestidad y coherencia, cumpliendo compromisos y haciéndote responsable por las decisiones y acciones que asumas.El puesto tiene sede en Córdoba Capital ó CABA

Maintain secure and reliable connectivity between Azure, AWS, data centers, external partners, SaaS platforms, and customer-facing services. Troubleshoot routing and connectivity across diverse network platforms. Create, modify, review, and support reusable network Infrastructure as Code and deployment workflows. Lead network-related projects and architecture initiatives from planning through implementation. Challenge existing designs and operating practices when there is a clear opportunity to improve reliability, scalability, security, automation, or operational efficiency. Work independently on complex technical initiatives with limited direct oversight. Maintain accurate network diagrams, architecture documentation, operational procedures, and configuration standards. Participate in network incident response, root-cause analysis, problem management, and corrective-action planning. Support certificate-related network dependencies, including TLS connectivity, certificate renewal coordination, and troubleshooting.Required QualificationsAzure Networking Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting Microsoft Azure networking. Experience with Azure technologies such as VNets, routing, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS, VPNs, ExpressRoute, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex Azure network and application connectivity issues.Infrastructure as Code Hands-on experience using Infrastructure as Code to provision, modify, and manage cloud infrastructure. Understanding of version-controlled infrastructure workflows, code review, repeatability, and configuration management. Ability to work effectively in environments where network infrastructure is increasingly managed through automation rather than manual configuration.Production Application Networking Significant experience supporting networks that directly serve production applications, customer-facing services, or business-critical systems. Strong understanding of application traffic flows, load balancing, firewalls, DNS, routing, latency, availability, and service dependencies. Experience participating in troubleshooting and incident response.Preferred QualificationsTerraform Hands-on experience with Terraform for cloud networking and infrastructure provisioning. Experience creating or modifying reusable Terraform modules. Familiarity with Git-based CI/CD and infrastructure deployment workflows. Ability to use AI effectively while maintaining appropriate engineering review and validation.Network Design & Architecture Experience working with a network architect to determine the best network solution. Experience interpreting complex network architectures and documenting them accurately. Ability to make recommendations to application engineers based on reliability, security, scalability, performance, and operational complexity.Project Leadership Experience leading technically complex network or infrastructure initiatives. Willingness to challenge legacy processes, designs, and assumptions when better technical solutions exist, rather than simply maintaining the status quo. Ability to drive technical change, build consensus, and move projects toward implementation.Project Independence Demonstrated ability to independently own engineering initiatives from requirements through implementation. Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and next steps without requiring continuous management direction. Strong judgment regarding when to escalate technical or operational concerns.Next-Generation Firewall Experience Experience with technologies such as Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, or comparable platforms. Strong understanding of firewall policy design, segmentation, NAT, VPNs, traffic inspection, logging, and troubleshooting.Physical Routing & Switching Experience with enterprise routers and switches in production environments. Strong understanding of BGP, OSPF, VLANs, trunks, Layer 2/Layer 3 design, route redistribution, and high-availability network design. Experience integrating physical data-center networks with cloud environments.Cloudflare Experience with Cloudflare services such as DNS, WAF, load balancing, and related edge-networking capabilities. Understanding of how Cloudflare integrates with cloud and on-premises application architectures.Datadog Experience with Datadog or a similar observability platform, particularly Network Performance Monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, dashboards, alerting, log correlation, or APM-related troubleshooting. Ability to use observability data to distinguish network issues from application or infrastructure problems.Network Incident Management & Analysis Experience participating in production network incident response. Ability to perform root-cause analysis and distinguish symptoms from underlying causes. Experience developing corrective actions designed to prevent recurrence.Certificate Management Experience supporting TLS/SSL certificates and certificate-dependent infrastructure. Familiarity with certificate lifecycle management, renewals, trust chains, certificate authorities, and troubleshooting certificate-related connectivity issues. Experience with automated certificate management or enterprise PKI is a plus.As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.Why join Teladoc Health?Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission. Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways. Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You’ll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM’s and containers.As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you’re able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.The role entailsBuild and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezonesDevelop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career developmentDemonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team’s goalsSet and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholdersLead modern, agile software development practicesEnsure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company valuesBe an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisationBuild automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelinesEngage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partnersWork from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external eventsWhat we are looking for in youYou love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing itYou are knowledgeable and passionate about software developmentYou are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality softwareYou have experience and commitment to agile development methodologiesYou have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degreeSoftware development experience in Python or GolangEffective written and verbal communication skillsPractical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWSWhat we offer colleaguesWe consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in personPersonal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per yearAnnual compensation reviewRecognition rewardsAnnual holiday leaveMaternity and paternity leaveTeam Member Assistance Program & Wellness PlatformOpportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleaguesPriority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company eventsAbout CanonicalCanonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.Canonical is an equal opportunity employerWe are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.descriptionText: About Meitner EnergyMeitner Energy is developing advanced nuclear energy solutions intended to deliver reliable, scalable, and carbon-free electricity for industrial and grid applications.Our international team brings together nuclear, engineering, commercial, regulatory, and project-development experience. We are building an organization focused on disciplined engineering, responsible execution, and the deployment of nuclear energy at meaningful scale.The OpportunityMeitner operates a private AI platform that handles export-controlled nuclear technology, sensitive engineering material, and regulatory data spanning multiple jurisdictions. This role owns the security and compliance posture of that platform: the access controls, audit trails, data-loss prevention, and control mappings that allow engineers and operators to use AI safely on controlled material. It is a security engineering position with genuine governance responsibility, where the controls you implement are the same controls you will be asked to evidence.You will also provide security engineering depth to the corporate IT security program, coordinating with the Director of Global IT and external security monitoring partners on shared standards. The primary focus is the regulated platform, and the corporate dimension is real but bounded.This role is ideal for someone who:Understands that security controls matter only if they hold up to assessment, and builds evidence along the way rather than reconstructing it afterward.Can translate regulatory requirements into concrete engineering tasks without losing either the technical or the compliance thread.Is interested in security challenges specific to AI systems, including prompt injection, model access control, and inference audit, alongside traditional infrastructure security.Wants to hold the security authority for a platform and shape its posture from the beginning.What You'll DoPlatform Security EngineeringImplement and maintain single sign-on and multi-factor authentication, role-based and attribute-based access control, and document-level access controls across the platform, ensuring that access aligns with data-sensitivity tiers and export-control requirements. You will deploy and operate data-loss prevention controls, immutable audit logging, and secrets management for the platform environment, and own vulnerability management for platform components including scanning cadence, triage, remediation tracking, and reporting.You will also run prompt-injection testing against the platform and own incident response procedures specific to AI systems, including playbooks for model misuse and data-exfiltration scenarios.Export Control and ComplianceOwn access enforcement for export-controlled material on the platform, ensuring controls are implemented, documented, and demonstrably effective rather than merely specified. You will build and maintain the control mapping and evidence library for the platform against the applicable federal information-protection standards, producing audit-ready artifacts suitable for presentation to regulators and external assessors, and coordinate with the AI Platform Lead and legal and compliance stakeholders on authorization design and ongoing compliance posture.Corporate Security CoordinationDefine and maintain corporate security standards in coordination with the Director of Global IT, ensuring the platform security posture is consistent with company-wide policy. You will manage the day-to-day working relationship with external security monitoring partners, covering alert triage, escalation, tuning, and regular reporting, and support security awareness and policy communication across the company’s sites.What We're Looking ForRequired QualificationsBachelor’s degree in computer science, information security, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.4+ years of professional experience in security engineering, security operations, or a combined security and governance role.Hands-on experience implementing single sign-on and multi-factor authentication, role-based and attribute-based access control, privileged access management, and secrets management in production environments, with the ability to configure these controls personally.Working knowledge of federal information-protection control frameworks and their evidence requirements, including experience producing control mappings that survived an audit or assessment.Experience with security information and event management or managed detection tooling, including alert triage and management of an external monitoring relationship.Understanding of export-control frameworks and controlled unclassified information handling requirements, gained in an environment where the regulatory stakes were real.Ability to write clear security documentation, control narratives, and audit evidence artifacts, and to work on-site in Dallas.Preferred QualificationsWorking proficiency in Spanish. Spanish is preferred because the position involves security coordination with colleagues in Argentina.Relevant security certification such as CISSP, CISM, or an equivalent credential.Experience with security challenges specific to AI systems, including prompt injection, model access control, inference audit, or adversarial testing of language models.Familiarity with data-loss prevention tooling and document-level access control in a regulated environment.Background in nuclear energy, defense, aerospace, or another export-controlled industrial sector.The Candidate We Are SeekingThe strongest candidate will be a security engineer who has implemented controls with their own hands and then had to prove those controls worked. This may be an excellent next step for a security engineer, security operations engineer, or technically strong compliance engineer who wants to hold the security authority for a platform from its beginning. Candidates should be prepared to discuss controls they personally configured, an assessment they prepared for, and the difference between a control that exists and one that functions.Why Join Meitner Energy?Consequential Work. Build the security and compliance foundation that allows advanced nuclear engineering work to proceed safely on modern tooling.Direct Ownership. Implement, document, and defend the controls yourself rather than reviewing someone else’s work. Meitner is small enough that your decisions visibly shape the company.International Scope. Work with professionals across the United States, Argentina, and the United Kingdom.Strong Benefits. Meitner offers comprehensive health insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and participation in the company's employee stock option program, subject to plan terms and eligibility. The final offer will reflect the candidate's depth and relevant skills, including security engineering depth, governance and assessment experience, Spanish proficiency, and regulated-industry background.High-Quality Workplace. Work from a modern Dallas office designed to support collaboration, productivity, and employee well-being, including an on-site fitness facility.To ApplyEmail your resume and a written response of no more than one page to hiring@meitner.energy. Use this exact subject line: Security Engineer / your full name / hands-on. Applications without it will not be reviewed.Write the response yourself, in your own words, for this posting specifically. Answer directly with specific examples; generic statements of engineering philosophy or best practices are not considered responsive, and responses that appear mass-produced or machine-generated are declined without review. Your one page should address the following:Quote the single sentence from this posting that best describes how this role differs from your current position, and explain why that difference appeals to you.Describe the most complex AI or LLM platform system you have designed, built, or operated in the past three years. What was the stack, what were the hardest trade-offs, what broke, and how did you fix it?Walk us through how you would fit a large open-weight model onto a fixed GPU memory budget. What trade-offs would you consider, and how would you verify the result?Describe how you have approached data-sensitivity routing or access control in a regulated or security-sensitive environment. What did you build, and how did you verify it held?Explain why this role is the right next step in your career, and identify one aspect of the position that may be more demanding than your current role.Please do not include confidential, proprietary, export-controlled, or otherwise restricted information belonging to a current or former employer.

postings.descriptionText: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.What We Are Looking For In YouProven experience hiring and leading a high performance software engineering teamExperience with Go and Python software developmentAbility to design and implement complex, distributed systemExperience working with container technology and KubernetesStrong understanding of software/infrastructure security and performanceExperience designing and/or operating large scale distributed systems Knowledge of identity and access management technologies and standards is desirable but not essentialExceptional academic track record from both high school and universityUndergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen pathProfessional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skillsExcellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountabilityAbility to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks longWhat We Offer ColleaguesWe consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in personPersonal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per yearAnnual compensation reviewRecognition rewardsAnnual holiday leaveMaternity and paternity leaveTeam Member Assistance Program & Wellness PlatformOpportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleaguesPriority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company eventsAbout CanonicalCanonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.Canonical is an equal opportunity employerWe are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring vulnerabilities and strengthen the Talent security posture. Ensure adherence to EY security policies, standards, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations.Required Skills Strong understanding of vulnerability management, risk remediation, and security governance processes. Experience managing GVM findings, remediation plans, security exceptions, and risk acceptance processes. Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across Product, Application, Infrastructure, Vendor, and Security teams. Strong analytical, prioritization, and risk management capabilities. Experience developing and maintaining dashboards, reporting, and remediation metrics. Strong communication and presentation skills for leadership, audit, and governance forums. Ability to manage multiple remediation initiatives and competing priorities across global teams.Preferred Qualifications Experience working within enterprise security, compliance, or risk management programs. Familiarity with EY security standards, audit requirements, and governance processes. Knowledge of vulnerability management tools and security reporting platforms. Experience supporting infrastructure refreshes, application upgrades, and security compliance initiatives. Security-related certifications (e.g., Security+, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001) preferred.Key Success Measures Reduction in overdue GVM vulnerabilities and EXP/RP items. Achievement of remediation SLA and compliance targets. Timely approval, renewal, and closure of security exceptions. Accurate reporting, audit readiness, and governance compliance. Improved visibility of security risks and remediation progress. Reduction in overall security risk exposure across Talent applications.

postings.title: Senior Project Manager - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText: At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.The opportunityThe Enterprise Security Program is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, global information security initiatives across EY. This role is designed for a project leader who can connect strategy to execution, bring together cross-functional teams, and drive outcomes that reduce enterprise risk while supporting business value and operational resilience.The role requires strong leadership without direct authority, clear executive communication, and the ability to coordinate across Information Security, Member Firms, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, vendors, and other stakeholders.Your Key ResponsibilitiesLead complex global information security programs and projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring scope, plans, milestones, risks, budgets and outcomes are actively managed.Translate enterprise security objectives into clear execution plans that support business value, measurable benefits and risk reduction.Coordinate cross-functional and geographically distributed teams across Information Security, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, Member Firms, vendors and contractors.Drive project governance, status reporting, issue escalation and decision-making with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors.Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, dependencies and RAID items using project management platforms and tools such as MS Project, Azure DevOps or equivalent tools.Identify risks, issues, interdependencies and resource constraints across programs, busy seasons and organizational priorities, and develop pragmatic mitigation plans.Facilitate stakeholder alignment by integrating feedback, resolving conflicts and keeping teams focused on shared outcomes.Support continuous improvement of security processes, governance practices and delivery methods, including lessons learned and sustainable operating models.Mentor and coach project team members, build team engagement, and encourage accountability, collaboration and quality delivery.Skills And Attributes For SuccessTo succeed in this role, you will need to combine information security knowledge, disciplined program delivery, and strong executive presence. The strongest candidates will demonstrate:Technical and security knowledge: Understanding of information security technologies, including cloud, network, perimeter, messaging, endpoint and data security, along with familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001 and CIS Controls.Project management depth: Proven ability to manage complex information security projects, including iterative and waterfall delivery methods, planning, budget management, risk management and stakeholder governance.Leadership without authority: Ability to build trusted relationships, motivate teams, establish a shared vision and drive delivery across teams that do not directly report to the role.Executive communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify technical matters for non-technical stakeholders and present concise, data-driven updates to senior leadership.Stakeholder engagement: Ability to engage executive leadership and key stakeholders, understand competing priorities and negotiate alignment at multiple levels of the organization.Risk and issue management: Ability to anticipate delivery risks, assess business impact, make timely recommendations and drive mitigation through structured plans.Problem solving: Strong analytical thinking, critical judgment, creativity and conflict-resolution skills in time-sensitive or ambiguous situations.Global mindset: Comfort operating across cultures, geographies, Member Firms and organizational structures, including awareness of political, regulatory and commercial factors that may affect delivery.To qualify for the role you must haveProven experience leading complex global information security, technology or risk-related programs from initiation to closure.Strong understanding of information security technologies and operating environments, including cloud, network, endpoint, messaging and data security domains.Experience managing project plans, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, budgets and executive reporting for complex initiatives.Knowledge of security frameworks, standards and risk management methodologies, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls or comparable frameworks.Experience working with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors, including preparing clear status updates, recommendations and escalation materials.Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive outcomes through influence, structure and accountability.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics in business terms.Experience identifying interdependencies across other programs, operational timelines, business cycles and organizational priorities.Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.Ideally, you’ll also haveRelevant certifications such as PMP, CISSP, CISM or equivalent practical experience.Experience with project management and delivery platforms such as MS Project, Azure DevOps or similar tools.Experience supporting compliance, privacy or regulatory requirements, including Privacy Impact Assessments and GDPR-related considerations.Experience supporting security initiatives that align to business strategy, operational resilience and measurable risk reduction.Familiarity with vendor and contractor coordination in support of complex technology or security programs.What We Look ForWe are looking for a seasoned Information Security project leader who can bring structure to complexity, communicate with clarity, and deliver outcomes through influence. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with senior leaders, global teams and diverse stakeholders; will be able to connect security priorities to business value; and will lead with accountability, sound judgment and a strong focus on execution. This role requires someone who can remain steady during ambiguity, encourage collaboration during challenges, and keep teams aligned to a shared set of goals.What we offerAs part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.Please apply to this role only through the ‘Apply’ link (not through the local office). Your application will then be routed to the appropriate recruiting team. The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build.EY | Building a better working world
