We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.How We WorkAt Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core valuesBold in how we dream and innovateResponsive to feedback, challenges and opportunitiesAccountable for results and best in class outcomesVisionary in future focused problem-solvingExceptional in execution and impactCorporate OverviewIn today’s cyber threat landscape, protection starts with people. At Proofpoint, that simple truth fuels our passion for protecting users, the data they create, and the systems they rely on from a uniquely people-centric perspective.And we’re just as passionate about finding the right people to help us in that mission. When you join Proofpoint, you’re helping toBuild and enhance our proven security platformBlend innovation and speed in a constantly evolving cloud environmentAnalyze new threats and offer deep insight through data-driven intelCollaborate with customers to help solve their toughest security challengesWe are singularly devoted to helping our customers protect their greatest assets and biggest security risk their people. That’s why we’re a leader in next-generation cybersecurity—and why more than half of the Fortune 100 trust us as a security partner.About The Product Support TeamAt Proofpoint, a product support engineer is responsible for providing technical support to customers who use Proofpoint's products and services. This may include troubleshooting issues, identifying, and resolving technical problems and working with other members of the engineering team to improve the overall quality of the product. They may also be responsible for conducting product training sessions for customers and other team members, and for providing feedback to the product development team based on customer needs and feedback. Ultimately, a product support engineer at Proofpoint plays a critical role in ensuring that customers can use Proofpoint's products and services effectively and efficiently. as a Product Support EngineerAn experienced professional with strong problem determination, isolation, and root cause analysis skills are required to diagnose and resolve technical issues of moderate complexity in Proofpoint’s products. You will interact directly with our enterprise customers to deliver “white glove service” on each and every interaction. The daily work includes regular updating of support cases to record progress of open issues in our call tracking system, hosting shared sessions with customers to diagnose reported problems and documenting technical solutions and product information in the knowledge base. This is an advanced support group, owning and resolving some moderate to complex issues from start to finish. The work is frequently performed in Linux command line environments so appropriate skills are required. You will work as a team with our Account Managers, SEs, Customer Success Managers, and Professional Services to provide a positive customer interaction with Proofpoint. Receives little instruction on day to day work.Responsibilities IncludeProvide advanced software technical support to customers, resellers, and partners of Proofpoint via phone and the ticketing systemManage cases in the ticketing system to ensure your cases are handled within SLO guidelinesCreate and send out alerts and other customer communications as necessaryPublish Knowledge Base articles for internal and customer useSeen as the SME to review technical documentation for training materials, manuals, troubleshooting guides, etc.Act as an SME for select technical skills, making yourself available to provide guidance and mentoring to lower-level Product Support Engineers in a positive and effective wayLead by example technically, professionally, and in dedicationRequirements4+ years experience in a Technical Support roleExcellent written and verbal customer-facing communication skills.Complete competence working in Linux command line environmentsAdvanced use of grep, regex, log scraping in command line, etcFully experienced with email system debuggingFully experienced using remote hosting tools for customer troubleshooting sessionsExperience with Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, Symantec, McAfee, Fortinet, or other email/network security products a plusWith little supervision, the ability to debug broad, system environments of moderate complexity involving multiple configurations and protocolsWhy Proofpoint Protecting people is at the heart of our award-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer-focused and driven-to-win organization with leading-edge products—and many exciting reasons to join our team. We believe in hiring the best the brightest and cultivating a culture of collaboration and appreciation. We are a diverse, multinational company with opportunities in all functions, and leaders that welcome candidates from all walks of life. Apply today and explore your future .Why Proofpoint?At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with usCompetitive compensationComprehensive benefitsCareer success on your termsFlexible work environmentAnnual wellness and community outreach daysAlways on recognition for your contributionsGlobal collaboration and networking opportunitiesOur Culture Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.How To ApplyInterested? postings.descriptionText: ET Risk & ComplianceET Risk and Compliance / Risk & Controls Governance AnalystFinanceSupervising AssociateAbout EYAt EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build an exceptional experience for yourself and a better working world for all.Job SummaryEnterprise Technology is a global organization that delivers reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to enable an exceptional technology experience for EY people. As part of the Enterprise Technology Risk & Compliance (ETRC) team, the Finance Governance role will lead the operational governance of the Finance risk and control matrix and support a consistent, integrated control landscape. Reporting to the Risk & Controls Governance Lead, this role will maintain the Finance control inventory, lead control design and impact assessments, coordinate control changes and ownership alignment, and provide risk and control input to Finance technology transformation initiatives.ResponsibilitiesThe Finance RACM role will provide domain leadership for the Finance control landscape and coordinate delivery of RACM governance activities under the direction of the Risk & Controls Governance Lead.Key responsibilities include Own and maintain the Finance risk and control matrix and related control inventory, ensuring alignment with the ETRC RACM methodology, taxonomy and governance requirements. Maintain Finance risk-to-control mappings and support an integrated view of applications, processes, risks, controls, ownership, access, vendors and key technology dependencies. Coordinate Finance control additions, updates and removals with control owners, delegates, Operations & Reporting and Assurance & Compliance stakeholders. Consolidate Finance control changes and prepare accurate RACM and ISQM updates that reflect approved control design activities. Assess Finance applications, processes and technology changes to identify requirements for new or updated controls, including IT general controls, SDLC controls, interfaces, access and segregation of duties. Lead control rationalization and control impact assessments, identify duplication or coverage gaps and recommend changes to control design, ownership and accountability. Manage the design and readiness process for new or updated Finance controls, including stakeholder consultation, required approvals, sign-offs and readiness for implementation. Coordinate Finance input to the annual ET controls certification cycle, review reported exceptions and track remediation actions arising from certification outcomes. Provide risk and control governance input to strategic Finance technology initiatives and perform control gap analysis with practical remediation recommendations. Monitor changes in control ownership and delegate arrangements, maintain effective stakeholder alignment and escalate unresolved ownership or control design matters. Identify recurring control themes and systemic gaps and provide clear management insights and recommendations to support the Finance control environment. Partner with the Non-Finance RACM role, Risk & Controls Analyst and other ETRC pillars to support one consistent and integrated ET control landscape.Analytical / Decision-Making ResponsibilitiesThe role applies sound judgment and strong analytical thinking to assess technology and process changes, evaluate control coverage, identify gaps or duplication and determine when controls require addition, redesign, rationalization or escalation. The individual will balance Finance-specific requirements with the ETRC control framework, prioritize competing governance activities and provide evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.Knowledge And Skills RequirementsThe role requires a strong understanding of technology risk and controls, RACM governance, control design and Finance technology environments. The successful candidate will be able to connect business and technology risks to practical controls, challenge unclear ownership or design, and translate complex requirements into clear documentation and actionable recommendations. Strong stakeholder management, organization, attention to detail and written communication skills are essential.Job RequirementsTo qualify, candidates must have Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Accounting, Finance, Risk Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. Minimum 6 years of experience in technology risk, internal controls, IT audit, compliance, risk and control matrix management or a related field. Demonstrated experience maintaining RACMs, performing control design or impact assessments and translating risks and requirements into clear control activities. Strong understanding of IT general controls, technology change, access management, SDLC, interfaces and segregation of duties concepts. Experience working with Finance technology platforms, SAP environments, ERP transformation or similar large-scale technology programs is preferred. Experience coordinating control owners and senior stakeholders across technology, risk, audit, information security and business functions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify control gaps, assess impact and develop practical recommendations. Strong organizational and project coordination skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, approvals, dependencies and deliverables. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear control documentation, governance materials and management updates. Proficiency with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI and collaboration platforms; experience with GRC or RACM tools is preferred. Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISM, CIA, CPA, ACCA or similar are a plus.What We Offer Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build.EY | Building a better working worldEY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across technology, assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

postings.title: Security Engineer, Security Operations and Governance
postings.descriptionText: About Meitner EnergyMeitner Energy is developing advanced nuclear energy solutions intended to deliver reliable, scalable, and carbon-free electricity for industrial and grid applications.Our international team brings together nuclear, engineering, commercial, regulatory, and project-development experience. We are building an organization focused on disciplined engineering, responsible execution, and the deployment of nuclear energy at meaningful scale.The OpportunityMeitner operates a private AI platform that handles export-controlled nuclear technology, sensitive engineering material, and regulatory data spanning multiple jurisdictions. This role owns the security and compliance posture of that platform: the access controls, audit trails, data-loss prevention, and control mappings that allow engineers and operators to use AI safely on controlled material. It is a security engineering position with genuine governance responsibility, where the controls you implement are the same controls you will be asked to evidence.You will also provide security engineering depth to the corporate IT security program, coordinating with the Director of Global IT and external security monitoring partners on shared standards. The primary focus is the regulated platform, and the corporate dimension is real but bounded.This role is ideal for someone who:Understands that security controls matter only if they hold up to assessment, and builds evidence along the way rather than reconstructing it afterward.Can translate regulatory requirements into concrete engineering tasks without losing either the technical or the compliance thread.Is interested in security challenges specific to AI systems, including prompt injection, model access control, and inference audit, alongside traditional infrastructure security.Wants to hold the security authority for a platform and shape its posture from the beginning.What You'll DoPlatform Security EngineeringImplement and maintain single sign-on and multi-factor authentication, role-based and attribute-based access control, and document-level access controls across the platform, ensuring that access aligns with data-sensitivity tiers and export-control requirements. You will build and maintain the control mapping and evidence library for the platform against the applicable federal information-protection standards, producing audit-ready artifacts suitable for presentation to regulators and external assessors, and coordinate with the AI Platform Lead and legal and compliance stakeholders on authorization design and ongoing compliance posture.Corporate Security CoordinationDefine and maintain corporate security standards in coordination with the Director of Global IT, ensuring the platform security posture is consistent with company-wide policy. You will manage the day-to-day working relationship with external security monitoring partners, covering alert triage, escalation, tuning, and regular reporting, and support security awareness and policy communication across the company’s sites.What We're Looking ForRequired QualificationsBachelor’s degree in computer science, information security, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.4+ years of professional experience in security engineering, security operations, or a combined security and governance role.Hands-on experience implementing single sign-on and multi-factor authentication, role-based and attribute-based access control, privileged access management, and secrets management in production environments, with the ability to configure these controls personally.Working knowledge of federal information-protection control frameworks and their evidence requirements, including experience producing control mappings that survived an audit or assessment.Experience with security information and event management or managed detection tooling, including alert triage and management of an external monitoring relationship.Understanding of export-control frameworks and controlled unclassified information handling requirements, gained in an environment where the regulatory stakes were real.Ability to write clear security documentation, control narratives, and audit evidence artifacts, and to work on-site in Dallas.Preferred QualificationsWorking proficiency in Spanish. postings.title: Senior Business Analyst
postings.descriptionText: Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera. Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad.Vas a ser el puente entre el negocio, el cliente y el equipo de desarrollo. Tu trabajo es asegurar que el equipo construya lo correcto: entender las necesidades, traducirlas en un backlog claro y accionable, y ayudar a priorizar siempre con foco en el objetivo del producto.¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades? Analizar y documentar las diferentes características de un producto, considerando tanto aspectos de negocio como técnicosAplicar buenas prácticas al momento de definir un backlog y documentar historias de usuarioFacilitar y participar activamente en reuniones de entendimiento de requerimientosTrabajar en conjunto con el equipo de desarrolloAyudar al cliente y al equipo a trabajar el alcance dentro de un marco ágil, siempre con foco en el objetivo del productoActualizar las prioridades del product backlog según el roadmap, negociando con el Product OwnerAtender las dependencias que puedan impactar en el objetivo del proyectoIncentivar al equipo a tomar un rol activo en los refinamientos¿Qué esperamos de vos? Experiencia documentando y realizando historias de usuario, diagramas UMLModerar reuniones efectivasConocimientos de servicios y la capacidad de testearlos a través de distintas herramientasEntendimiento de la arquitectura de un sistema es una gran ventajaExperiencia haciendo slicing de una funcionalidadCapacidad analítica y skills de negociaciónExperiencia en story mapping, impact mapping, bocetado, etc¿Cuál es nuestra propuesta de valor?En redbee buscamos crear un espacio de trabajo donde las personas se sientan felices y puedan desarrollarse; por eso ofrecemos 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y adicionamos 5 días hábiles más. Trabajamos con flexibilidad y de forma remote-first y, si vivís en AMBA, nos encontramos una vez al mes en la oficina para compartir, charlar y seguir construyendo vínculos. Sí estás fuera de AMBA el trabajo es full remote. Nos interesa tu comodidad, es por eso que contamos con coworks y brindamos equipamiento para tu espacio de trabajo. Además brindamos un monto mensual de puntos para canjear en una plataforma de beneficios. Sabemos que la familia ocupa un lugar importante: ofrecemos prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar. También otorgamos licencias extendidas para que puedas estar presente en esos momentos que importan. Creemos en el aprendizaje continuo y en el crecimiento a largo plazo. Vas a tener clases de inglés, acceso a plataformas de capacitación y un plan de desarrollo claro, pensado para acompañar tu viaje dentro de redbee.En redbee buscamos dejar huella en las trayectorias profesionales y ser una experiencia memorable en tu carrera. Creemos que la calidad técnica y la humana van de la mano, y desde ahí transformamos realidades a través de la tecnología. Si queres ser parte, ¡queremos conocerte!

They'll work across clients, strategists, product managers, designers, engineers, and QA teams, to create alignment from discovery through delivery and ensure that solutions address the intended business and user outcomes, all with minimal oversight. Additionally, a good candidate for this role should have a willingness to push the field forward, eager to create new ways of using these tools to build clarity for their teams.What You'll So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.About The RoleAt Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. postings.title: Professional Services Manager (EPM)
postings.descriptionText: About AbacumAbacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!About The RoleOwn end-to-end delivery of Abacum implementation projects, from pre-sales scoping through kickoff and delivery, driving customers to success and value realization on the platform. Partner with Sales during the pre-sales cycle to scope projects, size effort, and present and walk clients through the SOW, setting the right expectations before the deal closes. Build project documents, sprint plans, budgets, and resource plans tailored to project and delivery model. Manage implementations that involve both direct customer delivery and delivery through partners, holding partners to the same quality bar as internal delivery. Manage scope, risk, and change control, escalating early using our governance processes. Act as the trusted advisor to client stakeholders; not just running the plan, advising on process and org changes needed to get value from the platform. Coordinate with Product, Support, Sales, Customer Success, and delivery partners to keep a single, coherent client experience. Get hands-on with the product itself, deep enough to unblock the team on platform or FP&A concept questions without escalating. Contribute directly to how we deliver: developing/deploying Ai to speed up delivery and enhance the customer experience, refining templates, sprint cadences, and design-phase practices as we continually evolve our methodology. Mentor junior delivery team members and, where relevant, partner-side consultants on delivery standards and quality bar. What You Bring4+ years of hands-on experience implementing a financial planning/EPM platform; this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Experience scoping projects pre-sale and presenting SOWs directly to clients, comfortable being in the room before the deal is signed, not just after handoff. Direct experience managing implementations delivered through third-party partners or resellers, alongside those delivered directly to customers. Working knowledge of FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, reporting, consolidation), enough to challenge a client's assumptions, not just document them. Working knowledge of other planning use cases such as workforce planning and others is a bonus. Track record managing multi-stakeholder, multi-workstream projects with both technical and change-management components. Ability to read a scope document critically and flag risk before it becomes a delivery problem. Proficiency with SaaS project tools and Agile/hybrid methodologies. Excellent at client-facing communication, comfortable presenting to and influencing senior finance stakeholders. Formal Project Management Qualifications are a plus, not a requirement. BenefitsCompetitive compensation including equity packageCompetitive vacation policyMedical InsuranceL&D budgetAccess to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)Language courses (English / Spanish)Our ValuesCustomer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

postings.title: Senior Digital Transformation Specialist
postings.descriptionText: Unilever está contratando Senior Digital Transformation Specialist.A comienzos de este año, Unilever anunció un acuerdo para combinar su negocio de Foods con McCormick & Company, creando una potencia global de sabores a escala. La combinación propuesta reuniría marcas icónicas de Foods, incluyendo Hellmann’s y Knorr, con el portafolio de McCormick para crear un líder global en especias, condimentos, aderezos y categorías de alimentos complementarias, respaldado por sólidas plataformas de retail y foodservice. McCormick aporta más de 135 años de trayectoria, presencia en más de 150 países y territorios, y un portafolio de marcas de confianza. La transacción sigue sujeta a aprobaciones regulatorias y a otras condiciones habituales de cierre, con finalización estimada para mediados de 2027.¿QUIÉNES SOMOS?¿Quieres ser parte de una compañía que hace la diferencia alrededor del mundo? En Unilever, tenemos un propósito claro - Iluminar la vida diaria de las personas a través de sus productos y servicios, así como también promover un estilo de vida sustentable -. A través de nuestras 400 marcas que llegan a 2.5 mil millones de personas todos los días, nuestro objetivo es generar un impacto social positivo a nivel mundial y local.Estamos buscando un Senior Digital Transformation Specialist para nuestra unidad de negocio de Foods en Planta Pilar.PROPÓSITO DE LA POSICIÓNLiderar la estrategia de transformación digital del site, impulsando la adopción de tecnologías digitales, analítica avanzada, automatización, inteligencia artificial y ciberseguridad industrial para mejorar la eficiencia operativa, la confiabilidad de los procesos, la toma de decisiones basada en datos y la resiliencia de los sistemas de manufactura. Actuar como enlace entre las áreas de Operaciones, Ingeniería, Supply Chain, Calidad, IT y OT, garantizando la ejecución del roadmap digital y la generación de valor a través de iniciativas de innovación tecnológica.Las Principales Responsabilidades SeránDefinir y ejecutar la estrategia de transformación digital del site, alineada con los objetivos de negocio, manufactura y cadena de suministro. Liderar el roadmap digital de la planta, identificando oportunidades de mejora mediante automatización, analítica avanzada, inteligencia artificial y tecnologías emergentes. Gestionar e implementar proyectos de digitalización industrial, asegurando la generación de valor y la adopción por parte de las áreas usuarias. Actuar como referente local para iniciativas de Industria 4.0, promoviendo la utilización de datos para la toma de decisiones y la mejora continua. Liderar la implementación, gobernanza y monitoreo del programa de Cybersecurity OT del site, garantizando el cumplimiento de estándares corporativos y la protección de los activos industriales. Coordinar la convergencia IT/OT, asegurando la integración segura y eficiente de sistemas industriales, infraestructura tecnológica y plataformas corporativas. Evaluar, seleccionar e impulsar nuevas tecnologías que contribuyan a mejorar la productividad, confiabilidad, seguridad y sostenibilidad de las operaciones. Desarrollar y monitorear indicadores de desempeño (KPIs) para medir el impacto y madurez de las iniciativas digitales y de ciberseguridad. Promover una cultura de innovación, digitalización y ciberseguridad mediante capacitación, acompañamiento y gestión del cambio organizacional. Liderar iniciativas de gestión y explotación de datos industriales, habilitando casos de uso de analítica avanzada, mantenimiento predictivo y optimización de procesos. Asegurar la correcta gestión de riesgos tecnológicos y de ciberseguridad asociados a los sistemas de manufactura y entornos OT. Gestionar la relación con proveedores tecnológicos, equipos globales y stakeholders locales para la implementación de soluciones digitales y de ciberseguridad.StakeholdersInternos: Gerencia y Jefatura de: Producción, Calidad, SHE, Ingeniería, Logística, R&D, FI, Mantenimiento, TIM, Finanzas, RRHH, Inbound, Planning, Recepción y Despacho. Interaccion con areas ubicadas en Bouchard y Global de Cyb.Externos: Proveedores, auditores y consultores.¿QUÉ NECESITAS PARA APLICAR A LA VACANTE?Graduado de Ingeniería en Sistemas o afines. Posgrado o MBA (deseable). Certificaciones validadas por el mercado en networking y CS.Mínimo 5 años en roles digitales y 3 años liderando equipos.Nivel de inglés intermedio.Habilidades soft: liderazgo; orientación a resultados; pensamiento estratégico; adaptabilidad; comunicación efectiva.Habilidades deseadas: Gestión avanzada del cambio organizacional. Visión integral del negocio y de la cadena de valor. Colaboración global y gestión de equipos multiculturales.Conocer y aplicar los principios de cultura de inocuidad alimentaria, comprendiendo su rol en la prevención de riesgos, la importancia del cumplimiento de procedimientos, la detección y reporte de desvíos, y el compromiso con la mejora continua del sistema de gestión (FSSC 22000). Fomentar y comunicar la cultura participando activamente de las actividades propuestas.Conocimientos EnTransformación Digital Industrial e Industria 4.0.Ciberseguridad OT/IT basada en marcos NIST, ISA/IEC 62443 y gestión de riesgos industriales. Metodologías Agile, Scrum y gestión tradicional de proyectos. Analítica de datos, inteligencia artificial y machine learning aplicados a procesos industriales y mantenimiento predictivo. Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio) y soluciones low-code/no-code. Plataformas de datos industriales, Azure Cloud, Azure Data Explorer (ADX) e integración de datos OT/IT.Diseño y desarrollo de soluciones digitales con foco en experiencia de usuario (UX/UI) y adopción tecnológica. Lenguajes de programación, APIs, bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales. Sistemas de automatización industrial, SCADA, HMI, historiadores de datos e integración con PLCs. Redes industriales y corporativas: Switching, Routing, VLANs, PROFINET, diagnóstico de redes OT y segmentación industrial.En Unilever, Queremos Generar Experiencias Que Transformen a Las Personas. postings.title: Product Management Intern
postings.descriptionText: About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!About the Role:We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.What You'll Do:Ticket Management & Product SupportAssist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.Context Gathering & Stakeholder SupportHelp the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.Payment Workflow AnalysisLearn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.Documentation & Process TrackingMaintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.Agile MeetingsParticipate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.What We Look For:Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related fieldA genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hoodNatural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things outStrong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolvedComfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not requiredEffective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gapsPrior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.About You:You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.Compensation: The salary for the Product Intern is $800 USD Gross as an independent contractor.#Full-time

postings.title: EY - Manager en Finance Transformation (Industria Financiera)
postings.descriptionText: EY es una firma global líder que ofrece servicios de Auditoría, Consultoría, Estrategia y Transacciones e Impuestos, con una red integrada de alrededor de 400.000 profesionales en 150 países del mundo.   Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo mejor de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades. Trabajamos continuamente para mejorar la calidad de nuestros servicios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente y en innovación. Las oportunidades de crecer, tener éxito y desarrollarse en EY son ilimitadas.   EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas. Todas nuestras oportunidades de trabajo están abiertas a personas con discapacidad. Acerca del áreaDesde Business Transformation para la industria financiera buscamos ayudar a nuestros clientes de Banking, FinTech, Payments e Insurance a transformar sus negocios en una era dinámica y disruptiva. Colaboramos en estos procesos aportando una visión integral que combina negocio, personas y tecnología.Nuestras propuestas incluyen planes estratégicos, reinvención de modelos de negocio, transformación de modelos operativos, efectividad comercial, eficiencia operacional y diseño e implementación de programas de transformación integral. Dentro de esta agenda, buscamos fortalecer y desarrollar la práctica de Finance Transformation, integrando conocimiento contable, FP&A y FinOps (Operaciones y Finance), procesos y tecnología.Responsabilidades Este es un rol de liderazgo. Serás parte de un equipo talentoso que trabajará para llevar lo mejor de EY a nuestros clientes, construyendo soluciones a partir de sus necesidades y conformando equipos diversos para resolver desafíos complejos. Liderar el gerenciamiento y la ejecución de proyectos de planificación estratégica, transformación y rediseño de Modelos de Finance, con una visión integral de estrategia, procesos, personas y tecnología. Concebir e impulsar Servicios de Finance Transformation basados en un profundo conocimiento de las industrias y los procesos de Finance e integrando las capacidades existentes dentro de los equipos de EY. Diseñar y transformar modelos operativos de Finanzas, Accounting y operaciones, promoviendo la automatización, estandarización, eficiencia, escalabilidad y calidad de los procesos. Identificar e implementar oportunidades de eficientización y automatización de procesos financieros y contables, incluyendo cierres, conciliaciones, liquidaciones, controles y operaciones de back office. Diseñar y mejorar procesos, definir KPIs y SLAs, gestionar riesgos operativos y documentar procesos y controles. Liderar programas grandes y complejos de transformación, asegurando disciplina de ejecución y una visión integral de personas, tecnología y negocio. Gestionar, coordinar y desarrollar equipos de trabajo de mediana y gran escala, promoviendo autonomía, colaboración y orientación a resultados. Generar propuestas de valor para los clientes y transformarlas en proyectos concretos, contribuyendo activamente al desarrollo y consolidación de la práctica de Finance Transformation. Actuar como referente ante stakeholders clave y equipos multidisciplinarios, articulando necesidades de negocio, requerimientos contables y soluciones tecnológicas.Requisitos Formación universitaria en Contabilidad, Administración de Empresas, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines. Maestría o posgrado será considerado un plus. Experiencia de 5 años liderando proyectos vinculados con contabilidad, operaciones financieras, transformación financiera, optimización de procesos o consultoría de gestión. Sólida experiencia en procesos contables end-to-end, incluyendo cierres contables complejos, conciliaciones de alto volumen, análisis de cuentas y variaciones, controles internos y cumplimiento. Experiencia comprobable en la eficientización, estandarización y automatización de procesos de Finanzas, con capacidad para diseñar e implementar iniciativas de Finance Transformation. Experiencia liderando y desarrollando equipos de trabajo. Se valorará la gestión de estructuras numerosas en roles de Manager, Team Lead o equivalentes. Conocimiento y experiencia en sistemas contables, ERPs, plataformas financieras y herramientas tecnológicas o de automatización aplicadas a la función de Finanzas. Experiencia en la industria de servicios financieros, especialmente en Banking, FinTech o Payments. Conocimiento de adquirencia y emisión de medios de pago, chargebacks y contracargos, liquidaciones bancarias, esquemas de fees e interchange, retenciones e impuestos transaccionales, y conciliación entre sistemas operativos y contables. Dominio avanzado del idioma inglés, tanto oral como escrito. Capacidad para combinar profundidad técnica en Accounting y operaciones financieras con una mirada consultiva, orientación al cliente y visión de transformación.¿Qué ofrecemos? Formar parte de una de las mejores empresas para trabajar (GPTW Argentina 2026). Formar parte de un equipo de trabajo altamente reconocido en el mercado y basado en las mejores prácticas. Modalidad de trabajo híbrido. Ayuda económica para quienes se mudan a Buenos Aires para trabajar en EY. Monto adicional mensual por conectividad/trabajo remoto. Programas de Capacitación continua. Plataforma de entrenamiento virtual con más de 18.000 cursos disponibles, entre los cuales se encuentran cursos de Udemy. Acceso a EY Badges, programa global de certificaciones en diferentes áreas de conocimiento. EY Masters in Business Analytics y EY Masters in Sustainability, innovadores programas de aprendizaje virtual en asociación con Hult International Business School. Capacitación en idioma inglés: política de clases, open lessons gratuitas, webinars de doble impacto y libre acceso a la plataforma de aprendizaje virtual. Oportunidades de movilidad internacional. Cobertura médica privada para vos y tu grupo familiar. Consultorios médicos y nutricionales. Programas anuales de salud. Políticas de flexibilidad, licencias especiales y softlanding para madres recientes. Descuentos en importante red de gimnasios, comercios y universidades. Revisiones salariales periódicas. Bono anual por desempeño. 4 semanas de vacaciones.¡Y mucho más! Si querés ver todo lo que tenemos para vos, hacé clic acá https://bit.ly/36yXaK4The exceptional EY experience. postings.descriptionText: EY es una firma global líder que ofrece servicios de Auditoría, Consultoría, Estrategia y Transacciones e Impuestos, con una red integrada de alrededor de 400.000 profesionales en 150 países del mundo.Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo mejor de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades. Las oportunidades de crecer, tener éxito y desarrollarse en EY son ilimitadas.  EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas.Acerca del áreaConsulting es una de nuestras líneas de servicio que, en la era de la transformación, ayuda a los clientes a adoptar el cambio y abordar retos cada vez más complejos, permitiéndoles crecer, optimizar y proteger sus negocios.Creemos que las mejores preguntas provienen de mejores conexiones, por lo que desde el área fomentamos una diversidad de ideas y una rica mezcla de talentos, entornos y experiencias en equipos que trabajan en servicios digitales, estrategia, tecnología, analítica, ciberseguridad, riesgos y people advisory services. Dentro del área de Finance Consulting tendrás oportunidades de aprendizaje, crecimiento, grandes proyectos y desafíos en las empresas más grandes de la región.ResponsabilidadesComo Manager de Business Consulting - Finance acompañarás la transformación con una visión holística de negocio, personas y tecnología. Buscamos desarrollar tareas de Consultoría en mejora de procesos para las empresas más grandes de la región, relacionadas con las siguientes responsabilidades:Análisis y mejora de procesos de las empresas asignadas.Implementaciones de modelos de servicios compartidos (Shared Services), transformación operativa, service delivery y servicios funcionales de sistemas.Concebir e impulsar una transformación, basada en conocimiento de la industria e integrando las capacidades existentes dentro de los equipos EY.Diseñar sus negocio, servicios y modelos operativos. Ejecutar la transformación: Liderar programas grandes y complejos que requieren visión integral (personas, tecnología y negocio), disciplina y experiencia especializadas.Este es un rol de liderazgo y vos serás parte de un equipo talentoso que trabaja para traer lo mejor de EY a nuestros clientes. Estará orientado al cliente, buscando soluciones basadas en las necesidades del cliente y formando equipos diversos para resolver los problemas complejos de los clientes.RequisitosGraduadas/os de carreras como: Contador Público, Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Economía Empresarial o Ingeniería Industrial.Experiencia mínima de 5 años en roles de consultoría en análisis y mejora procesos.Dominio de idioma inglés tanto escrito como oral.Disponibilidad para trabajar full time e híbrido.Sólidas competencias vinculadas a la planificación y organización, liderazgo y supervisión de equipos de trabajo, orientación a resultados, compromiso y autonomía.Flexibilidad y adaptación para el trabajo en equipo, la innovación y el aprendizaje. ¿Qué estamos buscando?Buscamos personas talentosas y comprometidas a nivel Manager que estén interesadas en unirse a nuestro equipo. Personas proactivas y a las que les apasiona ayudar a los clientes a resolver sus problemas estratégicos/de transformación más difíciles y tienen experiencia en la entrega de recomendaciones innovadoras y creativas, pero a su vez rigurosas en su base, distintas para cada cliente y prácticas para ser ejecutadas.¿Qué te ofrecemos? Formar parte de una de las mejores empresas para trabajar (GPTW Argentina 2026). Formar parte de un equipo de trabajo altamente reconocido en el mercado y basado en las mejores prácticas. postings.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Banking Platform
postings.descriptionText: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $8,000 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!About the Role:We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Product Manager who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.Sezzle is building the platform that will carry us from a BNPL provider into a full-stack financial institution. This role owns the system at the center of that: Sezzle’s banking core — the ledger, accounts and balances, and the money movement that every future Sezzle financial product will run on.You would own it end to end. Discovery, architecture and vendor decisions, requirements, build, launch, and everything after — not a slice of someone else’s roadmap, but the full product lifecycle for the platform itself. You’d work directly with Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Treasury, and Risk, with real authority over how this gets built.Ideally you’ve built something like this before. If you haven’t, but you’ve owned a ledger, a payments platform, an issuing program, or other financial infrastructure — and you’re the kind of person who learns a domain properly rather than around the edges — we want to talk to you. What matters most is that you’ve owned real infrastructure and that you’re willing to go deep on the parts you don’t know yet.What You'll Do:Own the banking platform roadmap. Define and sequence the platform work required to support accounts, deposits, cards, and lending on a single ledger and account model.Help drive the build-vs-buy decision. Evaluate core banking platforms and processors, run vendor diligence, model cost and time-to-market, and help leadership decide whether we extend what we have or integrate a third party.Shape the account and ledger model. Work with Engineering and Finance on account hierarchies, sub-ledgers, chart-of-accounts mapping, posting rules, holds, interest and fee accrual, and general ledger integration.Specify money movement. Own product requirements for transfers, ACH, card issuing and network settlement, real-time rails, and returns and reversals — including exception handling, cutoff windows, and settlement reconciliation.Make the platform auditable. Ensure the system produces the reporting, traceability, and controls that Finance, audit, and regulators need — reconciliation breaks, balance attestation, and complete transaction history.Partner on regulatory readiness. Work with Compliance and Legal to turn their requirements into platform capabilities: screening hooks, onboarding data, error resolution, disclosures and statements, and reporting. You don’t need to arrive fluent in US banking regulation — you do need to be someone who learns it properly.Plan migration and cutover. If a migration is in scope, own data mapping, parallel-run strategy, validation criteria, rollback plans, and phased cutover.Write the technical requirements. Own detailed specs, API contracts, event schemas, data models, user stories, and release plans end-to-end.Use data to prove it works. Write your own SQL. Define platform KPIs — posting latency, reconciliation break rate, settlement accuracy, failure rates — and monitor them relentlessly.Manage risk early. Anticipate technical risks, edge cases, race conditions, and dependencies before they become incidents. Money movement defects are the expensive kind.Operate with urgency. Deliver against an evolving regulatory and business timeline with incomplete information.What We Look For:Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or other technical discipline (required).5–10 years of product experience, with meaningful time spent on financial infrastructure rather than only customer-facing surfaces.Real ownership in at least one of the following. You do not need all of them, and we care much more about depth in one than exposure to several:Ledgers, general ledger, or balance and transaction systemsPayments processing, orchestration, or money movement — ACH, card networks, transfers, settlement, or the LATAM equivalents (PIX, SPEI, PSE, CCE)Card issuing or card program managementDeposit, wallet, or account platformsLending origination or loan servicing platformsProduct work at a processor, BaaS provider, or core banking vendorComfort with double-entry accounting concepts as they show up in software — debits and credits, sub-ledgers, accruals, reconciliation — or a genuine appetite to get comfortable with them quickly.Deep technical understanding of APIs, event-driven architecture, idempotency, distributed system failure modes, batch vs. real-time processing, and data flows.Strong SQL skills and comfort querying and interpreting data independently.Experience working directly with Compliance, Legal, Finance, or Treasury as stakeholders — not only Engineering and Design.Comfortable working in ambiguity and making sound, documented decisions with incomplete information.Strong written and verbal communication — can hold your own in an engineering standup, a Finance review, and an executive discussion.Hands-on familiarity with AI tools, data models, or generative AI applications—personally, professionally, or better yet, both!Preferred Qualifications:Direct experience with a core banking platform, in-house or vendor (Thought Machine, Mambu, 10x, Finxact, Temenos, Technisys, Galileo, Pismo, or similar).Experience with a core migration, conversion, or major ledger replacement.Experience at a chartered or licensed financial institution, or supporting a charter, banking licence, or deposit insurance application.Familiarity with consumer finance regulation — US (Reg E, Reg DD, Reg CC, Reg Z, TILA, FCRA, BSA/AML) or equivalent local regimes.Background in consumer credit or BNPL, card products, or bank-fintech sponsorship programs.Experience with third-party risk management and vendor oversight in a regulated environment.About You:You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do thingsYou need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.#Full-time

postings.title: Product Manager, Orchestration Platform
postings.descriptionText: About UsAt Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers. We get things done with urgency and focus, driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego, fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious—always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.About The RoleWe've built an orchestration platform that runs our remittance transaction flow end to end. It handles the long-running, stateful, failure-prone work between "customer pressed send" and "money arrived": routing, compliance checks, partner calls, payouts, reconciliation, retries and compensation when a step fails.Remittance is the first product on the platform. Our intent is for future products to launch on this layer rather than rebuild transaction orchestration. This is the senior product role for that piece of core company infrastructure.ResponsibilitiesPlatform strategy: Define what the orchestration platform is and isn't: its boundaries, guarantees, and non-goals. Decide which capabilities are platform primitives and which belong in consuming products, and hold that line under pressure.The path to multiple products: Own the sequencing and core changes needed before a second product can onboard, and the migration approach for remittance as the platform evolves underneath it.The product surface: Define the contracts teams build against — workflow interfaces, idempotency, retry and compensation semantics, timeouts, state visibility, SLAs — and the docs, onboarding and observability tooling that make the platform self-serve and operable.Roadmap and delivery: Run the platform engineering team's roadmap, balancing remittance reliability against platform investment, and own the platform's success metrics (workflow success rates, time-to-completion, manual intervention rate, time to resolve stuck workflows, time-to-integrate).Stakeholders and architecture: Represent the platform to operations, compliance and finance; partner with the engineering lead on architecture decisions with product consequences.Requirements5+ years in product management with at least 3 years owning a platform, infrastructure, API, or backend product whose primary customers were other engineering teams. You have shipped something other teams built on, lived with the consequences of its abstractions, and can talk concretely about what you got wrong.Strong grounding in distributed-systems concepts: asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, at-least-once delivery, idempotency, compensation versus rollback, and the failure modes of long-running workflows. You can hold a design conversation with senior engineers as a peer.Payments, remittance, banking, ledger or transaction-processing experience. You understand settlement, reconciliation, payout partners and compliance screening well enough to know where the domain-specific logic ends.Exceptional written communication. Your specs and contracts will be the reference others depend on.Direct comfort with data: querying, reading dashboards, investigating anomalies without an intermediary.A track record of saying No to powerful internal stakeholders and being right often enough that they kept coming back.These are the applicable requirements, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.Nice to have:Hands-on product experience with a workflow or durable-execution engine — Temporal, Cadence, Step Functions, Camunda, or an in-house equivalent.Experience owning platform reliability outcomes, not just features.What We OfferCompetitive salaryInitial stock options grantAnnual performance bonusUnlimited PTOPaid parental leaveWork model: currently fully remote, with a future transition to a hybrid setupHealth, dental, and vision plans 401(k) with employer matching, for US-based employeesContinuous learning opportunities Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environmentEqual Opportunity EmployerAt Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy.

postings.title: Product Specialist, Cattle - Argentina
postings.descriptionText: About HalterAt Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.We're looking for a Product Specialist to be Halter's boots on the ground as we launch Halter in South America. This is a pioneer role. You'll be working directly with our earliest producers as we deploy Halter onto their farms, learning what it takes to make the product work brilliantly in this environment, and feeding those insights back to the rest of the company so we can build and iterate accordingly.You'll work closely with Halter's HQ in New Zealand and our commercial teams in South America to make sure the product delivers undeniable value from day one and that we're building the right things for South American producers.Halter is one of the world's fastest-growing agritech companies, and the most transformative technology available in pasture-based grazing. With Halter's cattle collars and app, producers can virtually fence and shift their cattle, and proactively monitor cattle locations and behaviour.We're looking for big thinkers who know how to get stuff done — people who are natural problem-solvers and are comfortable in a dynamic, high-energy environment where they'll be challenged daily. Our ideal person is someone deeply committed to understanding our product and our customers' needs. Above all, you'll care about the cattle and the producers who work with them, and you'll champion their interests across Halter.National and International travel will be required in this role. About The RoleWhat your day could look like:Getting out onto farms to help deploy Halter with our first customers — this is hands-on work, not desk work. Building close relationships with our pioneering producers, deeply understanding how they operate, and learning what the product needs to do to deliver real value in this context. Feeding those learnings back clearly and rigorously to our product and engineering teams in New Zealand, so we're always building what matters most. Helping us understand the nuances of South American cattle production. The animals, the land, the practices and sharing that context throughout the company. Thinking critically about the product end-to-end and identifying what we need to fix, improve, or build next. Working with our first customers to make sure they're getting the most out of Halter and seeing real results. Partnering across the commercial team to maintain strong alignment as we scale. Whatever else it takes to make Halter succeed in South America. What we're looking for:Experience working in South American cattle production. This is a must-have. Passionate about animals and the future of agriculture in the region. Tech-savvy and genuinely curious about how our product works under the hood. A strong communicator who can translate what they're seeing in the field into clear, actionable feedback for a remote product and engineering team. Proven ability to think critically about a problem and reach strong, innovative conclusionsComfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage market entry and things will be imperfect; you'll thrive on that rather than be frustrated by it. Fast learner with the drive to work hard alongside a team doing things that have never been done before. A get-stuff-done attitude with the resilience to push through challenges. Willing to travel and work flexibly, including weekends when needed. Spanish fluency required. English proficiency is a requirement for this role. The recruitment process will include interviews conducted in English, and a significant part of the day-to-day work will also be conducted in English. Candidates should feel comfortable communicating, participating in professional conversations, and working effectively in English. If you are not comfortable having professional conversations in English, this role may not be the right fit for you. Join our teamHalter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.Why our team loves working at Halter:Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations. Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems. You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund. This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"
